chapters.title: Chapter 654 Fools
paragraphs: As a player, he was sent to this planet right at the time the evolution had started.
And with his growth and cheats, he was far ahead of the normal people of this world.
But unlike many other players he didn't just focus on personal growth, and was a bit unlucky.
He built a good team but didn't have many lucky encounters, unlike other players who were even stronger.
"We have to quickly move to the Riverdel and enter the Cave of Beasts before others, according to the news, something very very special will soon be born there."
He said excitedly, with that treasure he really might be able to surpass other players.
These players although from the same planet didn't have very good relations unfortunately.
There were still small groups but most hated each other.
"These wolves of yours are quite nice, I will be taking them all." He added.
"Of course sir, it is all yours now. You can have more from the Wolves base if you want." Butcher decided to throw Xander under the bus too.
"Hmm Looks like we will be needing more."
Back in the underground base, Vritra and his wives chatted calmly.
Shitless was still all red with bulging eyes, wrapped in clothes.
For some reason he just wasn't returning to normal, though he could still transform into shit Sonia and look like a beauty.
Some time passed and...
KNOCK KNOCK
Some time passed and they heard a light knock on the door.
Vritra pulled open the door and saw Junior standing there.
"What is it?" he asked, blocking Junior's vision as he kept trying to peek inside.
It was the women who had it worse in this apocalypse, a lot of them became prey to men, unless they gained enough strength.
"Boss is calling you all, let's eat together and you should know more about this place too." He replied, giving up on looking inside.
"Alright, we will be there." He nodded and shut the door loudly, hitting Junior's nose.
OUCH
He fell back with a red nose.
"So, it is time, you are free to kill them all. But leave Xander guy alive, mom use your hypnosis to control him." Vritra spoke.
After all his wives had eaten those crystals their spiritual attribute had risen by a lot, it was already above all other attributes.
And Vanessa, whose ability especially depended on spiritual power, benefited the most.
Opening the door, Vritra stepped out and walked towards Junior who was waiting in the distance.
Onest and Shitless followed along.
Upon arriving in a hall, they saw a big table full of hot food, arranged before various seats.
Xander was already seated there with a welcoming smile, if they didn't know better, they might really have fallen into his trap.
"Boss says: Please take your seats, there are a few rules here that I would like to discuss while eating." Junior translated.
Vritra nodded and sat down, all others did the same.
The eleven seats were all occupied instantly, while Junior stood beside Xander, waiting impatiently for the women to eat the food.
They had added a strong sleeping liquid, that would quickly put them all to sleep.
"Oh that's very nice of you, I never thought there could be any more good people in this world like you."
This statement made Xander's underlings almost burst out in laughter. Their boss being a good man? He was the worst scum, they just waited to see how Vritra would react soon.
"Sorry husband, but I am full." Teresa said, rubbing her belly.
"Yeah darling, I am full as well. We ate too much earlier." Fiona added.
"Me too, honey." Vanessa also spoke.
"Master, I can't eat anymore either." Maeve said.
One by one all his wives refused, then even Shitless and Onest did the same.
Xander frowned but he didn't want to show his true colours just yet.
It would be the best if they could deal with these people peacefully, but he still gestured for more people to surround the hall in case of emergency.
"Boss says: It's fine, then at least have the sweets, I won't feel good if I don't treat my guests well." Junior said.
"Sigh fine if you insist so much." Diana said as she stood up and took the bowl containing some sweets.
She used her ability and easily got rid of the negative effects it would have.
The goddess served the sweets to all the women and to Shitless and Onest, before returning to her seat.
Each of the women in the group looked absolutely stunning, from Diana to Fiona, each made their minds freeze.
"Well then, let's dig in." Vritra said as he picked the spoon and fork and began to eat.
Xander smiled and nodded, as he started eating too, of course his food was fine.
'These people are too clueless, how did they even survive in this apocalypse?' he frowned internally, he never underestimated his opponents.
But these people were falling in his traps way too easily, it made him feel a bit uneasy.
Soon Vritra had eaten more than half and the others had eaten the sweets as well.
'The effects should be kicking in any second now.' Xander smiled, he had already gathered all his group around the room, in case things went wrong.
YAWN
Vritra yawned first, his eyes half closed and others too yawned one by one.
"Sorry, looks like we are too tired by our journey." Vritra said, rubbing his eyes.
He could start slaughtering them immediately but he wanted to start when they finally showed their true colours.
When they were sure their plan had succeeded, it would be way more fun that way.
"I guess the talking will have to wait till tomorrow, we will be returning to our rooms now."
While speaking his expression changed slightly, as if he had finally noticed something.
"Boss says: Hahahahaha" Junior started laughing loudly, Xander's laughter was too strange.
Vritra stood up before stumbling, and almost falling over the table.
"D- Did you mix haa something in the food?" he asked, looking weak.
"Kekeke Wow, what a genius, you caught on very quickly kekekeke" another guy laughed loudly.
"Boss says: don't worry, you will serve well as the food of our wolves, you three men will soon receive a very satisfying painful death in your sleep.
And as for these women hehehe" Junior translated, with an evil grin.
"H- How could you... I- I trusted you ughh" Vritra was showcasing his godly acting skills.
He knew they must have put strong sleeping solution in the food, it couldn't be poison.
"Tch boss says: How can you be this stupid, there is no free lunch in the world. If you do get it, then you are the fee itself.
Now enough chatting and go to sleep, when you wake up you will already be up in heaven."
"Sigh You bastards, I- I am going to- Pffttt" Vritra hugged his belly and started laughing loudly, Shitless, Onest and the women also started laughing all of a sudden.
The smile on Xander's face paused, he looked at them strangely and the feeling of foreboding in his heart rose, there really was something wrong.
"Boss says: attack them and break their limbs, kill the guys!!" Junior shouted, feeling scared suddenly.
"You guys, do you practice this thing in private?" Vritra wiped the imaginary tears from the corner of his eyes, as he straightened and looked at the two.
"Well playtime is over, shall we start the cleanup?" his expression suddenly changed, as blood began to swirl around him.
"W- W- W-" Xander was unable to speak, as he stumbled back and crawled backwards.
"What is going on? H- How are you not affected?" junior asked, he too frightened by the sudden change.
"ATTACK!!" Junior shouted quickly, but Vritra was quicker, as blood bullets shot out towards the men charging into the room.
BANG BANG BANG BANG
Limbs were torn, as the dozens of men fell to the ground, all gravely injured.
Vritra pulled out the spear from his inventory and calmly walked towards the enemy.
Meanwhile, Yasmine, vanessa, Diana and Teresa used their abilities to stop enemies from using their skills.
All nine of them supported him, as Vritra began stabbing them one by one.
But he didn't give any of them instant death, he stabbed so they bleed heavily and feel the pain.
Bleeding out to death was not a bad punishment for them.
There were more than hundred men that Xander had gathered outside and around the room.
Hearing the commotion, all of them began to rush forward, only to be subdued instantly before getting taken down.
Vritra was walking forward at normal pace while swinging and stabbing the spear, tearing apart limbs and bodies.
With the others helping him, Vritra didn't even need to put much efforts.
The opponents just paused before him mindlessly, not using their abilities.
Wherever Vritra passed, he left behind a trail of blood and bodies, as they all lay on the ground groaning and screaming.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +90}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +98}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +92}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +93}
As the men of wolves' group began to die, Vritra obtained a lot of sin points.
Since they were all in the same party so even if his family killed them, Vritra still received the sin points.
Finally all others were dead, leaving behind Xander and junior, the two guys were under vanessa's hypnosis.

"I guess it's time to deal with you guys, you have enjoyed yourself a lot huh. I wonder what your victims will do if I give you to them." Vritra mumbled as he approached the two, who still had some senses and kept shivering.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 To The Riverdel
paragraphs: Vritra created a rope made of blood that instantly stabbed into Junior and Xander's feet as they screamed in pain.
Then walking over the dozens of dead bodies, he walked out of the hall and headed towards the inner area.
He could hear distant growling noises, there seemed to be many wolves present in this base.
Soon Vritra arrived in front of a big iron door, with a kick, it flew away.
Instantly screams of several people sounded, hundreds of survivors were trapped inside, all hurled together.
They were scared as blinding light entered, the people looked thin and had wounds on their bodies.
These people were really treating them all as nothing more than slaves or food for wolves.
"Calm down." Vritra's loud voice reverberated across the big space.
They all quieted down, still filled with fear and looked at the people as their eyes adjusted to the light.
Finally they saw Vritra who was dragging along two guys, and upon seeing them, everyone gasped.
Many people had been fed to the wolves, all sorts of other crimes committed, all the people here were treated worse than animals.
And these two were the main culprits, their shock soon turned into rage.
"These two have been beaten by me, here do whatever you want to him." Vritra said as he tossed Junior forward.
The people were still fearful at first, but then one person roared like a beast and rushed forward.
He started kicking and punching Junior, who screamed and tried to block the strikes.
Soon, others' rage overtook and they began to hit Junior too, tearing his body apart.
Xander was frightened by how badly Junior was getting beaten, his arms were torn, skin ripped away.
Though it was still light for his crimes.
Vritra then dragged Xander away, taking him towards the place where the wolves were locked.
Xander was overjoyed inside, if he could get close to the wolves, he would use his strongest weapon against these people.
He felt the wolves could definitely kill this bunch, so he pretended to be more miserable.
Pausing outside, Vritra glanced at his mother, who nodded and used her hypnosis to control Xander.
They didn't plan to kill the wolves, which is why Vritra was being careful otherwise, he would just kill them all directly.
He kicked the door open as more than forty grown wolves appeared, all growling towards the group.
But they instantly calmed down as Vanessa made Xander use his ability then taking the command of all twenty of them.
"Honey, it's done." Vanessa said with a smile, even if this place was dangerous.
She would rather be here with her son instead of staying at Zoratian planet and worrying about him.
She could even support him.
"Onest, can you throw him into that place too?" Vritra said, gazing at the wolves who were all at least as tall as him.
There were many carriages too, so for the moment the problem of transport was resolved.

{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 14,924}
He glanced at his stats, after killing all the men here and the mutants on the way to this place, there was a significant increase.
He was pretty close to reaching the 100 mark.
Then he could use the ascension path, he could still do it since one of his attributes had reached 100 but doing it later would be more beneficial.
Onest dragged the screaming Xander who felt extreme headache and couldn't even activate his skill.
Soon, the survivors tortured by him tore his flesh to pieces, giving him every bit of pain they felt.
"Husband, I guess it is time we head to the next city, these wolves are pretty fast." Yennefer muttered, gazing at the big mutants.
"Yeah but for us, just eight would be enough. What should we do with the rest?" Vritra wondered.
He wondered if he should just use them to get sin points, but it would be a waste.
"T- Thank you for saving us..." the people finally walked out of the large hall and knelt before Vritra.
They knew he must be very strong if he cleared this whole base and he was the only one who could help them.
"Hmmm does any of you know where the military base is located?" he turned and asked.
"Y- Yes I do..." one guy stood up quickly, there were many who knew its destination in the group.
"C- Can we join you? We can do whatever work you want..." the people pleaded, but there was no way Vritra could take them all around.
"Sorry but you would be killed faster if you were to stay with me. Anyway, if you would like you can stay here or go to the military base, that place is safe. Some of the wolves can take you there."
Vritra said firmly, no matter how pitiful they were, there was no way he could bring them along.
None of them wanted to stay in this cursed place where many had lost their family members.
All of them decided to use the wolves to reach the military base, and with their speed, they could arrive very quickly.
The trip would still be dangerous, but it was better than being slaves to those wolves' guys.
Shitless and Onest helped them as they took the remaining wolves and carriages.
After those survivors were gone, only the ten of them remained.
"Let's head out as well, according to the map, the next city is Riverdel." Vritra said, as he looked at the two carriages.
One was for him and his wives which had six wolves while the other for Shitless and Onest which had two wolves.
Vritra's carriage could be pulled by fewer wolves but he took extra, just in case.
Without wasting any time, they got into the carriages and Vanessa ordered the wolves to start running.
The sound obviously attracted a lot of mutants but it was perfect for Vritra to earn sin points and get stronger.
The woman who had come secretly to see everything had stayed out all this time.
And upon seeing the victims leave and then Vritra's group emerge she was completely shocked.
Then joy flashed across her eyes. Just these few had really annihilated the whole group.
She stood up quickly and ran back, she had to bring this good news to others.
A couple hours after they had left, Butcher brought the player and his big group to the wolves' base.
But the entrance was wide open and the stench of blood was evident.
The player frowned, scaring Butcher as he quickly said:
"X- Xander, the leader and person who could control the wolves probably fed some people to his wolves, that's why it smells haha..."
As they walked into the underground base, the expressions of the people changed as torn and bloodied corpses lay all over the place.
Inside the hall, they found pieces of Xander's body, he was hardly recognizable.
"T- That's... he was fine just earlier, I chatted with him, it doesn't look like the work of a mutant." He muttered fearfully, shaking in terror.
All his bravado from before was gone.
"Hmm it looks like the work of a human, it might be that powerful guy I heard about." The player frowned, but seeing the faint tracks, he fell into deep thoughts.
One track led towards the Riverdel city while the other was opposite, so that guy was trying to fool him.

Then walking over the dozens of dead bodies, he walked out of the hall and headed towards the inner area.
He could hear distant growling noises, there seemed to be many wolves present in this base.
Soon Vritra arrived in front of a big iron door, with a kick, it flew away.
Instantly screams of several people sounded, hundreds of survivors were trapped inside, all hurled together.
They were scared as blinding light entered, the people looked thin and had wounds on their bodies.
These people were really treating them all as nothing more than slaves or food for wolves.
"Calm down." Vritra's loud voice reverberated across the big space.
They all quieted down, still filled with fear and looked at the people as their eyes adjusted to the light.
Finally they saw Vritra who was dragging along two guys, and upon seeing them, everyone gasped.
Many people had been fed to the wolves, all sorts of other crimes committed, all the people here were treated worse than animals.
And these two were the main culprits, their shock soon turned into rage.
"These two have been beaten by me, here do whatever you want to him." Vritra said as he tossed Junior forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 Blood Demon
paragraphs: Vritra lay in the carriage, his head resting in Vanessa's lap, as they chatted while travelling.
For any approaching mutant, one spiritual burst was enough, most had their heads explode.
So even while resting he was earning sin points and increasing his attributes, this was far better than walking in the snow.
Vanessa fed him spicy snacks, though sometimes she would lean down to sweeten his mouth with sultry kisses, as she was eating chocolate candies.
"Hmm Mom, pause here for a minute." Vritra said, as Vanessa's lips separated from his.
"Alright honey." The mature succubus only needed a thought as the wolves stopped moving.
"What's wrong, hubby?" Yasmine asked, yawning.
"It's nothing much, I just sensed a bunch of corpses not too far away, just keep sleeping." Vritra said as he sat up and walked out of the carriage.
Yennefer, Maeve and Teresa too got out to stretch, they had been travelling for over an hour, though the carriage was spacious but the ride wasn't very smooth.
"Ughh The stench is so strong here, like a lot of corpses have been rotting away." Wrinkling her nose, the demoness muttered.
Vritra chuckled, tapping over her nose gently.
"That's why I suggested you should just stay inside, Yenni could control the air flow and stop the stench." Vritra said with a shrug.
Then turning he looked around, finding himself standing in front of a big shopping complex.
"Wait here, I will be back in a minute." He said, before flashing away at full speed.
The boots he got last time were really a great help, helping him break past the limits of 100 attribute points.
He needed more skills and treasures to increase his strength further and all that could only be obtained from the sin wheel.
It was still bright outside but as he entered the humidity and darkness both enveloped him.
The inside of the mall was actually a bit hot, and the stench was even stronger here.
'This heat was probably caused by some mutant.' Vritra thought as he walked closer to the stench while covering his nose with Vanessa's fragrant handkerchief.
As he climbed onto the third floor, Vritra instantly noticed pieces of flesh spread all over the floor.
He saw a casino in the distance and the heat from inside was way too high, even the walls were affected by it.
Slowly he moved forward, and soon saw a big pile of rotten corpses, there were hundreds of corpses and the number increased as he continued forward.
'What... sort of place is this even?' frowning, he continued and soon saw a big pile of flesh glowing with an orange colour.
The torso of the mutant was extremely fat while its limbs and head were very tiny, it was almost like a giant ball.
"So this thing was the reason behind the heat?" it actually seemed very strong and dozens of corpses lay all around it.
It seemed to be sleeping right now, otherwise it would have attacked Vritra already.
'Thankfully I had hidden my presence with spiritual power.' He sighed then took out the spear and scanned the mutant.
Its internal body structure had changed greatly, the brain and heart had all been pushed to the centre of the big flesh ball.
Walking closer to the mutant, Vritra started to feel very hot, it was almost like a big fireball.
Thankfully he possessed fire resistance after his fight with Bull.
Positioning the spear carefully, he thrust it forward with all his strength.
[Blood Manipulation Activated!]
GRRRAAAAAAAAAAA!!
A terrifying roar instantly sounded across the mall and outside, the big mutant had woken up.
Even the blood had transformed into lava-like liquid but Vritra could still control it, he stabbed the creature's brain.
And used its blood to destroy all the internal organs quickly without giving it any chance to counterattack.
RARRRRRRRRRRR
The large ball trembled violently, trying to throw off the attacker but the spear continued to thrust forward, soon destroying its brain completely.
'This mutant, despite having its brain injured could still live, it was truly very powerful.' Vritra thought as he pulled back the spear, various messages flashing before his eyes.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +3,153}
"!!!" the number of sin points shocked him, this meant this mutant was as strong as the danger at the military base.
If a proper fight had broken out, Vritra might have had to escape.
[You have obtained the Fire Flesh Ascension Path!]
Then another message popped.
"Oh, this is nice!" Vritra exclaimed, but he wondered if he should use it or give it to Fiona.
After all, fire suited her more.
But looking at all the corpses around, he decided to think about that later.
Without wasting any time, he started touching all the corpses one by one as satisfying messages flashed before him.
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a dead body +18}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a dead body +22}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a dead body +27}
There were a lot of corpses, it took a while before Vritra was finished then he glanced at the sin points.
Even his stats had increased after killing that fire mutant.
{Sin Points: 23,024}
"Not bad, let's draw rewards with 500 sin points, use them all." He said as an ethereal wheel started to spin before him.
It seemed his luck was really shining as the very first message shocked him.
[You have obtained the Blood Demon Ascension Path!!]
[You have obtained 10,000 packets of cookies.]
[You have obtained 2 Strength attribute points.]
Exactly, forty-six messages popped before him.
First he scanned the number of attribute points.
[6 Strength, 8 Agility, 4 Endurance, 2 Spiritual, 4 Free Attribute points.]
[Stats]
(Strength: 97)
(Agility: 100)
(Endurance: 98.3)
(Spiritual: 100)
{Free Attribute: 4}
"My Spiritual attribute was already overflowing and now even agility has reached 100, let's use the free attribute first." He mumbled and filled them up.
[Stats]
(Strength: 100)
(Agility: 100)
(Endurance: 99.3)
(Spiritual: 100)
{Free Attribute: 0}
He was so close, just 0.7 more points in Endurance and all of them would reach 100, then he could use the ascension paths.
"Oh right, I got the Blood Demon Ascension Path, looks like it is really in my fate to be a demon." Since he already had two ascension paths, he decided to give the fire body to Fiona.
They would be getting a lot more in the future anyway.
"Time to leave." He muttered and disappeared, his speed even higher than before.
Even aside from those players, there must be many humans on this planet who had already gotten their ascension paths.
Not to mention the mutants seemed to develop their own ascension paths, so their strength hit no bottlenecks.
As Vritra arrived outside he saw his wives waiting for him, thankfully no trouble arrived in the meantime.
"Dear, are you done?" Diana looked at him tenderly, making sure he was not injured.
"Yes, and this was a rather lucky place..." Vritra began to explain, laughing lightly.
While chatting they got into their carriages and once again the journey continued, only to come to an abrupt halt just a minute later.
With a frown, Vritra opened his eyes and looked quizzically at Vanessa: "Mom, what's wrong?"
But without her answering, he already sensed the outside situation.
"There are people outside surrounding our carriages." Vanessa said in a serious tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 The First Player
paragraphs: Vritra sensed dozens of presences surrounding the carriages, with a frown he got up and walked out.
At least these people didn't attack them right away, he wondered what their motive might be.
Right after getting out, he noticed exactly 52 men surrounding them, and he actually recognized one.
But before Vritra could say anything, messages flashed before his eyes.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Morgan]
[Ability: Domain]
[Ascension Path: Beast Surge]
As the messages flashed before Vritra's eyes, he was taken aback.
The player himself had come to find him?
"Butcher, good to see you again." Vritra first looked at the tough looking guy who stood cowardly behind another man.
This man was none other than Morgan, the player. With a height even taller than Butcher and a bulky build, he appeared to have a wild personality.
But seeing all his men being so organised showed his control and cautious nature.
"You are still alive?!! How did you huh? All of you survived? What the fuck?!!" Butcher was truly shocked as he looked at the other members in the group.
Onest, Shitless, and the women had all walked out of the carriages by now.
But before anything else, Morgan interrupted their talk and stepped forward.
"Looks like you two know each other and it seems you really are the one who slaughtered the entire wolves' base." He said, his tone sounding impressed.
"So? What do you plan on doing, having surrounded us?" Vritra asked calmly, but he was a bit worried.
The other guy already had an ascension path, so his strength was certainly higher than Vritra's.
And all these men surrounding the group seemed rather strange, they lacked any sort of emotion.
They felt almost like puppets, maybe this domain skill was somehow connected to his subordinates.
'Is that why he is bringing along so many of them?' Vritra concluded, but getting out of the encirclement wouldn't be easy.
"I will keep it short, why don't you join my group. You look powerful, and would be a great addition to my collection." While speaking, Morgan looked at his men.
None of them were at Vritra's level yet, so recruiting him would increase his overall strength.
Not to mention, his skill mainly depended on his subordinates, the stronger puppets he had, the higher his strength.
"But it seems you are pretty full." Vritra said, aside from Butcher all fifty seemed like his puppets.
And seeing the perfect fifty number, it must be the limit of his skill.
"You have good observation, not bad. You can even be a commander in my army, good." Morgan nodded in satisfaction.
Then his gaze swept over the women beside him and he appeared quite shocked, there were such beauties on this planet?
He suddenly felt like adding them all to his army too.
"Alright, I am giving you one chance to be my commander. Kill that masked woman and the two guys and I will give you a spot."
Morgan said in a calm voice, pointing towards Teresa, Onest, and Shitless.
Vritra rolled his eyes, then spoke, "Alright, but I first need to see if your group really is as powerful as you say, and you must want to see my ability, right?"
"Oh? And what do you suggest?" Morgan narrowed his eyes.
"We are ten, and after killing those three, we will still be seven. So how about you let me fight seven people from your side, and also include that Butcher guy, so let me fight eight of them."
Vritra spoke, his tone firm.
"..." Morgan narrowed his eyes.
He didn't doubt that people could betray or abandon their own groups or even families in this apocalypse.
So Vritra accepting to switch sides didn't surprise him, but the conditions did.
'Looks like this Butcher has some feud with him. I can certainly give this guy up if it means something, but why does he want to fight my group?'
Of course, he wouldn't just believe whatever Vritra said.
To add a new puppet, he first needed to make them submit, which was why he was wasting time instead of just attacking.
He glanced over the women and wondered if he should accept or just use those women's lives to make him submit.
But those women were too beautiful and quite strong, it would be such a waste to just kill them.
"Sir, I alone can beat him up, just agree hehe, and if I win just let me join and have one or two of those women."
Butcher quickly spoke, afraid that Morgan might start killing the women.
He couldn't make the same mistake, it was his greatest regret to leave them to die.
Morgan wasn't one to underestimate his enemies or lower his guard, but this guy hadn't even obtained an ascension path.
'I guess I can see his battle prowess firsthand, and I don't think he can play any tricks.'
Although his strength wasn't the highest among the ten players, it was not a joke.
With his skill, he could use the skills of any of his men freely, so if Vritra really tried something, he could instantly kill the women and Vritra himself.
"Alright, fight those seven and Butcher, but if you lose you will even lose your will and be nothing more than a mindless puppet.
Prove to me your worth, and I will grant you a high position and some freedom."
Morgan said as he locked onto Vritra and the other women, ready to kill them if he tried anything.
"It would be a pity to kill you all, so behave." He added.
Vritra nodded, a solemn look on his face.
This situation was too dangerous, one mistake and there really might be casualties, he was feeling tense.
Pulling the spear out of nowhere, he surprised Morgan, who wondered if Neil had a space superpower.
The group backed away while Morgan and the seven men stepped forward to fight Vritra all at once.
Those men's strength was mostly around 90 stat points, of course not in all their attributes, none were like Vritra.
They had their strengths and weaknesses, if someone's strength was high then their agility or spiritual stat was lower.
Fighting them all at once would be easy.
'Divine, how long will it take if I use the Blood Demon Ascension path?'
Vritra asked in his mind as he gestured for his family to move away and be careful.
Without knowing anything about the opponent, the situation was too dangerous.
And this guy was clearly testing him.
"Merging with an ascension path is a long process, but you can quicken it, though it would be dangerous and a bit painful.
If you can survive that, then the time will be 30 minutes." Divine replied.
Then he added, "Though near the end, the others will notice it. Just fill your attributes before that."
Vritra took a deep breath, closing his eyes as the back of the spear rested on the road.
"Darling, be careful..." Fiona muttered, they all wanted to help but knew if they interfered the situation would only get worse.
Yasmine, Maeve, Yennefer, all of them were filled with worry, but trusted him completely.
"Pitiful one, you got this! Let me put my special curse on those pigs." Shitless said and began to chant something.
"Haha brother, looks like you have been living well, you have got quite the collection. Your taste is really great, brother."
Butcher spoke with a loud laugh.

sentences.text: Vritra sensed dozens of presences surrounding the carriages, with a frown he got up and walked out.
At least these people didn't attack them right away, he wondered what their motive might be.
Right after getting out, he noticed exactly 52 men surrounding them, and he actually recognized one.
But before Vritra could say anything, messages flashed before his eyes.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Morgan]
[Ability: Domain]
[Ascension Path: Beast Surge]
As the messages flashed before Vritra's eyes, he was taken aback.
The player himself had come to find him?
"Butcher, good to see you again." Vritra first looked at the tough looking guy who stood cowardly behind another man.
This man was none other than Morgan, the player.
With a height even taller than Butcher and a bulky build, he appeared to have a wild personality.
But seeing all his men being so organised showed his control and cautious nature.
"You are still alive?!!
How did you huh?
All of you survived?
What the fuck?!!" Butcher was truly shocked as he looked at the other members in the group.
Onest, Shitless, and the women had all walked out of the carriages by now.
But before anything else, Morgan interrupted their talk and stepped forward.
"Looks like you two know each other and it seems you really are the one who slaughtered the entire wolves' base." He said, his tone sounding impressed.
"So?
What do you plan on doing, having surrounded us?" Vritra asked calmly, but he was a bit worried.
The other guy already had an ascension path, so his strength was certainly higher than Vritra's.
And all these men surrounding the group seemed rather strange, they lacked any sort of emotion.
They felt almost like puppets, maybe this domain skill was somehow connected to his subordinates.
'Is that why he is bringing along so many of them?' Vritra concluded, but getting out of the encirclement wouldn't be easy.
"I will keep it short, why don't you join my group.
You look powerful, and would be a great addition to my collection." While speaking, Morgan looked at his men.
None of them were at Vritra's level yet, so recruiting him would increase his overall strength.
Not to mention, his skill mainly depended on his subordinates, the stronger puppets he had, the higher his strength.
"But it seems you are pretty full." Vritra said, aside from Butcher all fifty seemed like his puppets.
And seeing the perfect fifty number, it must be the limit of his skill.
"You have good observation, not bad.
You can even be a commander in my army, good." Morgan nodded in satisfaction.
Then his gaze swept over the women beside him and he appeared quite shocked, there were such beauties on this planet?
He suddenly felt like adding them all to his army too.
"Alright, I am giving you one chance to be my commander.
Kill that masked woman and the two guys and I will give you a spot."
Morgan said in a calm voice, pointing towards Teresa, Onest, and Shitless.
Vritra rolled his eyes, then spoke, "Alright, but I first need to see if your group really is as powerful as you say, and you must want to see my ability, right?"
"Oh?
And what do you suggest?" Morgan narrowed his eyes.
"We are ten, and after killing those three, we will still be seven.
So how about you let me fight seven people from your side, and also include that Butcher guy, so let me fight eight of them."
Vritra spoke, his tone firm.
"..." Morgan narrowed his eyes.
He didn't doubt that people could betray or abandon their own groups or even families in this apocalypse.
So Vritra accepting to switch sides didn't surprise him, but the conditions did.
'Looks like this Butcher has some feud with him.
I can certainly give this guy up if it means something, but why does he want to fight my group?'
Of course, he wouldn't just believe whatever Vritra said.
To add a new puppet, he first needed to make them submit, which was why he was wasting time instead of just attacking.
He glanced over the women and wondered if he should accept or just use those women's lives to make him submit.
But those women were too beautiful and quite strong, it would be such a waste to just kill them.
"Sir, I alone can beat him up, just agree hehe, and if I win just let me join and have one or two of those women."
Butcher quickly spoke, afraid that Morgan might start killing the women.
He couldn't make the same mistake, it was his greatest regret to leave them to die.
Morgan wasn't one to underestimate his enemies or lower his guard, but this guy hadn't even obtained an ascension path.
'I guess I can see his battle prowess firsthand, and I don't think he can play any tricks.'
Although his strength wasn't the highest among the ten players, it was not a joke.
With his skill, he could use the skills of any of his men freely, so if Vritra really tried something, he could instantly kill the women and Vritra himself.
"Alright, fight those seven and Butcher, but if you lose you will even lose your will and be nothing more than a mindless puppet.
Prove to me your worth, and I will grant you a high position and some freedom."
Morgan said as he locked onto Vritra and the other women, ready to kill them if he tried anything.
"It would be a pity to kill you all, so behave." He added.
Vritra nodded, a solemn look on his face.
This situation was too dangerous, one mistake and there really might be casualties, he was feeling tense.
Pulling the spear out of nowhere, he surprised Morgan, who wondered if Neil had a space superpower.
The group backed away while Morgan and the seven men stepped forward to fight Vritra all at once.
Those men's strength was mostly around 90 stat points, of course not in all their attributes, none were like Vritra.
They had their strengths and weaknesses, if someone's strength was high then their agility or spiritual stat was lower.
Fighting them all at once would be easy.
'Divine, how long will it take if I use the Blood Demon Ascension path?'
Vritra asked in his mind as he gestured for his family to move away and be careful.
Without knowing anything about the opponent, the situation was too dangerous.
And this guy was clearly testing him.
"Merging with an ascension path is a long process, but you can quicken it, though it would be dangerous and a bit painful.
If you can survive that, then the time will be 30 minutes." Divine replied.
Then he added, "Though near the end, the others will notice it.
Just fill your attributes before that."
Vritra took a deep breath, closing his eyes as the back of the spear rested on the road.
"Darling, be careful..." Fiona muttered, they all wanted to help but knew if they interfered the situation would only get worse.
Yasmine, Maeve, Yennefer, all of them were filled with worry, but trusted him completely.
"Pitiful one, you got this!
Let me put my special curse on those pigs." Shitless said and began to chant something.
"Haha brother, looks like you have been living well, you have got quite the collection.
Your taste is really great, brother."
Butcher spoke with a loud laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 658 Unbearable Torment
paragraphs: "Too bad though, brother, you can't protect them. I don't mind helping you, let me prove it with my strength." Butcher said, trying to act tough in front of the seven women.
Vritra wanted to immediately snap his neck but he held back, Morgan was the biggest problem right now.
"Let him try first, I doubt Butcher can beat this guy." Morgan instructed, Vritra's strength was definitely very high.
He could sense it.
'His ability was related to sound? Or was it someone else's?' Vritra wondered, as he opened his eyes and focused on Butcher.
'Merge with the Blood Demon Ascension Path! Forced Merge!' he called out in his mind and in his pocket, for a moment, a blood red crystal appeared.
Strange patterns were drawn over it, and it was the size of a fist.
Right as Vritra ordered, the stone began to melt and got absorbed into his body.
The same strange pattern began to appear all over his skin, thankfully it was all hidden under the clothes.
"Brother, let's start." With a big smile, Butcher said and suddenly sneaked an attack.
Pointing his hands towards Vritra, powerful sound waves shot out, it was terrifying enough to even destroy the ground around him.
Not only would it affect him physically but it was also a mental attack, a really powerful one.
But for Vritra, it was nothing. With Evomorph and his high spiritual and endurance attributes, he wouldn't even get injured.
FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
But clutching his head, Vritra grimaced in pain as a burning sensation spread all over his body.
It felt as if his very skin was being ripped away, as if his blood had started to boil over and harm him.
His organs were getting crushed or melted, the pattern creeping into his bones.
It felt so painful that Vritra almost felt like passing out, his face turned pale and eyes bloodshot.
"Hubby!!" Yasmine called out, almost running to his side. Their hearts ached to see Vritra suffer, they couldn't understand how this attack could hurt him.
Was he pretending? It didn't seem like it.

'What? This weak attack alone was enough to bring him down? Did I overestimate him or did he get injured in the previous fight? It didn't seem like he is pretending...' Morgan thought, staring intently at Vritra and his family's reaction.
"Hahaha, you are too weak brother, did you get help in wiping out Xander and others or use poison to weaken them? Anyway, let's just end the battle." Pausing, Butcher laughed.
He was very happy, now he could become a high ranking member in Morgan's group and get a few of those women.
It was a pity he would lose his base, but seeing Vritra's women, he was ready to give up anything.
Vritra almost fell as he experienced the excruciating pain. It was far worse than getting surgery all over his body without any anaesthetic and staying wide awake.
If not for his sheer will, he really might collapse right away.
Using the spear for support, Vritra remained standing on his feet.
Coughing lightly, he focused on Butcher.
'L- Let's do it!'
Gritting his teeth, Vritra used his boot's ability and shot forward, his speed still far worse than his peak.
But Butcher was caught off guard, as he hurriedly jumped back.
SWISH
Waving the spear in a big arc, Vritra stabilized his falling body, his movements seemed almost like a drunkard.
Fighting while experiencing such torment was way too difficult, he could barely keep his eyes open.
A shallow cut appeared over Butcher's chest, but he retaliated with a sound explosion, pushing Vritra back.
His face was as pale as white paper.
But he charged again, his superior attributes still gave him an advantage.
FAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
Another terrifying scream came out of Butcher's throat, as he pulled knives from his back and began to stab and slash with all his might.
His movements were messy and untrained, so Vritra could still predict it all.
[Spiritual Burst!]
"Ughh" a weak spiritual burst hit Butcher, making him stumble back as the spear instantly slashed at his thigh.
Of course, Vritra wanted to waste some time.
"Tch, damnit, you look like a ghost, just die already, BROTHER!!" screaming like a madman, he rained down a barrage of attacks while hitting Vritra with all sorts of sound attacks.
A few of the attacks landed on Vritra's body, though only managing to leave some scratches.
Which healed quickly thanks to Evomorph.
But because of the forced merging, his veins kept popping, skin rupturing, so he allowed Butcher to slash exactly there.

"Die! With such strength you can't do anything, even if you can defeat me, you can't beat those seven. So just let me kill you!! I can protect your family." Butcher failed to kill Vritra despite his current state.
Vritra was covered in blood, his body trembling as he weakly held the spear.
But he still couldn't beat him, Butcher could feel Morgan's gaze on him and felt the pressure.
He had to defeat this guy or death would be his only outcome.
Butcher lunged forward, but the spear suddenly appeared before his eyes, almost popping one of them.
Leaving behind a long and deep cut on his cheek.
Although the pain was only increasing, Vritra was slowly getting used to his condition, his movements becoming unpredictable.
But before the merging finished, he had to bring his endurance to 100.
Vritra was torturing Butcher, slashing and stabbing all over his body, for the payback from last time.
'Ughhh, fuck it!!' Butcher cursed internally then turned to face Morgan and called for help meekly:
"Sir, I can defeat him but it will take too long. W- Why don't you let them join me and see if he has any ability or not."
Morgan rolled his eyes, he couldn't understand what was wrong with Vritra but because of his current condition, the player didn't see him as a threat.
'Let's see if he is even worth it or not, I need as much strength as possible for Riverdel City, that place is far too dangerous.'
After thinking, he gestured for the seven men to join.
The puppet like men who all wore thick coats nodded and walked forward, standing in a circle around the weak Vritra.
Vritra inhaled the cold air deeply, the world around him appeared blurry and red, he just wanted to sleep.
A few minutes earlier, he was resting in Vanessa's lap and now he was in a death battle.
The future really was too unpredictable.
All seven possessed various abilities, with a quick scan Vritra found them out.
Two possessed high defenses, one was a speedster, there was also an ice ability user, the remaining three all had high strength skills.
It seemed Morgan had only sent the ones with weaker abilities, but their strength was not low at all.
They were also equipped with various weapons such as axes, hammers, and knives.
After a brief moment of silence, all of them attacked Vritra at once.
The first to strike was the sound attack followed by sharp ice crystals, aimed at his head and heart.
The remaining men attacked with physical weapons, launching from all sides.
Vritra allowed the crystal to slash at his back, while swinging the spear to parry the axes, then kicking the ground he shot towards one of them.
[Spiritual Burst!]
[Spiritual Burst!]
[Spiritual Burst!]

chapters.title: Chapter 659 The Parasite
paragraphs: [Spiritual Burst!]
[Spiritual Burst!]
[Spiritual Burst!]
Vritra's physical body had weakened but his mental energy was still just as strong.
Waves after waves of mental energy shot out at one of the men, as Vritra lunged towards him.
He had to stall for around 30 minutes, but in that time he also had to kill them all.
Morgan might play some tricks during this time, so Vritra was very vigilant, a part of his mind always concentrated on the player.
"Aghhhhh" the puppet like man clutched his head and screamed, his spiritual attribute was rather low.
If Vritra wasn't holding back, then he might already be dead.
WHOOSH
The spear stabbed into his thigh as blood gushed out, but the puppet didn't react to the physical pain, only staggering back.
THUD
The hammer struck Vritra's back in that instant, but it was more of a cover.
The energy was running rampant in his body, the merging was getting dangerous, as suddenly veins exploded on his back.
'Only five minutes have passed...' he thought, his body shaking even more violently.
'He is better than expected but also weaker...?' Morgan watched the fight and couldn't tell if Vritra was strong or weak.
This guy got so easily injured by those weak attacks, his body seemed on the verge of collapse.
Yet he was still contending against those eight, constantly wounding those men, it just didn't make any sense.
Whatever this guy might be planning, Morgan had his own plans, this sort of battle also benefitted him.
'Take as much time as you want, I was wondering if I should let you keep some of your consciousness but now you are going to be another puppet in my group.'
A thread like line started to stretch over the ground, completely invisible to the naked eye.
It quickly moved towards Vritra and just as he stepped back, it pierced through the back of his neck.
While fighting and with all the pain, he didn't even notice it.
This ability to turn others into puppets was very powerful, others wouldn't even notice and soon their memories and consciousness would be gone.
The only downside being that it needed time and with this battle, Vritra had given him enough time.
"Brother, you sure a- are tough. But HUFF HUFF unfortunately, you c- can't join them, if you just die a- all those women will be s- safe." Butcher spoke while panting.
There were many wounds over his body, greatly slowing him down.
He didn't possess any physical ability to begin with, so he just hid behind the seven men.
Fearing that Vritra just might kill him.
During the fight, he didn't forget to keep throwing lustful gazes towards the worried women.
A knife slashed at Vritra's arm but without caring about the wound, he stabbed the dagger through the throat of one man.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +5,021}
Instantly a message popped before Vritra, and he instantly ordered:
'Use 2,000 points to purchase 1 Endurance attribute point!'
After killing this guy, his attributes increased but it was just 0.1 short of 100.
[You have obtained 1 Endurance Attribute Point!]
[All attributes have reached the threshold!]
[Merge with an Ascension Path to continue evolving!]
Several messages popped before him instantly.
[Stats]
(Strength: 100)
(Agility: 100)
(Endurance: 100)
(Spiritual: 100)
{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 3045}
'It's done, now I just need to...' a wave of dizziness suddenly hit Vritra, almost making him fall as attacks arrived from all directions.
He stomped his feet on the ground, trying to stand properly.
Was it also because of the merging process?
He didn't have the time to think, as knives and ice blades almost punctured his body.
Vritra had experienced fighting a large horde, so it wasn't too difficult for him.
But with his current condition, it was almost like he was playing the game at hell difficulty and then giving handicaps to his opponents.
Morgan was careful of the women too, but the only danger here was Vritra.
BOOOM
Enduring the pain of a stab, Vritra hit the head of another man with the brunt of the spear, making it explode.
His body swayed, vision growing darker and redder, head spinning.
Shaking his head, he looked at them but suddenly he was seeing two images of each of them.
Vritra closed one of his eyes, it decreased the precision but it was better than completely missing.
FAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
Suddenly, a loud voice made his head hurt even more, pain shooting through his heart.
Seeing his attack finally work, Butcher was overjoyed.
He jumped forward and stabbed the knife into Vritra's abdomen, but quickly ran back, in fear of getting impaled by the spear.
Vritra staggered back, this bastard sneaked like a rat just as Vritra had parried a hammer.
Nearly fifteen minutes had passed, and his condition was worsening too quickly.
The forceful merging was already taking a toll on him and unknowingly even the parasite was affecting him.
Yasmine and the others felt a stabbing pain seeing Vritra fight in such condition.
But he had told them to absolutely not interfere or all of them would die, but they would have a part to play soon.
The remaining five men didn't care about the wounds on their bodies, the only thing that affected them were the mental attacks.
And Vritra kept launching Spiritual Burst, using these moments to injure or kill them.
Barely dodging the blades, he struck the belly of a guy, the spear coming out from the back of his head.
He had not yet displayed his blood manipulation skill and hid it for the climax of this battle.
Now only Butcher and the four guys remained. Two were with strength skills and two were endurance type.
Killing them wouldn't be hard, but that bastard Butcher kept sneaking in attacks while Vritra was busy fighting against the others.
CLANG CLANG
He pushed back the hammer then with a burst of strength and speed, he shot forward.
Vritra's hand pierced through the chest of one of the strength type guys, pulling his heart out, blood dripping down the ground.
The sight scared Butcher, making him stop as he was about to stab his back again.
'What sort of monster is he? Why is he not yet dead? He possesses mental attack, such high defense, high strength, high speed, what exactly is his specialty?'
Butcher's body turned cold, he knew for sure he was no match for Vritra.
Thankfully, the previous time they didn't confront directly and he had run away quickly.
No wonder this guy survived after being thrown into the river, he was way too strong.
'But I doubt he is as strong as that bastard.' He glanced back at Morgan who had a hideous grin on his face.
That guy also seemed to be planning something.
Vritra breathed heavily, fog coming out of his mouth as he stopped any painful groan from escaping.
Even burning alive wouldn't feel this painful, despite the surroundings being so cold, he felt as if his blood itself had turned into lava.
Throwing the heart away, he looked at the remaining four enemies, whose bodies were full of wounds.
Over twenty five minutes had already passed and he wasn't sure how long he could hold on.
"E- Explode." Vritra muttered as he stumbled and fell onto his back, losing all the strength in his body.

After killing this guy, his attributes increased but it was just 0.1 short of 100.
[You have obtained 1 Endurance Attribute Point!]
[All attributes have reached the threshold!]
[Merge with an Ascension Path to continue evolving!]
Several messages popped before him instantly.
[Stats]
(Strength: 100)
(Agility: 100)
(Endurance: 100)
(Spiritual: 100)
{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 3045}
'It's done, now I just need to...' a wave of dizziness suddenly hit Vritra, almost making him fall as attacks arrived from all directions.
He stomped his feet on the ground, trying to stand properly.
Was it also because of the merging process?
He didn't have the time to think, as knives and ice blades almost punctured his body.
Vritra had experienced fighting a large horde, so it wasn't too difficult for him.
But with his current condition, it was almost like he was playing the game at hell difficulty and then giving handicaps to his opponents.
Morgan was careful of the women too, but the only danger here was Vritra.
BOOOM
Enduring the pain of a stab, Vritra hit the head of another man with the brunt of the spear, making it explode.
His body swayed, vision growing darker and redder, head spinning.
Shaking his head, he looked at them but suddenly he was seeing two images of each of them.
Vritra closed one of his eyes, it decreased the precision but it was better than completely missing.
FAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
Suddenly, a loud voice made his head hurt even more, pain shooting through his heart.
Seeing his attack finally work, Butcher was overjoyed.
He jumped forward and stabbed the knife into Vritra's abdomen, but quickly ran back, in fear of getting impaled by the spear.
Vritra staggered back, this bastard sneaked like a rat just as Vritra had parried a hammer.
Nearly fifteen minutes had passed, and his condition was worsening too quickly.
The forceful merging was already taking a toll on him and unknowingly even the parasite was affecting him.
Yasmine and the others felt a stabbing pain seeing Vritra fight in such condition.
But he had told them to absolutely not interfere or all of them would die, but they would have a part to play soon.
The remaining five men didn't care about the wounds on their bodies, the only thing that affected them were the mental attacks.
And Vritra kept launching Spiritual Burst, using these moments to injure or kill them.
Barely dodging the blades, he struck the belly of a guy, the spear coming out from the back of his head.
He had not yet displayed his blood manipulation skill and hid it for the climax of this battle.
Now only Butcher and the four guys remained.
Two were with strength skills and two were endurance type.
Killing them wouldn't be hard, but that bastard Butcher kept sneaking in attacks while Vritra was busy fighting against the others.
CLANG CLANG
He pushed back the hammer then with a burst of strength and speed, he shot forward.
Vritra's hand pierced through the chest of one of the strength type guys, pulling his heart out, blood dripping down the ground.
The sight scared Butcher, making him stop as he was about to stab his back again.
'What sort of monster is he?
Why is he not yet dead?
He possesses mental attack, such high defense, high strength, high speed, what exactly is his specialty?'
Butcher's body turned cold, he knew for sure he was no match for Vritra.
Thankfully, the previous time they didn't confront directly and he had run away quickly.
No wonder this guy survived after being thrown into the river, he was way too strong.
'But I doubt he is as strong as that bastard.' He glanced back at Morgan who had a hideous grin on his face.
That guy also seemed to be planning something.
Vritra breathed heavily, fog coming out of his mouth as he stopped any painful groan from escaping.
Even burning alive wouldn't feel this painful, despite the surroundings being so cold, he felt as if his blood itself had turned into lava.
Throwing the heart away, he looked at the remaining four enemies, whose bodies were full of wounds.
Over twenty five minutes had already passed and he wasn't sure how long he could hold on.
"E- Explode." Vritra muttered as he stumbled and fell onto his back, losing all the strength in his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 660 Evolution
paragraphs: BOOM BOOM BOOM
The heads of the three puppets exploded at the same time as Vritra used Blood Manipulation and Spiritual Burst at the same time.
Messages popped before him, but Vritra felt too weak to even see them.
His eyes were starting to shut, his connection with his own body breaking.
Something was wrong, this shouldn't just be because of the merging.
With his half opened eye, he looked towards Morgan who should have been shocked after his last powerful attack.
Just like how Butcher looked not far away, he didn't die but felt the blood in his body start to boil.
Instead, there was a grin on Morgan's face, almost like he was about to succeed in something.
'What has he done? Trying to turn me into a puppet?' Vritra wondered, his thoughts jumpy.
But even if he found out there was no way to stop it, there were still a bit over four minutes left.
Not to mention, very soon the merging would start to affect even the surroundings then Morgan would find out.
Just a couple more minutes, Vritra had to wait a bit more.
Letting out a groan, he turned over and slowly pushed his broken form up.
Butcher who was feeling pain in his body, didn't have any time for another sneak attack.
He just stood frozen there.
If Vritra had targeted him too, then wouldn't he have had his head explode just now?
His heartbeat increased even more, as he gasped for breath feeling intense pain in his chest.
'Heart attack?!!' clutching his chest he fell to the ground, it was Vritra's doing of course.
He could control every drop of blood inside Butcher's body.
Using the spear, Vritra straightened up, his clothes torn and drenched in blood.
Cuts were visible all over his body, though most had already healed.
Evomorph working in the background.
It even resisted the effect of the puppet thread, greatly slowing it down.
"COUGH B- Butcher, this is haa haa payback for the l- last time..." Vritra walked unsteadily towards the screaming guy, his tall figure looming over him.
Pulling the spear, Vritra stabbed into the side of Butcher's belly, not killing him directly.
"Aaaaaaaaah S- Stop ughhh damnit s- save me s- sir please help me..." Butcher begged, terrified of Vritra.
But Morgan just stood there with his arms crossed, wondering why it was taking so long to take control of Vritra's body.
"S- Spare me I- I will be y- your slave COUGH please g- give me one chance ughhhh ahhhhhhh" seeing that Morgan had no intention to save him.
He turned to Vritra and began to beg, but this type of guy is the worst.
For his personal enjoyment, he had destroyed the lives of many, just after getting some strength.
And he dared to play that trick on Vritra, almost killing his family and even now this pig was trying so hard to kill him.
Sneaking attacks and eyeing his women, there was no way Vritra would spare him.
Twisting the spear, he pulled back, dragging along his intestines.
"Aaaaaaaah" his painful wails rang out, yet with his current level of mutation that was not enough to kill him.
Which was actually a curse for Butcher.
Vritra placed the tip of the spear above Butcher's forehead, then began to drag it down vertically.
Cutting his body symmetrically, first the blade pierced through his nose then tore through his lips then neck, chest, belly and so on.
Though it was still not deep enough to make him die.
'It's been too long, he should already have turned into my puppet, something is wrong.' Morgan frowned and decided to intervene.
"Alright, that's enough. You have proved yourself and I am more than happy to welcome you to my team.
You can be my commander as long as you can kill that woman and those two guys." Morgan walked closer.
If his first attempt failed then he would just need to try again.
This time he planned to directly plant the seed of the parasite into his body and for that he just needed to tap on his head.
Morgan walked forward, while Vritra who seemed not to have heard, continued to torture Butcher.
Morgan arrived behind Vritra hurriedly but just as he raised his hand to strike, a tentacle from his own shadow shot out.
He was completely taken aback as it stabbed towards his eyes, but his speed was fast enough to dodge it.
Maeve controlled the shadows, her body completely merging with them as she disappeared along with the others.
Morgan frowned, did these women finally decide to intervene? Did they think they could win against him?
He still had those forty five men waiting for his orders, maybe they were just driven into a corner.
"Fools..." he shook his head, yet just at that time a bloody wave exploded around Vritra.
Strange patterns began to glow all over his body, lighting up even the surroundings.
A flood of blood rose drowning Vritra's body and shooting out in all directions.
"Merging? Is he ascending? B- But how?" Morgan was blasted backwards by the force of the flood, his eyes wide open.
How could this guy be merging with an Ascension Path while fighting?
Morgan's own merging had taken like a day, and it had gone very smoothly but what was wrong with this guy?
'I read about forceful merging, did he attempt that? All the while fighting those guys?'
Morgan was extremely shocked, just what sort of determination and tolerance did he possess?
How could he endure all that pain? No wonder those weak attacks were managing to hurt him so badly, in fact almost all his injuries came from the process of merging.
'I have to kill this guy!!'
He knew it would be near impossible to tame him and if the merging completed, then the outcome might be unknown.
He had confidence in his own strength but he had already made a mistake, he didn't think that someone could actually do this.
"ATTACK!!" He screamed, instantly swallowing the whole place in his domain.
His body glowed with various skills but suddenly, a cube made of thin walls appeared around him.
His body froze for a few moments, a hand came from one of the walls, stabbing a knife straight into Morgan's throat.
This was the first time that Teresa had hurt someone else, even after coming to this world at most she would help Vritra and others by freezing the enemies.
But right now she couldn't care less about others' lives, Vritra was all that mattered to her.
And thus, the kindest soul in the universe rained down knives into Morgan's body.
Morgan used all his might to break the walls, but burning her energy, Teresa kept opening more and more.
While stabbing more and more knives into him, he couldn't even use any skills and was completely helpless.
It was all because of this guy that Vritra had suffered so much, he felt so much pain.
Thinking of it made Teresa mad, she felt immense rage take over her mind and heart, only one thought remaining in her mind.
To give as much pain to Morgan as possible, to give him a painful death.
While Teresa stopped Morgan, the rest of the women, Shitless and Onest protected Vritra from the puppets as his body was undergoing evolution.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 Titan Origins
paragraphs: He was in the final stages of ascending, the Blood Demon Ascension Path completely merging with his body.
Shitless finally revealed his true form, a red mutant that scared even a couple of puppets, as his body turned to metal and he pounced at them.
Vanessa used her hypnosis and created illusions around Vritra, Maeve used her shadow ability to protect everyone and attack those puppets.
Onest was running at full speed like a train, colliding forcefully into anyone who got close to Vritra and throwing them away.
Yennefer and Fiona controlled flames while using weapons, they were directly attacking the opponents.
BOOM BOOM
Yasmine made powerful explosions and kept launching Spiritual Burst at the opponents, their single goal was to protect Vritra.
But there were just too many opponents and their strength was too high, they also possessed abilities of their own.
Without Morgan's control they couldn't efficiently fight, but all of them were still having difficulty stopping them.
A blade made of light suddenly pierced into Fiona's belly, making her grimace, but she just continued to fight.
Diana's main role was to support the group, not only was she providing healing but also debuffing the enemies.
Her support was really a big relief for them, she stood not far away from Vritra.
His body was swallowed by a tornado of blood, there were strange light patterns at the surface of the tornado, as it grew bigger and bigger.
'This guy is too powerful? How is his ascension causing such a ruckus?!!' Morgan felt his heart grip with panic, as he could only watch Vritra undergo the evolution.
Teresa's ability was really annoying him, he could break it but she would already have more prepared, not giving him any time to do anything.
'Damnit, kill this woman first!!' he thought but even his orders weren't received by his puppets.
Suddenly, two knives plunged into his eyes, making his world drown into complete darkness.
Teresa felt nothing even as she kept hurting a person.
ROOAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRR
A terrifying roar suddenly shook the surroundings, the road cracked, the buildings shaking and almost falling over.
The air rippling with pressure, the phenomenon was getting more absurd.
'How high were his attributes? He merged perfectly with his ascension path?' for such a reaction to occur there were many factors.
Like how high all of the attributes were, how high his mutation level was, how high his compatibility with the ascension path was and more.
Vritra's talent seemed really terrifying, scaring even Morgan.
He knew he had to kill him asap or this guy would spell trouble for them all.
But within moments, the blood tornado became so big that it pulled even the buildings, turning them into rubble.
All of them moved far away, the fighting paused as his wives and the two guys escaped hastily.
Though those puppets were dragged into the blood tornado.
Their bodies were instantly torn to pieces as their blood too merged with the tornado.
Seeing this, Morgan gave up all hopes of killing Vritra, all his underlings were now gone.
His strength had already decreased a great deal, now only escaping was on his mind.
'Damnit stupid woman, do you want to drag me to death with you?'
Morgan was going mad, he really just wanted to run away now.
But Teresa kept him trapped as the pull of the tornado got stronger and stronger.
Unfortunately, Teresa ran out of energy, trapping such a powerful guy and creating so many walls wasn't easy.
She fell weakly to the ground, her beautiful face covered by glistening droplets of sweat.
Teresa had no strength to move whatsoever, yet she looked hatefully at the man whose body was pierced by dozens of knives.
Without wasting a second, Morgan turned and made a run for his life, he had to get away before that demon got out.
Teresa could only watch as he ran and disappeared in the distance, she tried to move but her body helplessly got pulled towards the tornado.
It was not under Vritra's control, so it wouldn't matter if it was a friend or foe, the ones getting swallowed by the tornado would have the same fate.
But right at that moment, shadows rose around her and swallowed her completely.
Maeve and the others quickly moved several kilometres away, the merging was going too wild.
"Was it supposed to be this huge? I thought merging was a simple process, is it also because master chose forceful merging?" Maeve wondered.
But that shouldn't be the case, but upon thinking Vritra had always been a monster, so it actually wasn't as surprising.
They were just worried about his safety.
"Honey..." Vanessa bit her lips as she watched the tornado cause havoc all over.
A lot of mutants were attracted by the phenomenon and by the smell of the blood, the humans who saw it ran away in a hurry.
Believing it was another dangerous mutant.
People situated even farther away in the city could see the raging tornado.
As more and more mutants poured out to the smell of the blood their bodies were getting swallowed.
Divine watched the scene, of course he already knew something like this would happen.
Even if Vritra had entered the game and locked all his skills, levels and treasures.
But he was a Titan, a power even the Divine couldn't contain.
Titans were originally creatures who were made by nature to create chaos, to create destruction.
Wherever the Titans appeared the place was destroyed, though there were too few of them.
Giving them such powers, the world naturally took many things away from them.
Their will itself, they possessed no consciousness and just continued to eat, floating all over the universe.
Right from birth, they were born as a demi god, just by this fact, it could be known how terrifying this species was.
Even the gods and higher beings feared these mindless creatures who freely roamed all over the universe.
There was practically nothing that could harm them, not even time so they just lived and lived.
Yet higher beings knew if these never died and with more of them being born even if in very long times, the world would grow too chaotic.
So all of them were locked away in the realm of chaos, a realm where Divine was thrown after his sisters sacrificed themselves to protect him.
The others believed he would die, but he only came out stronger.
And that's how he managed to conduct his research on the Titans, the beings who had even started to devour one another.
This was the plan of those higher beings, but in the end one Titan was still left who started to devour that realm itself.
But unfortunately for it, those higher beings wouldn't leave it alone and did everything in their power to stop it.
And Divine was lucky he took the benefit of the chaos and took away the core, heart and everything from the Titan.
He created another Titan, one who had his will, one with limitless potential.
Vritra's strength had just started to rise, he had not yet utilized the abilities of the Titan.
And Divine wanted it to be so for now, he didn't want others to know that there was still a Titan, at least not until Vritra had grown a bit more.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 The Snakey Bird
paragraphs: Once Vritra could use all his skills, those gods or even the higher beings would be nothing.
That Titan Fall was one of a Titan's skills as well, it gave immense strength to the Titan whenever they felt danger.
They could actually use it freely and would just need to rest for some time, unlike Vritra who used it as a demonic dragon.
Thankfully he already possessed Divine's bloodline and physique at that time.
Seeing Vritra grow stronger, Divine felt relieved, it was nearly impossible to create a Titan.
His success was due to Vritra and his own genius.
'Looks like I have mostly completed my part here, this avatar of mine won't last long. I can still help him a bit longer, but that avatar will still be with him.'
Divine thought as he gazed at the others in the group.
Turning around, he flew away, those pesky insects wouldn't leave him alone.
His own self had become an enemy of himself, making Divine sigh.
Vanessa, Yasmine and the others had received injuries during the short battle, though none were serious.
And with Diana being there they were all healed pretty quickly.
"That tornado is devouring so many mutants!!" Yennefer exclaimed, just hoping for Vritra to be safe.
"Maybe their blood is needed for hubby's nourishment? I think he should be fine, still let's stay careful." Yasmine spoke, her eyes focused on him.
Though the group had no choice but to keep moving backwards as the tornado kept getting bigger and bigger.
Vritra's bloodline unconsciously had activated one of his innate skills.
Just like his ability to devour others' physique he could devour the bloodlines, the lifeforce and the blood itself.
A giant mutant, whose body resembled a human, ran into the tornado trying to devour the blood.
But his hands were instantly torn to pieces then the mouth, and within moments, his whole body disappeared.
Seeing the scene everyone was shocked, the big mutant was killed just like that.
The Ascension Path doesn't affect anyone's stats, it not only opens the path for further evolution and transformation, but also grants stronger abilities.
Yasmine and the others had already moved around ten kilometres away from the tornado, it was still getting stronger.
The sky rumbled, electricity coursing through the dark clouds, and snowfall stopped altogether in the entire city.
The snow on the ground over a large distance was already swept away.
It suddenly appeared as if night had descended, lightning thundered and fell with a deafening roar.
It looked powerful enough to kill anyone, the nine of them had no choice but to move under a building.
They watched the tornado with worry, but had no way to help him.
THUNDEERRRRRRRRR!!
Suddenly, an especially terrifying, thick and powerful bolt of electricity descended right towards the centre of the tornado.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
A loud explosive sound followed and dozens of buildings started shaking violently, like trees in a storm.
There was not a single window left intact inside the entire city, but the strange thing was, this electricity didn't seem normal.
The tornado was finally blasted apart by the lightning bolt, an enormous crater forming in the ground.
"Honeyyy!!" Vanessa felt her heart shake in fear, this lightning might have really hurt her son.
All of them hurriedly began to move forward, but they had not taken more than ten steps when an earth shaking screech reverberated.
KRRRRRIIEEEEKKKKKK!
A silhouette became visible in the sky, much bigger than any mutant they had seen, as it spread its wings.
And then it descended.
The wind created by its wings made the rubble fly away and finally its figure was revealed.
It was an enormous mutant bird, though aside from the wings it didn't look anything like a bird.
Its body was more like a snake, with a long beak and big terrifying claws, its body over 30 feet long.
"Wha-!!" their bodies instinctively froze for a moment, this thing was far too dangerous.
More deadly than anything they had witnessed in this apocalypse.
Then the mutant bit down on something and swallowed, letting out another screech and with a flap of its wings it disappeared into the sky.
Maeve and the others were shaken out of their stupor, their hearts sinking as they quickly ran towards the spot Vritra should have been.
"H- He is gone...?" Yennefer mumbled, her eyes wide and chest feeling tight.
"That m- mutant must have taken him!" Teresa exclaimed, biting her lips to the point of feeling pain.
"It moved in that direction, if we hurry, we might be able to catch it. I don't think pitiful one could just die." Shitless spoke, with confidence on his mutant like face.
"..." Vanessa nodded, and they looked around, soon finding the mutant wolves and their carriages.
When the tornado had appeared the wolves had moved away on their own, thankfully.
Getting into the carriages, they moved in the direction of Riverdel at full speed.
Was that city filled with such dangerous creatures? This thing, it had truly mutated into something far from possible.
"Mom, don't worry, hubby will be fine." Yasmine said, though her own hands were shaking.
Most of the mutants had been killed earlier so none attacked them as they strode forward.
"Our strength has increased too!" Maeve spoke in surprise, earlier Vritra had killed a lot of mutants.
It seemed, he and they along with him had benefited from it.
"Our mutation isn't far from 100%, but how are we even going to do anything to that bird?"
They felt depressed and powerless but all they could do now was believe in Vritra and follow after it.
Inside Riverdel City, large groups and organizations had already formed a month or two after the apocalypse had appeared.
People who advanced quickly and had powerful abilities became the leaders, some were good and some became tyrants.
The city in which Vritra and the others had descended could be said to be one of the cities furthest from the tower and so the evolution was slower there.
With weaker mutants, which is why Divine had dropped the group there.
He could have directly sent them close to the tower, even forgetting the chance of getting discovered, they would all be killed instantly.
A couple of players had already grown to terrifying levels, not to mention the mutants and few humans of this planet.
They were given special abilities, to pose a challenge for the players.
This was a level 3 game, so the difficulty was very high and the danger even higher.
Near a tree, two groups were engaged in a fierce battle.
One side wore red colored clothes while the other was wearing purple.
A fruit like stone could be seen growing over one of the branches of the tree, glowing faintly.
The humans and the mutants all maintained a distance from it.
Humans fought among themselves while the mutants fought among themselves, as if they had some sort of agreement.
"Ergen, we are the ones who have been guarding it for a month now, back off!!" a guy wearing a red outfit shouted.
"Grrr As if guarding something makes it yours. Then I guarded my childhood friend for ten years, was her waiter, frustration punching bag, weren't you the one who took her in the end?
Offer me your wife and I will give up on this Ascension Path." The guy in a blue outfit spoke in a very thick voice.

sentences.text: Once Vritra could use all his skills, those gods or even the higher beings would be nothing.
That Titan Fall was one of a Titan's skills as well, it gave immense strength to the Titan whenever they felt danger.
They could actually use it freely and would just need to rest for some time, unlike Vritra who used it as a demonic dragon.
Thankfully he already possessed Divine's bloodline and physique at that time.

His success was due to Vritra and his own genius.
'Looks like I have mostly completed my part here, this avatar of mine won't last long.
I can still help him a bit longer, but that avatar will still be with him.'
