chapters.title: Chapter 663 Crash Landing
paragraphs: The leader of the blue side, the Eagles, was Ergen, whose voice sounded very thick while his body twisted around like rubber.
He had awakened a special ability like that guy from anime.
While on the other side was Ming, the leader of Glasses; his ability was to shoot powerful lasers from his fingers.
"She chose me, not you!!" Ming shouted, shooting lasers towards the thin Ergen.
"This Ascension path is calling to me, can't you hear? It's saying daddy, come take me haha," Ergen said in his heavy voice, then added:
"Tell that bitch her husband's dick isn't even 1% of mine, heh I bet you can't even satisfy her."
Ergen had devoted his life to that woman who promised to marry him; he paid for everything, gave her a home, and stayed like her servant.
But that woman kicked him away as soon as she got a job and eloped with this Ming.
"You can have her if you like, but this ascension path is mine, even if I have to kill everyone here I am not-"
Just then their quarrel paused as a distant loud screeching sound reverberated, all of them looked up.
The mutants fighting on the other side paused as well, their bodies tensing up and they almost started to flee.
Then a large and strange looking bird became visible, its body resembling a long thick snake with large wings.
It was swinging around violently, all of them on the ground were baffled.
They had seen a lot of powerful mutants around, but most were present at the centre of the city.
That's why they remained on the outskirts, this ascension path was precious but the powerful mutants wouldn't have any use for it.
Their first instinct upon seeing such a powerful mutant was to hide, but soon they noticed that something was wrong.
The large mutant was swinging around wildly, blood was pouring out of its body, and it seemed to be breathing out fire from its nose and mouth.
THUMP THUMP THUMP
Muffled sounds kept ringing from inside its body, it smashed into a few buildings.
BOOM
An explosion rang out as a big hole opened in its back, making the mutant screech madly.
It smashed into the ground, wildly shaking and skidding over hundreds of metres.
Just some distance away from the frozen human groups, it stopped, screaming and thrashing.
BOOOM!!
Another loud explosive sound and flames burst out of its back, the eyes of the mutant exploding all of a sudden.
It bit down on its own long tongue, wings stretched far but could do nothing.
"E- Ergen, this ascension path stone is yours." Ming suddenly turned and tried to flee.
But Ergen wrapped one of his arms around his leg, making him fall face first into the road.
"Hah You motherfucker, you think you can run away? Either we both die or just you die, you are not leaving alive from here!!" he swung Ming, throwing him towards the mutant.
KRRIIEEEEEEEEEEE
Electricity coursed through the body of the bird, shooting in random directions.
"You piece of shiiiieeeetttttt-" Ming screamed, his body almost falling into the bird's screeching mouth, but using the laser he barely managed to smash into the ground.
After a few minutes of struggling, the large mutant suddenly became still, its screams coming to a halt.
"Is it dead? H- How? Did it run from a fight? Did it fail to evolve? What happened?" Ergen wondered, gulping in fear.
They looked so small in front of this thing, its length was way too big and the width alone was more than 30 feet.
Then the sound of bone crunching rang out and flesh being torn apart, the dead body trembled slightly.
All jumped back, wondering if this thing was still alive.
"Uwaaaaaaa" Ming screamed, shooting lasers in all directions as he rolled on the ground.
CRACK CRUNCH KSSHHHH
After a moment, the flesh on the back of the mutant bird was torn, and a figure rose.
He was covered in blood, somehow appearing much more terrifying than the mutant bird itself.
"H- He killed it? Is it a human or a mutant?" The people stood closer, as Ming hugged Ergen's leg.
"Boss, he is asking if it's a human or mutant." Ming's underling spoke, his body structure looked strange, like a horse.
"I heard it, damnit!" Ming cursed, if he wasn't his wife's brother, he wouldn't have brought this man here.
Vritra climbed out of the corpse of the mutant bird, his tall figure stood on top of it gazing at his surroundings.
He kind of lost his senses at the final step of the ascension.
Vritra didn't know what had happened but he suddenly felt something hit him and then he was eaten by this mutant.
Without panicking he first made sure his wives, Shitless and Onest were safe by asking Divine.
Then he looked at his status panel.
[Stats]
(Strength: 126.5)
(Agility: 130.4)
(Endurance: 128.7)
(Spiritual: 182.1)
{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 91,499}
It seemed increasing his stats would be even more, based on the large amount of sin points, he surely must have killed a lot of mutants.
Finally, after checking it, he decided to check out what his ascension path had brought.
"Blood Demon Transformation... hmm I will try that later, first let's test some basic skills." He mumbled, thankfully there was a guinea pig right there.
[Blood Burst!]
BOOOM
[Blood Claw!]
CRACK
"Oh this is fun, and there are so many possibilities!"
[Blood Surge!]
GURGLE-BURST
[Blood Storm!]
SPATTER-WHIRL
[Blood Harden!]
CRUNCH-FREEZE
"Let's try corroding it from inside, all its organs, everything!" Vritra mumbled as strange patterns lit up over his back and arms, and blood red fog poured out.
[Blood Corrode!]
FIZZ-MELT
"Alright, time to land little birdie." The bird was shaking around crazily, screaming and trembling.
[Blood Puppet!]
TWITCH-JERK
Soon after the bird started to go still, Vritra looked up as energy shot out of his body, creating a violent explosion.
He was yet to test out the most powerful skill, and had much more possibilities now.
It was like he had become blood itself, could sense every single drop of blood around himself and inside his body.
He could sense the humans and mutants not far away, could kill them with a thought.
Sensing the growth in his strength he decided to move out first.
[Blood Burst!] [Blood Burst!]
BOOOM BOOOM
He breathed in the cool air as blood began to drop from his body, revealing his handsome face and a perfect physique.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +9,849}
{Sin Points: 1,01,348}
'I have reached over a hundred thousand, not bad. It should give me plenty of attribute points, but I also need powerful weapons.' Vritra had even dropped his spear back there.
Finally his gaze moved towards the humans and mutants, staring at him in bewilderment.
They were shocked that he managed to singlehandedly kill such a powerful mutant, if it was a fair fight even the current Vritra might have had some trouble.
But the bird had shown its own weakness.
'I should find mom, Yasmine and the others, they should be worried.' Vritra thought as he put on clothes, blood floating away from his body.
Finally, he started walking, he looked at the mutants and instantly their bodies exploded in a mist of blood.
'M- Monster...' all of them had the same thought, their bodies stuck to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 Rest
paragraphs: Vritra looked at the group of people, who shivered as the bodies of the mutants exploded.
He then glanced around but found it hard to know his exact location, so jumping off the body of the dead mutant,
he walked towards the group.
"Come here." He said, and both Ming and Ergen shivered, meekly walking over.
"Where am I?" Vritra questioned.
"T- This is the Riverdel city, j- just the outer part though..." Ergen spoke, his voice thick as ever.
"I see, the bird flew straight from that direction?" pointing back, Vritra continued.
Both Ming and Ergen nodded hurriedly, fearing that this guy might really kill them.
"Alright, stay here." After speaking, Vritra turned, bloody energy blasted out of his feet as he flew away.
In an instant he had disappeared from their sight, the group fell to the ground, all gasping for breath.
The pressure he put was too suffocating, just by being here.
With his new abilities, he could even continue to fly.
'They shouldn't be far.' Vritra looked around, all his wounds from earlier had already been healed.
Quickly, he crossed the boundary of the Riverdel city, each explosion making him shoot forward.
Before long, he heard the noise of mutants screaming.
It seemed there was a fight breaking out, and Vritra felt his family might be fighting against the mutants.
So he sped up, but upon getting closer, he came across a rather strange sight, it was indeed his family.
The two carriages were running in a line, the women were in the one at the back, while Shitless and Onest were on the front one.
Shitless, who looked like a mutant, was tied outside the carriage.
And dozens of mindless mutants were screaming in terror as they fled away from the carriage, as if Shitless was carrying some plague.
Even the mutants were so scared of this guy?
But Shitless sure seemed mad being tied outside like that, cursing at Onest.
Shaking his head, he landed in front of the fast moving carriages.
The scared mutants were thrown away as their bodies burst out, the wolves stopped, their feet slipping over the snow.
"P- Pitiful one?!!" Shitless looked shaken and then began to beg.
"T- This mugger tied me, SOB if my Bullo was here, he wouldn't dare do anything, you have to beat his ass."
"Alright alright, I will make him pay." Vritra cut the ropes as Shitless fell face first into the snow.
The others quickly rushed out when the carriages stopped abruptly.
All the women were overjoyed to see him perfectly fine, all of them jumping into his arms.
"Dear, are you alright?" Diana checked his body for any injury and sighed in relief.
"Yes I am fine, that player didn't attack you right?" Vritra asked, a frown appearing on his face.
Although he was badly injured, he still might have some tricks up his sleeves.
"No, he ran away during the chaos, I am sure he must have run to the Riverdel city." Vanessa spoke before explaining herself.
Earlier using manipulation and hypnosis, she was able to peek into his memories and knew he was going there.
"Some beast cave or something is present there, and that guy knows a big treasure will be appearing there so he will definitely go.
He drew most of his strength from his underlings, they are all gone now, he might try to get more puppets." She added.
"Yeah he must have already fled to the Riverdel, I doubt he would stay here. Anyway, let's go there, we need to find more about that place too."
Getting into the carriages, they began to move forward.
Morgan, who was badly injured by Teresa, had already left the city, trying to find powerful underlings or team up with other players.
Vritra, lying comfortably in Yennefer's lap, heard her speak of everything that happened after he fell unconscious.
He was surprised Teresa was able to hurt Morgan, and so badly at that.
Sitting up, he patted her head, smiling:
"Tess, you have done great. There are some people in this world who don't deserve our kindness, we just have to distinguish, and by removing those pests you will be saving innocent people."
Tess nodded, leaning into his arms. At first it bothered her. Hurting another person was the last thing she ever wanted to do before, but hearing his words made her relax and feel better.
'I was right, if my husband says so then I am.' She thought, and felt that she should help him in clearing the scum.
While chatting, the carriages quickly entered the Riverdel city and before long they arrived at the place where the big corpse lay.
"Woah, this thing is so big!" Shitless peeked out and exclaimed.

Comparing themselves with him they suddenly felt their mood turn sour, no wonder so many women flocked around him.
But without the strength to protect them, looks alone can't keep them. They became even firmer in their thoughts and wanted to kill Vritra immediately.
'Sigh there is always scum, the apocalypse has truly made these people let out their inner demons, these disgusting pigs.' Vritra thought, his gaze briefly passing over the invisible blanket.
The scared guy stiffened, his gaze briefly meeting with Vritra's.
'H- He saw me? No way, right? This has to be a coincidence, n- no one can see through my ability...' his heart was beating rapidly and he was already regretting agreeing to this plan.
"I don't need it, you can leave." Vritra said, standing right before the door.

"Haha At least look at what he has sent, or he will be angry at us, food is already scarce, you can just take it." the guy said as they pulled the clothes from the basket away and revealed dozens of black fruit like bombs.
"Sir, have a taste of this, I am sure you are going to like it!!" after speaking he threw the bomb at Vritra, and instantly the sub leader shot out with a sword in his hand.
He swung with all his strength to cut off Vritra's head in one single attack.
The bomb exploded without a sound, instantly covering half of the corridor in whitish fog.
Some of it even drifting into the rooms, now the two basket guys were sure those women inside would be charmed.
And they would listen to them only.
After charming the women they planned to use them to kill the other two guys.
CLANG
The sound of metal hitting something rang out in the blinding fog, the two basket guys and fatty couldn't help but laugh out loud.
Sure that they were succeeding. Then the door opened as Diana and Maeve walked out.
"They are here!! They are under our control already, and that guy has been killed too, now just one more thing!" Fatty spoke, laughing hideously.
"All the women, get here and help us kill those two guys, then..." one of the basket guys spoke, his laugh ringing out.
The scared guy stood back, but felt maybe it was the right choice to come after all.
Smiling he walked forward, hoping these guys would share the prize with him.
"Oh, you want us to do what?" Maeve asked, her voice intoxicating the four men.

sentences.text: Vritra gently lay Yasmine to the side to let the dragoness rest, just after one time she looked completely spent.
Which was the first.
Then turning to his wives, another round of pleasure began and the bath continued for long.
One corridor below from Vritra's room, the members of Ming and Ergen's team were all just talking about the new guests.
Few had managed to see glimpses of the women and had almost gone mad.
Although they were all sticking close, but in the apocalypse, each person has plans of their own.
They wouldn't hesitate to kill even their families or friends for their goals, and many here also had evil thoughts.
Though because of the warnings from Ming and Ergen, they were forced to stay away from them.
A group of five looked around sneakily, carrying two baskets.
"A- Are you sure it is fine?
Ergen warned us many times..." a guy wearing a blue dress muttered, he was part of Eagles.

If you did, you would be rushing me to continue with this plan." one of the guys carrying the basket said with urgency.
"Yes, they are very beautiful, I have never seen anyone like that.
Even the models and actresses back then feel like ugly hags compared to them, I am shocked someone like them actually exists."
The other guy carrying the basket muttered.
It was the idea of the two guys carrying the baskets, their contents hidden.
But Vritra's team had three men, so the two alone wouldn't be enough to do anything.
They took three other guys, one with the ability to help them sneak up as Ming and Ergen had set security to stop anyone from going up.
One fat lusty guy who had agreed immediately had a lewd skill, the smoke bombs made by him could instantly charm any woman.
And those women would see the fatty as their lover.
That was exactly why they just had to take care of the three guys and charm the women.
While everyone in the world was doing whatever they wanted, they had been good boys but now they could no longer.
Right after that, they would flee and disappear from this area.
In times of apocalypse who would endanger their lives chasing them?

The two basket guys and the fatty all slapped their foreheads, while the last guy walked as if he didn't care.
He was the main fighting force of the group, and a sub leader, he just didn't like Vritra and others getting such treatment.
And wanted to see if those women were really as beautiful as the two basket guys made them to be.
"Stupid, Ming and Ergen are clearly trying to fool those guys.
I am sure they are planning the same, they must have their eyes on those women, but we have to do it first." the fatty guy replied.
If they didn't need this scared guy for sneaking past, they wouldn't have brought him.
Climbing the stairs silently, the four men paused and glanced at the scared guy who hesitated then enveloped them all in a blanket.
It completely erased their presence and made them invisible.
This skill had saved the life of the scared guy many times, even when his family got devoured by the mutants, he just sat in the corner crying.
There were three guards stationed near the stairs, they all looked tired after staying up the whole night.
And were probably about to change shift with others.
The group of five sneaked up the floor, only stopping before one of the two doors.
"They should be inside." the sub leader spoke, there were only two occupied rooms.

"Whoa, so all seven of those women belong to that one guy?!!

chapters.title: Chapter 667 Sick?
paragraphs: "Oh, you want us to do what?" Maeve asked, her voice intoxicating the four men.
"Hahaha, hurry up and help us kill those two men, then we will decide what to do later." Fatty was the one to speak.
While the two basket guys and the scared guy looked at him in awe, his superpower was so powerful.
He could literally make an army of women who followed all his commands, they felt a bit envious.
But thankfully, they still had a chance with these most beautiful women.
"Kill them? Sure." Maeve nodded, her face blank as she pointed her hand forward.
WHOOSH
Two shadow spikes rose from the ground all of a sudden, piercing through the chests of the two unsuspecting basket men.
UGHHHH COUGH
They both coughed out blood, their bodies pinned against the wall. But the injury was not lethal enough to kill them instantly, as they looked in shock at Fatty.
He must be the reason why she suddenly attacked them.
"W- What are you doing? I didn't mean them, damnit, guys it was a mistake. Wait, you won't die, there is a healer below-" while speaking Fatty hurriedly walked towards them.
Seeing their big wounds, his face turned pale; after fleeing from this place, they still needed to depend on each other.
'Or wait, if they really die, I can have all the women to myself and make them protect me outside!' his evil mind instantly filled with wretched ideas, as a smile appeared.
"Keke, you know what, forget it, it's too late to save you now. So I will be kind enough to kill you swiftly." Folding his hands over his chest, Fatty laughed.
The scared guy had again covered himself with the blanket, but had no strength in his legs to run.
"Finish it!" Fatty spoke, frowning as he couldn't find the scared guy.
"Alright." Maeve nodded, and then another two spikes rose from the ground.
KCCH
They pierced through the bellies of Fatty and the scared guy, pinning them to the wall as their painful wails filled the corridor.
"Urrrk COUGH COUGH Aaaaaah it hurts, damnit what d- did you do?!! I asked COUGH to k- kill them, not me ahhhhh so much b- blood..." Fatty screamed as a pool of blood formed under their feet.
"Oops, my bad." Maeve said, removing the spikes as their bodies fell limply, writhing in pain trying to stop the bleeding.
Their internal organs were damaged too.
"S- Shit, I didn't COUGH ask y- you to do that-" Fatty cried out, wondering why she was not following his commands properly.
"Oh, my bad again." Maeve said, and again four spikes rose, pinning them to the wall, piercing yet another hole.
The screams of the four men startled the guards and people below as they ran up.
The fog subsided and then the figures of two men were revealed.
Vritra just stood there, hands resting in his pockets while the arrogant subleader lay in a pool of his own blood.
There were countless holes in his body, and a dreadful expression, his body still trembling in pain.
Vritra frowned as he looked at the pinned guys, he knew with the beauty of his women, it would attract a lot of unnecessary attention.
But that didn't mean they needed to restrict themselves, with him here, he would torture any man to death who even thought of trying anything.
And these people had tried.
"You want to hypnotize my wife?" his gaze narrowed at Fatty as he instantly felt a piercing pain in his brain.
He screamed, feeling like nails were getting hammered in, and it was just a gaze.
"W- What is going on?"
"Call Ming and Ergen here." Vritra said, pulling out a machete from his inventory and walking towards the four men.
"Y- Yes sir!!" the guard nodded quickly, they were very scared by the sight and fled quickly.
The scared guy was crying and pleading for help, begging for forgiveness, but it was all too late.
His fate was sealed the moment he agreed to this plan.
Amidst the loud screams of the five, the terrified Ming and Ergen arrived, they too were shivering.
Only a few of them knew Vritra's true strength, even if all of them attacked him at once, one thought alone could kill them all.
"S- Sir, forgive us, it is our mistake!" right after arriving they knelt, striking their heads against the ground.
The five dead bodies were torn apart in a brutal manner, the upper halves of four were still stuck to the wall though.
"Did I not tell you clearly enough that I don't want any sort of problem from your men?" Vritra asked, as he pointed the machete at them, splashing blood onto their bodies.
"S- Sorry, we didn't know they could try something like that SOB everyone was behaving well a- and..."
"Enough, I am in no mood to hear your excuses." Vritra interrupted, he didn't plan on killing over this but wanted to punish them somehow.
His wives had already gone back into the apartment, while Shitless and Onest joined him.
"Pitiful one, leave their punishment to me, I just need to keep them alive right?" Shitless spoke.
"Yeah right, then they will be in your care now." Vritra said, then turned back, entering his apartment.
"Hehe, why don't I test my metal body on you guys? I needed dummies anyway and mugger, you are my servant for a week, let's go to the below floors."
Soon screams filled the lower floors, Ergen with his rubber ability still had it better though.
After proper rest and eating, it was time to continue.
As they found out, this place is far more dangerous than the previous cities.
The nights are especially dangerous, strange mutants lurk over the streets to hunt.
There were various places that Vritra needed to visit in this city like the attribute stone caves, the beast cave and to kill Morgan.
In the end, Onest decided to bring Ming along while Shitless wanted to bring Ergen along, since they could help them with training.
Ergen was the perfect punching bag, while Ming helped with agility.
"We will have to be even more careful from here on out, it would be better if those organizations, the Doctors, the Cinema or others don't target us." Vritra spoke as he got into the carriage.
While helping his wife up, he noticed Yasmine's expression appeared a bit different.
"Wifey, is everything okay?" he asked, taking her hand and gently pulling her in.
"Yes, I just- maybe it's motion sickness, I feel a bit sick suddenly, but it's nothing serious." She replied, before smiling sweetly, not wanting him to be too concerned.
"Let me see." Diana said, taking her hand.
Now that she had become a healer, and from her past knowledge as one of the best potion masters, she possessed a thorough understanding of the human body.
Yasmine sat down and extended her arm, as the goddess tested her pulse and with her ability scanned her body.
Her expression changed to confusion, making Vritra concerned, then it changed to surprise.
"Uhm she isn't sick..." the goddess spoke slowly, pausing at the end.
"That's good then, I guess it's just momentary because of motion sickness, though as a dragon, I don't think you would have it." Vritra said.
"Yes, it's not motion sickness either..." Diana interrupted, as they looked at her in confusion.
"Actually, she is pregnant!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 668 Uncle's Protection!!
paragraphs: "Actually, she is pregnant!!" Diana suddenly spoke, as stunned silence filled the carriage.
"W- What...? Pregnant?!" Yasmine was surprised as well, for a few moments unable to react.
But as these words registered, everyone exclaimed in happiness.
Joy surged into the dragoness's heart, she is pregnant!!
Finally, she is going to have her hubby's baby, the thought truly shook her mind though she had been trying so hard for it.
Then her gaze moved to Vritra beside her who was still silent, taking his hand, she muttered:
"Hoo Hubby, I am pregnant!"
Vritra stared at her face for a few moments and then a big smile appeared on his face, as he pulled Yasmine into a tight hug.
"Pregnant... s- she is really pregnant?" he mumbled, appearing frozen for a few moments, his brain processing the sudden news.
"My wifey is pregnant?!! We are going to be daddy and mummy!!" Vritra wasn't sure if any news had excited him this much, it felt a bit strange as well.
Having a child is a big responsibility, and a big change in one's life.
Still, Vritra felt immensely happy, he pulled Yasmine out of the carriage, picking her up, his hands wrapped around her waist.
"Thank you, Yasmine, I am truly delighted!! Thank you..." Vritra felt happy, excited and a whole lot of emotions that he couldn't understand.
Yasmine's eyes filled with tears, seeing his reaction made her even happier as she giggled in his arms.
Their hearts were beating rapidly, a vast amount of emotions filling their minds and hearts.
His body felt hotter, he felt excited enough to keep announcing it loudly but also a bit anxious, it was really... too strange.
The other women also walked out, smiling to see their affectionate display, they all felt very happy.
It was probably the first time they had seen Vritra like that.
Vanessa was also overjoyed, her son is going to be a father, though it made her wonder about the sort of relation she will have with their kid.
Will she be a grandma, or as his wife, just another mummy?
Will she be a grandma, or as his wife, just another mummy?
And age wise, Yasmine is much older than her, but shaking her head she smiled, those things didn't matter.
As the shock subsided, Vritra hugged Yasmine as if to calm his raging emotions.
Then kissing her lips, he looked at her gently, but remembering the sort of place they are at, made him frown.
"What's wrong hubby?" Yasmine was surprised by the shift in his expression, did he not like it?
"It's just that... this place is too dangerous, we can't be sure about our own safety, how am I going to take care of you? Our child..." the thought instantly made Yasmine's smile fade.
Just earlier they almost died in that military base, she has just heard about her pregnancy but already felt so attached to the new life starting to develop in her belly.
She or Vritra would feel broken if anything happened to their child.
'My child...' Vritra looked down and gently touched her belly, his lips curling, it was still hard for him to believe he was going to be a father.
Although his strength has increased by a lot recently, this place was designed to be very deadly for the players, so the dangers he will face will only get more deadly.
"Well well, am I going to be an uncle? That's... pleasant to hear." Just then Divine's voice sounded in his mind, surprising Vritra.
Right, maybe this guy could help him somehow.
'Divine, is there something you can do?' Vritra asked, hoping for some solution.
"Of course, how can I not protect my sister and my nephew or niece? Just draw the rewards!" he said, sounding quite happy.
He has planned a whole lot and did even more to protect his sisters, to bring them back to life, to make sure in this lifetime they could be happy.
Testing Vritra many times before finally putting his faith in him completely.
Although now he needed to spend too much energy and some of his avatar's remaining life force, it was worth it.
"Oh, okay..." Vritra glanced at his points which were over one hundred thousand.
He needed better rewards, more weapons and if lucky, better ascension paths.
"Wifey, it will be fine, I am just so happy..." he hugged her again, with him around, Vritra didn't want her to worry about their child's safety.
"Mhmm" Yasmine hugged him, sighing, still reeling in the shocking news.
Then the group of women surrounded her, while Shitless and Onest walked up to Vritra.
They had already heard about it.
"Congratulations, pitiful one, I am proud of you, you have grown up." Shitless said, wiping his tears as he patted Vritra's shoulder.
"Congrats, Vritra. We will do our best to help you." Onest said, they were weaker than Vritra but could protect the whole family if the situation arose.
They chatted for a while, the excitement in the family was palpable.
Such grand news called for celebration, so they decided to delay a day and head out later.
He allowed Ming and Ergen to rest too, while moving to the upper floor.
The mood was joyful though everyone was still concerned about the place, but trusted Vritra.
While Yasmine was surrounded by the other women, Vritra walked to the balcony, standing there alone.
He arranged his thoughts, his heartbeat and excitement hadn't calmed yet even after half an hour.
"Use all points and draw rewards for 1,000 points each." Vritra said, putting his faith in Divine.
The only thing making him feel extremely anxious was the danger to the safety of his family, especially Yasmine and the baby.
All the other women weren't jealous but felt motivated to have kids with Vritra as well.
As messages began to flash before his eyes, Vritra suddenly had a lot of questions in his mind.
Like whether her pregnancy time would be the same as normal humans, whether he would have a boy or a girl, skills or things he should know and whatnot.
His mind was too flooded right now, but he was happy, very very happy.
The wheel began to spin in front of him quickly and soon a lot of prizes flashed before him.
[Congratulations, you have obtained the Uncle's protection charm!]
[Congratulations, you have obtained 3 Strength attribute points!]
[Congratulations, you have obtained a spatial whip!]
Lots of messages popped before Vritra, as he came out of his thoughts, he was a bit surprised by the names.
'Uncle's protection? Heh' he chuckled lightly, reading the first name.
There were a few weapons that could fit his family very well, there was even an ascension path.
[You have obtained the Elemental Core Ascension Path!]
"Oh this is made perfectly for Yenni, this is great."
Among his family only a few possessed suitable ascension paths so far.
Vanessa has Mind Eye, Fiona has Flame Body, Yennefer will have the Elemental Core and Shitless possesses Metal Body.
He arranged the weapons, deciding to give which one to whom.
There were a lot of rewards this time and so much food, and other supplies.
After reading through it all, his gaze moved towards the final attribute points part.
If he bought those points with 2,000 each, he would have still gotten over 50.
"Let's see how many I got this time." Rubbing his palm, he checked it.

The other women also walked out, smiling to see their affectionate display, they all felt very happy.
It was probably the first time they had seen Vritra like that.
Vanessa was also overjoyed, her son is going to be a father, though it made her wonder about the sort of relation she will have with their kid.
Will she be a grandma, or as his wife, just another mummy?
Will she be a grandma, or as his wife, just another mummy?
And age wise, Yasmine is much older than her, but shaking her head she smiled, those things didn't matter.
As the shock subsided, Vritra hugged Yasmine as if to calm his raging emotions.
Then kissing her lips, he looked at her gently, but remembering the sort of place they are at, made him frown.
"What's wrong hubby?" Yasmine was surprised by the shift in his expression, did he not like it?
"It's just that... this place is too dangerous, we can't be sure about our own safety, how am I going to take care of you?
Our child..." the thought instantly made Yasmine's smile fade.
Just earlier they almost died in that military base, she has just heard about her pregnancy but already felt so attached to the new life starting to develop in her belly.
She or Vritra would feel broken if anything happened to their child.
'My child...' Vritra looked down and gently touched her belly, his lips curling, it was still hard for him to believe he was going to be a father.
Although his strength has increased by a lot recently, this place was designed to be very deadly for the players, so the dangers he will face will only get more deadly.
"Well well, am I going to be an uncle?
That's... pleasant to hear." Just then Divine's voice sounded in his mind, surprising Vritra.
Right, maybe this guy could help him somehow.
'Divine, is there something you can do?' Vritra asked, hoping for some solution.
"Of course, how can I not protect my sister and my nephew or niece?
Just draw the rewards!" he said, sounding quite happy.
He has planned a whole lot and did even more to protect his sisters, to bring them back to life, to make sure in this lifetime they could be happy.
Testing Vritra many times before finally putting his faith in him completely.
Although now he needed to spend too much energy and some of his avatar's remaining life force, it was worth it.
"Oh, okay..." Vritra glanced at his points which were over one hundred thousand.
He needed better rewards, more weapons and if lucky, better ascension paths.
"Wifey, it will be fine, I am just so happy..." he hugged her again, with him around, Vritra didn't want her to worry about their child's safety.
"Mhmm" Yasmine hugged him, sighing, still reeling in the shocking news.
Then the group of women surrounded her, while Shitless and Onest walked up to Vritra.
They had already heard about it.
"Congratulations, pitiful one, I am proud of you, you have grown up." Shitless said, wiping his tears as he patted Vritra's shoulder.
"Congrats, Vritra.
We will do our best to help you." Onest said, they were weaker than Vritra but could protect the whole family if the situation arose.
They chatted for a while, the excitement in the family was palpable.
Such grand news called for celebration, so they decided to delay a day and head out later.
He allowed Ming and Ergen to rest too, while moving to the upper floor.
The mood was joyful though everyone was still concerned about the place, but trusted Vritra.
While Yasmine was surrounded by the other women, Vritra walked to the balcony, standing there alone.
He arranged his thoughts, his heartbeat and excitement hadn't calmed yet even after half an hour.
"Use all points and draw rewards for 1,000 points each." Vritra said, putting his faith in Divine.
The only thing making him feel extremely anxious was the danger to the safety of his family, especially Yasmine and the baby.
All the other women weren't jealous but felt motivated to have kids with Vritra as well.
As messages began to flash before his eyes, Vritra suddenly had a lot of questions in his mind.
Like whether her pregnancy time would be the same as normal humans, whether he would have a boy or a girl, skills or things he should know and whatnot.
His mind was too flooded right now, but he was happy, very very happy.
The wheel began to spin in front of him quickly and soon a lot of prizes flashed before him.
[Congratulations, you have obtained the Uncle's protection charm!]
[Congratulations, you have obtained 3 Strength attribute points!]
[Congratulations, you have obtained a spatial whip!]
Lots of messages popped before Vritra, as he came out of his thoughts, he was a bit surprised by the names.
'Uncle's protection?
Heh' he chuckled lightly, reading the first name.
There were a few weapons that could fit his family very well, there was even an ascension path.
[You have obtained the Elemental Core Ascension Path!]
"Oh this is made perfectly for Yenni, this is great."
Among his family only a few possessed suitable ascension paths so far.
Vanessa has Mind Eye, Fiona has Flame Body, Yennefer will have the Elemental Core and Shitless possesses Metal Body.
He arranged the weapons, deciding to give which one to whom.
There were a lot of rewards this time and so much food, and other supplies.
After reading through it all, his gaze moved towards the final attribute points part.
If he bought those points with 2,000 each, he would have still gotten over 50.
"Let's see how many I got this time." Rubbing his palm, he checked it.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 The celebration
paragraphs: Standing on the balcony, Vritra gazed at the rewards he got from all 101 of the draws.
[14 Strength, 20 Agility, 18 Endurance, 20 Spiritual, 16 Free Attribute Points]
"Not bad, that's a lot of attribute points, I wonder if there will be more evolution after 200 points." Vritra spoke to himself.
[Stats]
(Strength: 146)
(Agility: 153)
(Endurance: 148)
(Spiritual: 202)
{Free Attribute: 16}
{Sin Points: 676}
'I guess no evolution at 200 points, anyway my Spiritual attribute is already over 200.' The battle ahead would be very dangerous, so he would need all the strength he could get.
Especially now to protect the dragoness.
Then walking back, he joined his wives in the celebration, as lots of dishes were arranged.
"Wifey, this is for you from your brother." Vritra said as he handed over a simple-looking paper with strange patterns over it.
"Divine?" With a surprised look she took the paper as it instantly turned into ashes and faded.
"Huh? Did it work?" Yasmine couldn't feel any sort of change.
"It should have..." Vritra replied, not sure himself.
"Of course it did work, try pricking her skin with a pin or something." Divine said suddenly.
Frowning, Vritra first told her about it and Yasmine asked him to try it too.
So taking out a knife, he tried pricking her skin but just as the knife got closer, sparks flew around and a barrier appeared.
Instantly, Yasmine disappeared and teleported to stand right behind Vritra.
"Oh!"
"Told you, no matter what, you can leave her safety to that charm. Nothing on that planet can harm her." Divine said confidently.
'Thank you.' Vritra said, truly feeling grateful.
It really calmed them, with the safety of Yasmine and their child confirmed, they could continue to progress without any headache.
And now Vritra was even more motivated to finish this game as soon as possible, he didn't want Yasmine to give birth here after all.
"Wifey, how long will it take?" Vritra asked, gently caressing her cheek.
"As a dragon, it should take around a year, it isn't much different from humans, just a bit longer." She replied.
'One year... we will have to beat the players and this game before that then.' He thought.
Then he handed over the weapons he had just got.
Vritra had the spear and the others didn't really suit him, though he kept some just in case of emergency.
"Yenni, this is for you." Then he handed over the Elemental Core Ascension Path to Yennefer.
"Thank you husband." The empress said, looking at him passionately.
She too wanted to have a child with him as soon as possible, and experience the same joy as Yasmine.
It wasn't just her who looked at Vritra like that, even Vanessa wanted it.
Divine looked at them celebrating the event then he closed the scene before him and looked in a different direction.
"Can't wait any longer huh, guess things are about to get interesting." Stretching his arms, Divine got up.
He wasn't really surprised to see her go, he was instead surprised she had managed to hold back for so long.
"Looks like it is time to go out, haa so tiring to stay cooped up here." He walked in the endless white, a big smile stretching over his face.
He wondered how those gods were going to react when their well-planned game and all the hard work would go down the drain.
The god which got the Zoratian planet involved must have not known or probably didn't care that there existed the successor of the Divine.
Too bad, after things blow up, those gods would be in trouble as well.
Suddenly a door flashed open in front of Divine, stepping through it he disappeared.
After a whole day had passed, the sun had just gotten up, Vritra and the group were already ready to leave.
"Heh you must be happy that you are going to meet your beloved wife again." Ergen mocked.
"Tsk I would rather just have stayed here sigh..." Ming massaged his forehead, it was indeed a mistake to marry that sort of woman.
Initially he was thrilled by the sheer fact that he cucked Ergen, after this guy did so much for her, he was the one to take her.
But when he found himself on the receiving end of his wife's betrayal, only regret and an eternal enemy were left.
BANG
"Let's go, slaves." Shitless hit them with a whip, making the two jump in fright.
"Slaves don't talk until their great owner allows it, did you ask me before talking?" he shouted.
"M- Master, can we talk then?" Ergen asked, thankfully he didn't feel as much pain because of his ability.
"Hmph you dare question me?! You are asking for a beating!!" Shitless hit them again, making them cry in pain.
He laughed maniacally all the while, he was so into it.
While the two cursed him internally, wasn't he the one who asked them to question first?
'This Baldy bastard, he just beats us up at everything. And what even is he? Why is he red and so... ugly?'
"What? Why do you look at me as if I am something disgusting?" Shitless said, whipping out again.
"Alright time to leave." Vritra interrupted them as he climbed into his carriage.
Vritra lay in Teresa's lap, as the shy goth mommy fed him snacks and kissed him to fill his mouth with sweetness every now and then.
The carriage moved forward quickly with Ming and Ergen leading them forward.
From what he had heard, the glasses organization, which Ming was part of, had a cave of attribute stones.
So they planned to go there first, and increase their strength as much as possible before the battle against big groups.
Every now and then mutants ran towards the carriage but they would have their heads blown off.
"How far is their base?" Vritra asked.
"He mentioned it was like six or so kilometres, and after the apocalypse this place has grown too big." Maeve replied.
Her shadow ability was also great for sneaking around or hearing things from far away.
"I see." He sat up and looked out the window, the city was in complete ruins.
Buildings lay broken, roads were destroyed, everything covered in snow.
But now it seemed the temperature was dropping gradually, the snowfall had completely stopped.
"Looks like the snow is melting slowly." He muttered.
Then he frowned, instead of going straight according to the map, Ming and Ergen made them turn to take a detour.
"Is there something wrong with this path?" he questioned.
"Yes, Ergen just mentioned this place is marked as a forbidden zone by their groups." The demoness spoke.
She was keeping a close eye on the two guys.
"Hmm after getting more important, we will clear these forbidden zones too." Vritra decided as they continued to march forward.
After travelling a few kilometres and killing a lot of mutants along the way, the two carriages came to a stop.
"Are we there already?" Vritra sat up and looked outside but found the road ahead blocked.
It seemed to be a human-made blockage, and several men were standing there.
"Do they want to take a toll or something? Or want to attack us?" Vritra wondered as he got out of the carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 A Warm Welcome
paragraphs: "S- Sir this is the check post by the Cinema organization, they take food as toll to let people pass through here." Ergen explained.
"How strong is that organization?" Vritra asked, it would be foolish to challenge if the opponents were too strong.
It seemed the closer he moved to the tower, the higher and better the resources.
"The Doctors and the Cinema are the two groups that control Riverdel, it would be better if we don't clash with them." Ming spoke.
Vritra nodded, he too wanted to understand this place better first, before the battles started.
And he didn't lack food so giving away a bit wouldn't hurt.
"They take based on how many people are passing, and they will be inspecting the carriages." Ergen replied.
"Sigh. Alright, let's kill our way past them." Vritra turned to see and found near 20 men present there.
"B- But it might alert that group-"
Ming and Ergen were baffled, but thinking about it, if these guys saw the women in the carriage they would surely cause trouble.
So whether they wanted or not, they had already become enemies with the Cinema organization.
Walking forward, Vritra scanned the area and knew none of them had ascended yet.
"Sorry guys, we will have to pass here a little forcefully. Don't worry, you will be in an eternal peaceful sleep." Vritra muttered, walking closer to the barricade.
"Huh? What the hell is he talk-"
BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM...
One after another, the heads of all of them began to explode.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +92}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +93}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +88}
Quickly, several messages popped up before Vritra as all the headless corpses fell to the ground.
Then he threw away the heavy stones which were blocking the way and instantly sensed the change in the atmosphere.
'This city is really dangerous, we will have to be careful moving forward.' Vritra thought, as he walked back.
"Let's go."
Getting into the carriage, the ride started.
This place was in complete ruins, barely any building could be seen as most lay destroyed.
The place was completely silent, the sound of wolves and carriages ringing far and wide.
"Just two or so kilometres, and we will be at the base of the Glasses." Maeve spoke, she silently covered the two carriages in darkness.
Though it did little to hide their presence.
THUD THUD
Both the carriages suddenly shook and their wheels suddenly submerged into the ground, burying deep.
The wolves almost fell.
"What's wrong now?" Frowning, Vritra and the others got out to see, finding the wheels half buried in the ground.
"The ground isn't even muddy, how did it...?" Yennefer touched the ground around with her feet, finding nothing wrong.
But suddenly, the ground started shaking.
"JUMP!!" Vritra suddenly shouted as he sensed something.
All of them jumped into the air without a second thought, as a layer of blood appeared beneath their feet.
It rose higher into the air, creating some distance.
BOOOOOM!!
The ground buzzed and exploded as a large mouth opened and swallowed the two carriages and all of the wolves at the same time.
It was so large that it could swallow nearly 10 big buildings at once.
'What the hell is even this thing?!!' Vritra was just as baffled as the others, the mutants here were too terrifying.
"T- They got even stronger!! This place is too dangerous, we shouldn't have come here!!" Ming felt like crying, he wanted to run away.
'We still can't kill that thing, the creatures have really evolved to such a degree?!' Vritra frowned, and their means of transport were gone.
The mouth closed and the ground returned to calmness once again, everything looking normal.
"Do we continue on foot now?" Onest looked up, his body still stiff.
"What choice do we have? We can't stay hanging here forever." Vritra said.
"Can't this thing fly? Let's just fly back-"
RIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEEEE
Just then a screech sounded and all eyes moved up in alarm, another shocking sight present right before them.
Hundreds of large mutated bees were flying in the sky, the buzzing making everything around tremble.
'I guess fighting is inevitable here, we just have to be careful when choosing the opponent.'
"Get ready, we will slaughter them all." Pulling out the spear, Vritra took a step forward.
But the queen of the bee group flew forward, its body was half of Vritra's but it possessed such a powerful presence.
'This thing... is dangerous!' a feeling of danger instantly rose in his mind.
They were charging towards them.
The bee was certainly ascended, and was rather high in the chain of evolution.
[Spiritual Burst!!]
Vritra sent a powerful wave of mental energy, with the power of over 200 attribute points, it made dozens of bees explode.
But the queen bee seemed to have gotten really angry by that move, its wings buzzed rapidly.
WHIZZZZZZZZZZZZ
'Physical? No it's a mental attack!' Vritra quickly launched another Spiritual Burst as the bee queen's wings shot white energy towards them.
The mental energies collided in the air, the space buzzing and then the white energy actually won.
This thing must have gotten lucky and had grown its mental power to such an extent, this was bad news.
Vanessa and Yasmine supported Vritra against the battle of mental energies but when the large group of bees attacked at once.
BOOOOM!!
Vritra felt his mind shake with intensity, the entire group was blasted towards the ground.
Thankfully their mental defences were high enough not to be greatly injured by just that.
Though Ergen and Ming were in pretty bad shape.
BAM BAM BAM
They fell to the ground as the bees launched another joint attack, hundreds of wings buzzing at once.
From not too far away, a group of humans was hiding from the group of bees.
It was them that had previously provoked the bees when they tried to break into their home, and were chased all the way here.
"Heh this is perfect, I thought we were done for this time." One man without any nose spoke, he looked like Voldemort.
"Should we leave?" another asked.
Initially they were thirty but more than half had died already and only 8 remained now.
"Nah, I want to see those idiots die, kek hmm those women, they are pretty. Should I save a couple of them?" the noseless guy wondered.
Then pointing his hands towards Vritra, he activated his skill.
Vritra who was about to launch an attack against the bee queen suddenly was surrounded by a dark cloud.
Just then the ground shook, and a bad feeling settled in their hearts.
They were surrounded.
'There are more people here?' Vritra sensed the group, the dark cloud madly consuming his energy.
What a grand welcome...
[Blood Manipulation Activated!!]
Vanessa, Diana and the others were suddenly pulled away, their bodies disappearing high into the sky.
The noseless guy suddenly felt pain in his head, forcing him to stop using his ability.
The dark cloud subsided, and a figure was revealed.
His very body seemed to be made of blood, he didn't look human, but a terrifying mutant entity.
"W- What even is that? Don't tell me they were all mutants!!" the noseless guy was startled, and he turned, fleeing.
[Blood Demon Transformation!!]

This thing must have gotten lucky and had grown its mental power to such an extent, this was bad news.
Vanessa and Yasmine supported Vritra against the battle of mental energies but when the large group of bees attacked at once.
BOOOOM!!
Vritra felt his mind shake with intensity, the entire group was blasted towards the ground.
Thankfully their mental defences were high enough not to be greatly injured by just that.
Though Ergen and Ming were in pretty bad shape.
BAM BAM BAM
They fell to the ground as the bees launched another joint attack, hundreds of wings buzzing at once.
From not too far away, a group of humans was hiding from the group of bees.
It was them that had previously provoked the bees when they tried to break into their home, and were chased all the way here.
"Heh this is perfect, I thought we were done for this time." One man without any nose spoke, he looked like Voldemort.
"Should we leave?" another asked.
Initially they were thirty but more than half had died already and only 8 remained now.
"Nah, I want to see those idiots die, kek hmm those women, they are pretty.
Should I save a couple of them?" the noseless guy wondered.
Then pointing his hands towards Vritra, he activated his skill.
Vritra who was about to launch an attack against the bee queen suddenly was surrounded by a dark cloud.
Just then the ground shook, and a bad feeling settled in their hearts.
They were surrounded.
'There are more people here?' Vritra sensed the group, the dark cloud madly consuming his energy.
What a grand welcome...
[Blood Manipulation Activated!!]
Vanessa, Diana and the others were suddenly pulled away, their bodies disappearing high into the sky.
The noseless guy suddenly felt pain in his head, forcing him to stop using his ability.
The dark cloud subsided, and a figure was revealed.
His very body seemed to be made of blood, he didn't look human, but a terrifying mutant entity.
"W- What even is that?
Don't tell me they were all mutants!!" the noseless guy was startled, and he turned, fleeing.
[Blood Demon Transformation!!]

chapters.title: Chapter 671 Warning!!
paragraphs: [Blood Demon Transformation!!]
Vritra used the transformation for the first time, his body becoming intangible.
He truly looked like a demonic figure. Right at that moment, the ground tore open as the enormous mutant opened its mouth again.
While the bees kept launching mental attacks, Vritra's body just deformed, disappearing completely.
Droplets of blood flew all across the sky, completely engulfing the group of bees.
Each droplet then turned into knives, unaffected by anything.
SWISH SWISH
In the next second, the blood knives began to move at extreme speed, piercing through the bodies of the bees.
The queen kept launching mental attacks but it was of no use, she couldn't even find his real body.
The group of eight humans who were trying to flee suddenly had their feet explode, their bodies falling with a crunching thud.
At the same time, two enormous blood hands appeared, clutching both sides of the mouth of the swallowing mutant.
The hands were nearly as big as its own body. The mutant let out an ear-piercing scream as the blood hands began to rip its mouth apart.
In the Blood Demon Transformation, Vritra's strength had increased way higher than he expected, this was made perfectly for him.
Normally after ascension, people could indeed transform but their bodies didn't transform completely.
It was near impossible to have an ascension path custom built for oneself, so they could only transform their body parts.
Using a certain extent of the power.
The eight humans quickly had their limbs torn before they had a chance to react, their faces full of dread.
The noseless guy regretted not having run away when he had the time, he should have just gone back.
Within a minute, nearly all the bees in the sky were dead, the queen bee still resisting fiercely.
Then launching a powerful mental attack and stopping the knives mere inches from her, she flew away in haste.
On the ground, blood poured out from the sides of the enormous mutant's mouth as the two blood hands kept trying to rip its mouth.
BANG
With a loud bang, the mouth shut and the mutant ran back into the ground.
Vritra didn't chase it, he just wanted to scare the mutant so it would stay in the ground for a while.
His strength was still not enough to kill that big thing.
'Over four hundred bees! Not bad.' He shot after the queen bee but her mental power stopped him from getting closer.
He tried his best to kill it but only managed to injure it.
He sighed in disappointment seeing the queen bee fly away in haste.
Vritra could give it a chase but he might end up running into even more dangerous mutants then, so it was better not to.
Though now he would have to be careful, it seemed the queen bee wouldn't let this be the end of the battle.
The blood converged and Vritra's real body appeared once again, though he was still in the Blood Demon Transformation.
"It consumed a lot of energy, especially creating those two hands. Hmm it feels there is still so much potential in this ascension path, I will have to understand it better."
As his body returned to normal, the others slowly descended from the sky, a bloody platform under their feet.
[Stats]
(Strength:161)
(Agility:168)
(Endurance:163)
(Spiritual:210)
{Free Attribute:16}
{Sin Points:51,423}
"The sky could be more dangerous than the land, so we will have to cover the remaining distance by walking." Vritra spoke.
But his ability could certainly help them move on the ground too.
[Warning!]
Suddenly, a message flashed before Vritra and the nine others.
They looked at each other in surprise, then more messages flashed.
[An abnormality has been detected inside the game planet!]
[The Administrators will be cleaning all abnormalities.]
"What is this now? Are the gods coming down or something?" Yasmine frowned, her gaze turning to Vritra.
Who looked equally confused, and turned to the only person with answers.
"Divine?"
"Yes?"
BOOM!!
CRACK!!
Vritra was again surprised as he heard the sound of battle from the other side, a really intense battle.
"Can you talk right now?" he questioned.
"Uwaaaaaaaaah M- My heart, give it back!!" a painful voice rang out.
"Yeah I can talk just fine, is it about the message you saw just now?" Divine asked. Vritra imagined him holding someone's heart, then spoke:
"Yes, are we the abnormality? Are the gods coming after us?"
KRRRRRRRR
BANG

"Heh you think those lousy gods can catch a trick of mine so easily? Of course the abnormality isn't you, but some forces out of their control have entered the game." Divine replied, then a tearing sound rang out.
"Who are you even fighting? Anyway, this will affect us too, right? You have any plans for this?" Vritra asked, sighing.
This guy was still as mysterious as ever, what forces could be out of the gods' control.

"Of course, it will affect you, those people specifically entered to kill you after all. Remember that World Bank? It is the protector of that place who breached into this place to catch you." Divine answered, as various screams rang out.
He didn't answer the first question.
Vritra: "..."
Even though it was his stupidity that he played around with the bomb, he couldn't even remember why he did that.
It was just like how he threw away the love pill without any thought, like he was guided by some unknown force.
Though it helped Yennefer, Vritra wondered what happened with the rest of the pill.
Unknown to him, when those protectors of the World Bank had broken into this planet, an additional figure had sneaked in.
"So... what are we supposed to do now?" he asked, it was already so troublesome to fight the mutants, humans and players.
Since they had started so late.
"Just try to reach the tower as before, what's there to worry about?" Divine replied.
"..." Vritra felt like punching him, he was returning to his shitty personality.

"Alright alright, stop murdering me in your thoughts. Their aim should be to capture you, as long as you are careful, you will be fine. Also be careful of the Administrators, they work under the gods." Then he went silent.
Vritra massaged his temple, suddenly the game's difficulty had risen to near impossible.
"The situation is kinda fucked..." sighing, he explained it to the others, their expressions turning grim too.
"How could... how could we be stupid enough to sacrifice ourselves to protect that jerk?" Yasmine cursed.
Teresa too had a frown, though she didn't curse out loud.
"Let's keep moving, we just have to be careful of the protectors and administrators while fighting against the humans, mutants and players, pretty simple." Vritra spoke.
Landing on the ground, a cart with big wheels made of blood appeared.
His control was way better now, so this was no problem.
On the same planet, a woman with blonde hair appeared, sneaking into the game.
Her face was emotionless as she looked around and soon set her sight on a figure very very far away.
Instantly her expression changed, a strange look appearing in her eyes, almost appearing crazed.
"Finally!! I have found you, my love~"

chapters.title: Chapter 672 The Glasses
paragraphs: "Sir, that is the Glasses base." Ming spoke, he really didn't want to return there.
"I see, if we go there, will those people cause trouble for us? What type of person is your leader?" Vritra asked.
"There might be a few, in the apocalypse, a lot of humans have turned into devils after all." Ming said, then added:
"As for my leader, he isn't excessively bad and is smart, I will explain things to him so he should make the right decision." Ming said.
"Hmph. Let's just go in and take over this place, with our strength what can they even do?" Shitless said, he seemed more arrogant after getting two slaves.
Now there were a lot of things to consider with the addition of those protectors, and who knows, there might be players here.
"Bring us in, and Shitless, enough playing around." He said sternly.
"Oh hehe okay, it was fun." He laughed, putting the whip into his pocket.
They walked towards the base of the Glasses organization which seemed to be a college, its walls were properly defended.
"Stop right there!! Identify yourselves!!" there were over fifty guards standing over the wall.
This base sure had a lot of people.
"I- I am a member of the Glasses, these people are with me!! We need to meet the boss." Ming shouted.
"Ming? The guy with a famous wife?" one of the guards seemed to recognize him.
"Y- Yes, that I am." Ming nodded quickly, with an embarrassed look.
The guards suddenly started to laugh, then the door opened as a few of them walked out.
"Who are these people? Why are they he-" they paused upon seeing the beautiful women.
In a world where the women were already so few, there were such beautiful ones?
They stared in a trance, like everyone else they had the same reaction.
Vritra sighed, taking a step forward and spoke: "I need to talk with your leader about some important stuff."
"Oh and what could that be?" one of the guards shook his head and looked at Vritra threateningly.
"I heard you people have an attribute mine here, I want to borrow it for a while." Vritra spoke, his expression remaining the same.
"Wha- pfft hahahaha brothers did you hear that? He wants to borrow our mine? Haha Ming, is that why you came here?" the guards laughed before their expressions turned dangerous.
Vritra was about to speak but suddenly he felt a chill run down his spine, he quickly looked up and around.
But there was no one around, just now he definitely felt a piercing gaze.
There was no killing intent but the sheer intensity made him feel goosebumps.
'Am I imagining things? It must be so, right? Right?' he hoped.
"Ahem. Anyway, let's not waste our time and words here, how about you just let me meet your leader?" Vritra asked.

"Heh you believe anyone can meet our leader? This punk, just because he is handsome, he is getting too cocky!! Shall we break your legs in front of these pretty ladies?" the guards felt braver in front of the group of women.
They had an urge to defeat Vritra and gain their interest.
'Sigh if the sin system was still working like before, I would be earning a shit ton of sin points.' Vritra thought, he really didn't want to fight the entire base.
But upon thinking, it would be inevitable as he needed their attribute mine.
No one would give that up.
"Shitless, Onest, take care of them. We are going in." Vritra said, as he took Yasmine's and Yennefer's hands before walking forward.
"Are you hungry?" looking at the dragoness he asked.
"No," she replied, while observing the base.
Shitless transformed into a metal man while Onest, the greatest thief, dashed forward.
The guards were startled and were about to use their abilities.
But right then, Teresa captured them into cuboidal rooms, making them freeze completely.
The group walked inside as Shitless and Onest left all the guards unconscious.
Their entrance was quite grand, more and more people began to charge outside.
Yasmine sent weak spiritual bursts, making all of them faint.
While Vanessa used her ability to trap people into mental illusions, stopping them far away.
Yennefer, Fiona, Diana and Maeve couldn't do much, or they might end up killing the people.
Waves of people lay unconscious over the ground as just ten of them made their way inside.
Ming and Ergen were terrified, as they silently followed behind.
"Who is there?!!" a loud voice sounded as a bulky guy rushed out, charging straight towards Vritra.
"Is he the leader?" Vritra asked, pointing a finger as a blood rope suddenly grabbed the guy.
"N- No, that's the vice leader." Ming replied fearfully.
"I see, useless." Vritra just tossed him away, and continued to walk forward.
This college was quite big, there were hundreds of people in this place. Though most of them remained hidden in fear.
"Who are you?" a person floating in the air suddenly appeared above them.
Rather than floating he seemed to be standing over something invisible.
"You are Glass?" Vritra asked, the name of the leader was strangely 'Glass'.
"Yes, why have you come here? Do you want to challenge me and take over this base?" Glass asked, he looked like a rather plain college student with thick glasses over his eyes.
No wonder he got that name.
"Oh no no, we aren't evil people. We don't do any of that stuff, we are here for a simple matter." Vritra shook his head.
Sigh...
Glass heaved a sigh of relief, looking around he noticed that all the people were still alive.
So these guys were really not bad, not the thieves like the ones who had attacked before.
"Alright, then what is it?" he asked, thinking if they wanted some sort of cooperation, he relaxed.
"We just need to borrow your attribute mine for a while and you can also give us any attribute stones you collected from it, that's it." Vritra said nonchalantly.
"Oh just borrow- what?" Glass was baffled by the level of shamelessness, he was literally asking for their best resource.
"Uhm since you aren't here to steal and aren't bad people, then I have the freedom to refuse right? Are there any consequences?" Glass asked, since there was no way he could give away the mine.

"Of course you are free to refuse, like I said, we aren't here to steal. I just need to borrow it for a while, and as for consequences, there are none. Just say no and we will leave." Vritra said, smiling with honesty.
"..." Glass frowned, were there really such good people? Maybe the world really hadn't sunk into a hellhole yet.
"Yea, sorry I really can- umph" as he tried to speak, Glass's lips were suddenly sealed tight.
"You really can... let us borrow? Then thank you very much, can we borrow it for more than a day?" Vritra asked.
"Hmmm Umph!!" He shook his head, unable to speak or even use his ability somehow.
"Ah so just one day? Well that's fine too, thank you, you are a good guy." Vritra said, then gestured for Vanessa to extract info about the mine.
Their group's strength was enough to subdue organization like this.
'T- This guy is a devil...' Ming and Ergen both hugged each other, cursing their luck to have met this devil.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 An Independent Woman
paragraphs: After subduing Glass, Vanessa used her ability to control their leader and find the location of the Attribute Mine.
"Honey, I found it." After a few moments she replied, then added: "It is the mine for Flame Stones."
"Oh, so aside from attribute stones, there could also be other ones."
It was a pity but the value of these stones would be less than the Attribute Stones.
And not everyone in his family would be able to use them, but Fiona, Yasmine, Yennefer and he himself could.
"I guess that is fine too, shall we go and take over the mine for just a day." Vritra said, looking at Glass's leader who still looked very upset.
'Sigh at least they aren't killing any of us, and it is just borrowing for one day. My strength isn't enough so I will have to take the loss this time.' Glass thought.
And he stopped struggling.
It was just one day so he wasn't too worried.
"Let's go." Vanessa said and led the group away.
Shitless and Onest stayed back to keep watch, this mine was of no use to them anyway.
The mine was actually situated near the centre of the college, inside the main building.
Upon entering the main building, Vritra could sense many people who were hidden in the rooms.
"So this is the mine." Stopping before a glowing hole in the ground, Vritra directly jumped inside.
A few people were still working inside and were startled when several people appeared.
"W- Who are you?!!" they exclaimed, pointing their excavating tools at the intruders.
"We made a deal with your captain, so for one day we will be taking over this mine." Vritra said, without wasting any time he directly moved all the workers outside.
Then he looked at the glowing red stones that were embedded in the walls.
Getting these stones would be a bit difficult since the walls were made of stone, unlike the dust ones back then.
'If only I had my dust ability...' Vritra sighed then looked back.
"Shall we get to work then?"
"Yes!" the women exclaimed, and all of them got to work.
Vritra, Yasmine, Yennefer and Fiona were directly devouring the stones while the others just collected them for them.
If the people outside were to see this scene they would be baffled.
Normally, if people tried to devour the entire stone they would be seriously injured.
They absorbed the energy inside slowly while Vritra and others directly devoured all the energy.
It was no surprise though, they were demi gods even if all their strength and abilities were locked away.
The players also shared this benefit.
Quickly, they began to break the walls with sheer strength and pull out the stones.
The mine was filled with their chatter and the sound of stones breaking.
Shitless and Onest too joined soon after to help them and then left to keep watch outside.
Without any rest, the group continued to work the entire day.
They even took the stones that had already been excavated and were stored away.
Glass sat outside sighing, nearly a day had passed but there was no sign of any of them.
'I wonder if he is going to stay inside for more than a day, what can I even do?' Glass sighed.
He glared at Ming who had brought this abomination here.
How could this guy be so strong though?
Glass had fought against other groups, he was rather a good-natured guy and took proper care of his base.
But most organizations were completely different, they kept attacking this base to loot the resources.
To steal the women.
'Sigh I hope no one attacks at a time like this, we are all in no position to fight.' Glass thought, he didn't believe Vritra would help him.
A few minutes before the promised day was over, Vritra and the others walked out of the main building while chatting normally.
'T- They really... came out!!' Glass exclaimed and sighed in relief.
Those stones were important to fight against other groups.
"Thank you for your generosity, as promised I came out in a day." Vritra patted Glass's shoulder, smiling.
"You will leave now, right?" the poor leader asked.
"Yes of course, like I mentioned we are good guys. We won't harm any of you for no reason." Vritra reassured, then asked:
"Anyway, how many human scum organizations are there around?"
He needed to earn more shards and increase his attribute points, killing the humans and mutants was the fastest way.
"There are many, why? You want to attack them?" Glass asked, slowly rising to his feet, the blood rope still wrapped around him.
"Yeah, can you explain them all to your underling Ming?" Vritra said, he planned to quickly clear a few weak and medium organizations.
Before facing the powerful ones.
"...Okay" Glass nodded, then looked around and saw Ming standing with Ergen and a woman.
Vritra noticed it too, this woman was wearing rather provocative and revealing clothes, and it was evident how she had survived so far.
"Is she Ming's wife?" he asked.
"Yeah, she keeps a lot of soldiers happy in return for food and other things, well I heard she already had many affairs after her marriage, so it is pretty normal for her." Glass added.
It was better to be single than have such a woman.
"Heh, what a great couple, you two are made for each other." Ergen laughed, thankfully he was saved in time.
"..." Ming's face was bright red with shame and anger.
"What? How dare you? What other choice did I have? I want a life of luxury and in the apocalypse, only by selling myself can I do that." The woman said proudly.
"Shut up, and we are not related anymore. Get away." Ming said, moving away from her.
"Heh, what are you doing my husband. No matter what, I will always be your wife and only love you, no matter how many men use me.
It is just meaningless and emotionless sex, in the end I am only yours." She spoke, trying to hug Ming.
She really believed whatever she was doing was the right way, and how women should be, self-reliant and strong.
"Are you done with your drama? Ming, go talk with Glass." Vritra interrupted.
"Oh!!" the woman's eyes widened as she saw the most handsome guy ever, her body instantly turned excited.
She also saw how powerful he was and must have lots of food, if she could get him, she would be set for life.
"Hey handsome, how about we have a nice and long talk-" she coyly walked forward, leaning forward.
"Get lost!" With a look of disgust, Vritra said.
This sort of woman was too dirty and even if a normal woman were to approach, he wouldn't want her close.
She wanted to keep trying but the glare from seven women not too far away scared her, so she had no choice but to hurriedly move away.
After Ming understood everything, they left the Glass base, moving towards their next target, the Blood Fang.
"Sigh finally they are gone..." Glass sighed in relief and decided to go and check how much they managed to take in a day.
They didn't seem to be carrying anything so he was happy, how much could they have absorbed in just a day?
Though the very near future was going to be too hard on his heart.
