chapters.title: Chapter 674 Meaaatttttt!!
paragraphs: BOOOOOM
An army of giant crabs were blasted away by a powerful explosion, their bodies ripped to pieces.
A man stood above a one-floor building, his right hand raised slightly. Wherever he pointed, destruction would ensue.
Several other men stood not too far away from him, looking at him in awe, respect, and fear.
"Denir is so powerful, we have been following him since the beginning but how come the gap between us keeps growing?" one of the men mumbled.
"Why don't you go ahead and ask him?" the others chuckled, making the first man shiver.
Not too far away stood a guy with lots of wounds on his body, one of his eyes was completely gone while the other still looked wounded.
It was surprising he was still alive with all those wounds.
Morgan, the player who fought against Vritra previously, observed Denir's fighting prowess.
He too was surprised that despite not being a player, he had grown to such an extent, his ability was very powerful too.
'Maybe these are the dangers gods have arranged for us, just like that guy and the forbidden zones.' Remembering Vritra, a shiver ran down his spine.
That sight was so terrifying, his blood ran cold just thinking of it.
But it was fine now, before he found the other players, he would use Denir to kill that guy and get the treasure from the beast cave.
"Great job, Denir, with my skill I can help you grow even stronger, even faster!" clapping, he stepped forward.
"Can you? But I don't trust you, and you have to prove your worth with a battle." After speaking, he pointed his hand towards Morgan who turned pale.
But then a grin appeared on his face, as if he had expected it and everything was consumed by chaos.
Vritra and his group were moving over the blood cart, it was a pity the wolves and the carriages were gone.
He swore to kill that mutant.
"You are not uncomfortable, right?" he asked.
Honestly, he just wanted to return home as soon as possible so Yasmine could get proper rest and wouldn't have to be in danger.
For now, moving around and fighting was no problem, but soon things wouldn't stay the same.
"Yes hubby, I am fine." She replied, it was still hard for her to believe she was pregnant.
This was certainly not a good time or place to be pregnant though.
"Our next target is the Blood Fang, I heard the leader there also awakened some blood-related skill and went crazy." Maeve spoke.
"Then dealing with him shouldn't be too difficult." Vritra added.
BOOM
Any mutant that approached them instantly exploded in a bloody mist.
Vritra stared at the sky, the weather seemed hotter now, more and more snow was starting to melt.
Maybe once all the snow was gone, moving around wouldn't be so difficult.
But that went for mutants too.
His thoughts quickly changed as he wondered if he would have a son or a daughter and he began to decide names.
Thinking of this he couldn't help but turn to face Yasmine and give the dragoness a gentle kiss on her forehead.
She was surprised but smiled upon receiving his gentle love-filled kiss.
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
Right at that moment, something exploded in the distance creating a big mushroom of smoke.
For a moment, Vritra felt a strange gaze on him, a gaze that seemed to devour him whole.
More intense than anything.
But it disappeared quickly.
'What's going on? Did I get discovered already?' he wondered and increased the speed.
He didn't want to be discovered by the Administrators or the protectors of the World Bank.
Unfortunately, or maybe fortunately, the first to discover him was a woman who had known him from way before his birth.
The person who alerted the laws and made him arrive on the Zoratian planet.
The same one who gave him Mutamorphis, Divine's abilities, the Mythic Halos and whatnot.
His secret sugar mommy, who was a bit crazy.
Maybe crazy just for him.
Over the years, the number of rules she had broken was astronomical, she even formed a deal with the Divine who was hated by all the gods and higher beings.
If her family or others were to find out, she would be in great trouble but she took the risk again just to come here.
And went out of her way to make sure Vritra could become a Titan.
The same blonde and unbelievably beautiful woman, someone so ethereal that she could match Teresa, floated above the mushroom cloud.
It all began with that love pill, she had lived with him for years even before he came into existence.
It was her current self that gave Divine that love pill and he influenced Vritra to just throw it away.
The bigger piece had travelled through space and time and ended up with her past self many, many years back.
In her most vulnerable moment.
Therefore, it was confusing to know if her love was initiated with the pill or she gave the pill because of her already obsessive love.
'Just a bit more... My love, you shall be with me very soon, then you will be mine, just mine!' her gaze lingered on him before her body disappeared.
She felt incredibly jealous of all the women around him, but she didn't really mind them.
Otherwise, they would have never gotten close to him.
Not to mention, each of his women had a bigger role later on in his life, which was why exactly those women were able to get close to him.
Unaware of the presence of the crazy lovesick woman, Vritra and the others had quickly arrived at Blood Fang's base.
They had to kill many mutants along the way, thankfully they didn't encounter anything way too powerful.
"These pieces of shit, they are so disgusting!!" Yennefer cursed, as the group broke into the base of Blood Fang.
The sight of the victims could easily make one vomit, so many had died and the ground was covered with blood all over.
"Huuuuuuh? Who goes there huuuuh?" a strange sound reverberated, then a mutant-like man walked out of a building.
He held a torn human arm and was chewing on the raw meat.
Cannibalism, this pig was eating his own kind with such cruelty.
Vritra didn't consider himself a good guy, not completely, but there were lines that he could never cross.
"Ohhhhh Meaaatttttttt are you here for me uhahahaha." Even his way of speaking was so strange, he really had turned into a strange mutant.
In the entire base, no one worked under this guy, as he had turned everyone into victims.
As he went mad, those following him were the first to become his victims.
"Woommeeeennn meat meat meat!! Give me alllllll meaattttttttt!! Sooffffttttt meakkkkkk." Throwing away the limb, he clapped and ran towards the group.
"You like eating meat that much huh, then here is a great treat for you!!" Vanessa stepped forward, her eyes glowing.
Instantly, the leader of Blood Fang was trapped in a strange illusion, he screamed and cried for a while.
Then began to munch over his own flesh, tearing the meat of his arms, then feet, shoulders and everywhere his mouth could reach.
"This guy sure is flexible..."
Ergen tried to lighten the mood as the leader bent and ate his own manhood.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 Speedster
paragraphs: The leader was crying out in pain and enjoying eating meat at the same time, it was a very strange scene.
Yasmine and the others just turned their gazes away, but the painful wails sure were satisfying.
Vritra looked around, he was here to slaughter the human scum but only found one.
What a pity, truly.
All the sin points were just gone, all because of this cannibal pig.
He waited until the pig had eaten most of his own body and finally made his head explode.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +2,924}
'Hmm not bad I guess, looks like he was close to ascension.'
He scanned the place and found no one else alive, not even the victims, they had all already been killed.
The group sighed collectively, all these poor people were suffering for no reason.
'Divine mentioned the gods are only controlling the games, it is put to enjoy for higher beings, looks like they are even shittier.' Vritra thought.
"Heh right, they are such evil people, if you were to ever meet one don't hesitate and attack." Just then Divine's voice sounded, from the tone it was obvious he was joking.
Ignoring him, Vritra turned and walked out.
He glanced at his status panel, upgraded after killing many mutants on their way here.
[Stats]
(Strength: 164.3)
(Agility: 172.9)
(Endurance: 167.1)
(Spiritual: 213.2)
{Free Attribute: 16}
{Sin Points: 63,350}
"Shall I draw rewards again?" he wondered and decided to do it.
Even if he used 1,000-point draws, he would still get 63 rewards.
"Draw 1,000 sin point rewards, use everything." He spoke, as the ethereal wheel began to spin before him rapidly.
[You have obtained 5,000 barrels of Diesel.]
[You have obtained 10,000 packets of instant noodles.]
[You have obtained 4 Agility attribute points.]
Instantly dozens of messages popped before him, as the items got stored into his inventory.
Again there were a few weapons, many attribute points, food and more.
He quickly scanned the list to look if he got any and indeed there was one.
[You have obtained a Shadow Soul Ascension Path!]
"This is for Foxie, hmm I guess I could get ascension paths for everyone with more draws." Vritra then turned to Maeve and gave her the stone.
"We are all very close to ascending." Maeve said, their mutation progress was very close to 100%.
"Hmm, looks like we have to get more ascension paths and find a place for you all to-"
CRACK CRACK
Just then they all heard a cracking sound from the sky, all gazes moved up, as a figure in black stepped out.
'That's... the protector of the World Bank?!' Vritra somewhat recognized those guys, he had briefly seen them before.
'Don't tell me they can use all their strength while we here can't.'
Those people had managed to fool the gods or maybe made some deal, and managed to break into the game.
"Yeah, although they can't go all out but with your current strength, killing them would be impossible." Divine said, he felt quite nice having fought after a very long time.
Maeve moved with haste as the shadows devoured them all, hiding them away.
The protector in the sky looked around, his gaze moving over the base of Blood Fang.
After a few minutes of shrivelling he flew away.
"Sigh the difficulty just keeps rising, let's quickly head to the... hmm Rankers organization." Vritra said.
That wasn't an evil organization but from the information they possessed some mine and had recently found an Ascension Path.
The cart moved away quickly, as the group stayed careful to not be seen.
A few minutes later, as they were crossing a long street, a whip suddenly appeared out of nowhere and hit Shitless in the chest.
BANG
His metallic body was thrown back as a loud sound reverberated, then a mutant was revealed.
It was a zombie with arms several metres long and a very thin body.
"This thing has ascended!" Vritra was a bit surprised, as it didn't seem special.
But as the zombie moved, even Vritra was shocked by its speed, it had turned into a blur.
WHOOSH
Teresa tried to trap it into a room but moving very quickly, it launched an attack straight at her.
BOOM
Using the explosive power, Yasmine blasted the tentacle-like arms away, before launching Spiritual Burst.
They all knew this thing was powerful, with speed being its greatest advantage.
Vritra took out the spear, and tried to use Blood Manipulation only to find there was absolutely no blood in that body.
Not even bones!
Only he could somewhat match that speed, but landing an attack successfully seemed nearly impossible.
He used the boots but now they didn't increase his speed by that much, there seemed to be some cap to their ability.
'No wonder it grew so powerful, its speed is terrifying. And it had to come at the moment when I wanted to pass by quietly sigh.'
BANG BANG
Loud sounds rang out, as Vritra used the spear to dodge the attacks.
It was smart enough to keep targeting the other people, but every time the spear would parry.
[Spiritual Burst!!]
Thankfully, this thing still had a brain, and the shockwave hit it like a running train.
Its quickly moving body lost balance and smashed into the wall.
Vritra moved at full speed, as he stabbed the spear, aiming for the head of the creature.
KRRRRRRRR
But at the last moment, it twisted and blocked the attack with its arm.
SWISH
Still the spear that could cut through anything managed to cleanly cut off the arm, right from the shoulder.
The zombie glared at Vritra before running away, there was not much Vritra could do without creating too much ruckus.
And running behind it was pointless.
'Sigh I really can't calm down, these mutants are growing very quickly. We have to speed up more.'
"Let's continue." Vritra jumped onto the blood cart, and it began to move forward.
Ming and Ergen were pointing directions, but many things had changed since they were here last.
They faced many mutants on their way, thankfully the protector seemed to have already left the area.
"Is Rankers stronger than your group?" Vritra asked, as he heard the distant sound of fighting.
It seemed they weren't the only ones who had this idea of taking the Rankers' treasures.
"More or less, the leader was a bit stronger than Glass, but I don't think you will have any problem." Ming answered.
He was happy to have finally broken things off with that whore of a wife.
'That fire mine yesterday has greatly increased my fire affinity and power, I wonder what mine there will be here.'
Vritra was yet to test the fire ability.
But Yasmine had used it earlier, and it was very powerful.
Killing a few more mutants, they finally arrived outside a tall building which was protected by walls made of grass.
Two groups were attacking the Rankers organization at once, each had over thirty members.
They had arrived in the midst of an interesting battle, and it looked the Rankers might not last long.
"Shall we get involved as well?"
The cart came to a stop behind the two groups and their presence made the battle halt, as everyone turned to look at them.

sentences.text: The leader was crying out in pain and enjoying eating meat at the same time, it was a very strange scene.
Yasmine and the others just turned their gazes away, but the painful wails sure were satisfying.
Vritra looked around, he was here to slaughter the human scum but only found one.
What a pity, truly.
All the sin points were just gone, all because of this cannibal pig.
He waited until the pig had eaten most of his own body and finally made his head explode.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +2,924}
'Hmm not bad I guess, looks like he was close to ascension.'
He scanned the place and found no one else alive, not even the victims, they had all already been killed.
The group sighed collectively, all these poor people were suffering for no reason.
'Divine mentioned the gods are only controlling the games, it is put to enjoy for higher beings, looks like they are even shittier.' Vritra thought.
"Heh right, they are such evil people, if you were to ever meet one don't hesitate and attack." Just then Divine's voice sounded, from the tone it was obvious he was joking.
Ignoring him, Vritra turned and walked out.
He glanced at his status panel, upgraded after killing many mutants on their way here.
[Stats]
(Strength: 164.3)
(Agility: 172.9)
(Endurance: 167.1)
(Spiritual: 213.2)
{Free Attribute: 16}
{Sin Points: 63,350}
"Shall I draw rewards again?" he wondered and decided to do it.
Even if he used 1,000-point draws, he would still get 63 rewards.
"Draw 1,000 sin point rewards, use everything." He spoke, as the ethereal wheel began to spin before him rapidly.
[You have obtained 5,000 barrels of Diesel.]
[You have obtained 10,000 packets of instant noodles.]
[You have obtained 4 Agility attribute points.]
Instantly dozens of messages popped before him, as the items got stored into his inventory.
Again there were a few weapons, many attribute points, food and more.
He quickly scanned the list to look if he got any and indeed there was one.
[You have obtained a Shadow Soul Ascension Path!]
"This is for Foxie, hmm I guess I could get ascension paths for everyone with more draws." Vritra then turned to Maeve and gave her the stone.
"We are all very close to ascending." Maeve said, their mutation progress was very close to 100%.
"Hmm, looks like we have to get more ascension paths and find a place for you all to-"
CRACK CRACK
Just then they all heard a cracking sound from the sky, all gazes moved up, as a figure in black stepped out.
'That's... the protector of the World Bank?!' Vritra somewhat recognized those guys, he had briefly seen them before.
'Don't tell me they can use all their strength while we here can't.'
Those people had managed to fool the gods or maybe made some deal, and managed to break into the game.
"Yeah, although they can't go all out but with your current strength, killing them would be impossible." Divine said, he felt quite nice having fought after a very long time.
Maeve moved with haste as the shadows devoured them all, hiding them away.
The protector in the sky looked around, his gaze moving over the base of Blood Fang.
After a few minutes of shrivelling he flew away.
"Sigh the difficulty just keeps rising, let's quickly head to the... hmm Rankers organization." Vritra said.
That wasn't an evil organization but from the information they possessed some mine and had recently found an Ascension Path.
The cart moved away quickly, as the group stayed careful to not be seen.
A few minutes later, as they were crossing a long street, a whip suddenly appeared out of nowhere and hit Shitless in the chest.
BANG
His metallic body was thrown back as a loud sound reverberated, then a mutant was revealed.
It was a zombie with arms several metres long and a very thin body.
"This thing has ascended!" Vritra was a bit surprised, as it didn't seem special.
But as the zombie moved, even Vritra was shocked by its speed, it had turned into a blur.
WHOOSH
Teresa tried to trap it into a room but moving very quickly, it launched an attack straight at her.
BOOM
Using the explosive power, Yasmine blasted the tentacle-like arms away, before launching Spiritual Burst.
They all knew this thing was powerful, with speed being its greatest advantage.
Vritra took out the spear, and tried to use Blood Manipulation only to find there was absolutely no blood in that body.
Not even bones!
Only he could somewhat match that speed, but landing an attack successfully seemed nearly impossible.
He used the boots but now they didn't increase his speed by that much, there seemed to be some cap to their ability.
'No wonder it grew so powerful, its speed is terrifying.
And it had to come at the moment when I wanted to pass by quietly sigh.'
BANG BANG
Loud sounds rang out, as Vritra used the spear to dodge the attacks.
It was smart enough to keep targeting the other people, but every time the spear would parry.
[Spiritual Burst!!]
Thankfully, this thing still had a brain, and the shockwave hit it like a running train.
Its quickly moving body lost balance and smashed into the wall.
Vritra moved at full speed, as he stabbed the spear, aiming for the head of the creature.
KRRRRRRRR
But at the last moment, it twisted and blocked the attack with its arm.
SWISH
Still the spear that could cut through anything managed to cleanly cut off the arm, right from the shoulder.
The zombie glared at Vritra before running away, there was not much Vritra could do without creating too much ruckus.
And running behind it was pointless.
'Sigh I really can't calm down, these mutants are growing very quickly.
We have to speed up more.'
"Let's continue." Vritra jumped onto the blood cart, and it began to move forward.
Ming and Ergen were pointing directions, but many things had changed since they were here last.
They faced many mutants on their way, thankfully the protector seemed to have already left the area.

It seemed they weren't the only ones who had this idea of taking the Rankers' treasures.
"More or less, the leader was a bit stronger than Glass, but I don't think you will have any problem." Ming answered.

"Shall we get involved as well?"
The cart came to a stop behind the two groups and their presence made the battle halt, as everyone turned to look at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 676 The Healing Stones
paragraphs: The three groups all looked at these twelve new people and wondered if they were here for the treasures as well.
"Who are you? I have never seen you around here- hmm? Glass and Eagle?" the leader of one group narrowed his eyes at Ming and Ergen.
"Do you know anything about these two groups?" Vritra didn't reply, instead asked a question.
"Yes sir, they are pieces of shit so it wouldn't be a problem even if you were to kill them all. While the Rankers are really good people, I would say one of the best in this city." Ergen answered.
Now he wasn't as afraid as before after witnessing Vritra's strength, instead they were starting to enjoy the journey.
"I see, well that's good." Vritra looked at the ground and saw dead bodies of humans and many mutants.
Jumping off the floating cart, he casually walked towards the building then knelt and touched the arm of one corpse, then another and so on...
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a mutant +28}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a mutant +28}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a mutant +26}
Everyone looked at him in confusion, and Vritra only stopped once he had collected all the sin points.
Then he looked into the building where dozens of men and women with injured bodies were defending against the two groups.
"You two, I heard you have kept a lot of slaves, is that true?" Vritra asked, his tall imposing figure making them feel nervous.
"Who the fuck do you think you are? Get lost before we-"
BOOM
Vritra snapped his finger as the head of the loud man exploded, the sight scared everyone else.
"Too noisy, anyway who is the leader?" he then questioned looking at the 1st group.
"Y- You just killed him..." one of the men said fearfully, the scene had turned completely silent.
"Oh, anyway answer my previous question, I need some slaves." He asked lazily.
"Y- Yes, we have a lot of slaves, w- women too. You can have them all-"
BOOM
The speaker from the other group died, his head exploding like a balloon.
"Did I ask you yet, wait for your turn." After speaking he turned to face the 1st group.
"Y- Yes, we have them, a lot of the-"
BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM
One by one the heads of the men began to explode, the others were terrified and tried to flee.
But it was pointless, and soon all more than sixty men lay in a big pool of blood.
The Rankers inside were all scared, their bodies shaking.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +73}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +98}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +102}
"That takes care of it, now among you all, who is the leader of the Rankers?" Vritra asked, throwing away all the blood and corpses.
"..." the group looked dreadfully at one another, afraid that they might have their heads explode just like that.
"I- It is me..." One middle-aged man with a well-built body stepped forward, he used to be a boxer.
But lost his family at the start of the apocalypse, at first he wanted to just die but ended up protecting a few people.
From that moment on, he had been protecting others.
"Hmm do you still have that Ascension Path stone?" Vritra asked.
"Y- Yes sir, I do have it." He sighed internally, so this group was here for that as well.
He just hoped they wouldn't hurt any of them, there was no point in putting up a fight against this man.
"Good, how about you exchange that Ascension Path and the mine with me for food enough to feed everyone here?" Vritra said.
"Oh!" the boxer was surprised, he expected Vritra to just forcefully take away everything, but getting food in return was great.
"A- Alright, how much food you have?" he asked hurriedly.
"How many people you have?" Vritra returned the question.
"Uh O- Over 300, there are kids and old people too." The leader replied, food was very precious now, so it wasn't a bad deal.
"Alright, let's talk inside." Vritra led his family into the building, the boxer was slightly nervous at first but he wouldn't be able to stop them even if he wanted.
Arriving on a top floor, Vritra and the others stood in front of the leader, who took out the Ascension Path stone and handed it to Vritra.
"This thing wasn't suitable for me otherwise I would have already ascended." The leader said.
[Stone of Duality Ascension Path!]
"Hmm?" Vritra couldn't understand its true nature, so he decided to just let his family hold it and see if it resonated with them.
Diana, Yasmine, Teresa and Onest all held it one by one.
The goddess, Teresa and Onest all shook their heads.
"I believe I am compatible with this stone hubby, no it's like perfectly made for me." Yasmine spoke in surprise.
Wasn't this a bit too easy?
"Of course it was easy, I haven't been just lazing around all this time, I have made proper arrangements." Divine spoke suddenly.
'Aren't you speaking too much lately? Anyway, good job, you can subtract one slap from the ones I was going to deliver when meeting you.' Vritra praised.
Now only Teresa, Diana and Onest remained who were yet to get their Ascension Paths.
"Should I put the food here?" Vritra asked, now after checking out the mine, they would be done here.
"But you aren't carrying anything..." the leader looked on in confusion, wondering if he had just been scammed.
But in the next moment, a huge amount of food items appeared out of nowhere.
Water, instant noodles, meat and whatnot, Vritra gave enough to keep them full for at least a year.
As for storage, they could worry about that on their own.
"W- Whoaaaa!!" The leader fell onto his butt, so much food in the apocalypse?
What kind of cheat life was this guy living?
"This should be enough, anyway bring us to the mine now." Vritra interrupted the leader's shock.
"Y- Yes sir, please follow me. It is just in the building opposite to ours, we just found it but someone leaked the news."
The leader became very respectful, as he led them towards the other building which had already been cleared out.
Soon all of them stood under the ground, unfortunately, it wasn't an Attribute Mine either.
This mine seemed to be made especially for the goddess, energy stored in the stones would only benefit her.
Well, it was still good, the stronger the healer of the group the better.
And so, they began to pull out the stones while Diana alone devoured them.
Vritra tried one, and with his Evomorph, he was actually able to absorb it which affected his self-healing ability.
'Great, so it is useful for me too.' Diana wouldn't have been able to use all of them anyway.
Even the two of them wouldn't either, so they just took out a lot of stones and devoured them all.
Leaving more than a quarter behind, they could be used by the Rankers for healing.
Vritra walked out of the building, it was already getting dark so he decided to stay at the Rankers building for now.
He had heard that the mutants at night were especially dangerous, so Vritra wanted to check this out and hunt at night.
"Found you!!" just then a chilling voice sounded from the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 677 The Administrator
paragraphs: "Found you!!" All of a sudden, a chilling voice sounded from the sky.
Vritra's body stiffened, gaze shooting upwards as he saw a man dressed in a black outfit.
It was the protector!
"Vritra Arclis, the one who destroyed a big part of the world bank, it is you!" he continued in a rough voice.
"Oh, I am Adam, you got the wrong person." Vritra spoke, while getting ready to use the Blood Demon Transformation.
That was his current strongest form, but having his power sealed while the opponent could use some of it was cheating.
But during a fight, none of it matters.
Most of the time, his opponents had been out of his league anyway.
"Run!" He shouted and shot in a different direction as the protector suddenly moved.
None of them could react fast enough, thankfully, Vritra seemed to be the sole target.
The group was left behind, all shocked and worried as Vritra and the protector disappeared into the distance.
"L- Let's move to a nearby building first, staying in the open will make us easy targets." Yasmine spoke, her fists clenched.
All of them moved, despite their worries, they couldn't do much about it right now.
Flying some distance away, Vritra paused and turned back, it was impossible to run anyway.
"Just come with me, I am tasked to bring you back so I would prefer not hurting you." The protector said, taking out a round ball like object.
He suddenly threw it towards Vritra which transformed into a big round prison.
But Vritra's body transformed into a flood of blood, flowing in all directions.
[Blood Demon Transformation!]
The prison captured a big amount of that blood but couldn't capture it all, as Vritra's figure materialised.
"I am not going to go back with you, the trial or whatever can wait until I am done with this place." Vritra said, flames bursting out of his fists.
"Is that your choice?" the protector sighed as he put away the prison, metallic chains moving out from under his robe.
"Yeah..." Vritra took out the spear, his senses on high alert.
CLANG
A chain moved abruptly in his direction, almost piercing through his chest but was parried away by the spear.
Vritra's body transformed into a blood pool as he flew forward, while blood exploded around him, stopping the chains.
[Blood Eagles!]
CHIEEEEEEEEE
CHIEEEEEEEEEEE
Several large blood eagles rushed into the protector's direction, while Vritra stabbed the spear forward.
The protector looked on calmly, raising his hand as more and thicker metallic chains rushed out.
Yet at that moment, his expression changed, he looked up suddenly.
BOOOOM
An explosion that sent Vritra flying back suddenly exploded on the protector's body, burying him deep into the ground.
Vritra transitioned between blood state and somehow managed to balance himself.
He looked up quickly and saw a man floating high in the sky, he looked like a normal middle-aged human.
Though Vritra could tell that wasn't his real form, another person had been added to the equation.
"Uh oh, that's one of the administrators, they work right under the gods and maintain order in the game.
You can be exposed, if he sees you." Divine spoke, but he didn't seem in a hurry to help Vritra.
The protector stood up and dusted off his robe, that attack didn't deal much damage, except breaking a few chains.
"Protector, I advise you to leave the game area immediately.
Whatever issues the world bank had, you shall not interfere with the games, the higher beings won't like it."
The administrator spoke, his tone emotionless.
"I just need this one person, and all of us will leave. If we can't capture and bring him back, we would have to face the higher beings, so we don't really have any choice."
The protector said, not backing down.
The administrator's gaze moved towards Vritra who was standing not too far away and a surprised expression appeared on his face.
"Oh hmm? You are?"
"Hello, I am Adam, nice to meet you. Please resolve your issues, I will be taking my leave now." Vritra said, turning and trying to fly away.
"Wait." both the men said at the same time, it seemed escape was impossible.
"Yes?" sighing he turned back and questioned.
"Why do you... have the same code as one of the players? How did you get here? Who are you?" the administrator's brows furrowed as he opened info about Vritra.
"Alright, I need both of you to follow me. We need to detain you and conduct a thorough investigation, but the game shall not be interrupted!" he said firmly.
The protector nodded, floating close to the administrator.
Vritra sighed and nodded as well, his body shooting up.
"Good, don't worry, you will be sent back into the game after we are done with-" the administrator was speaking when suddenly a chain pierced through his back.
His eyes widened, not expecting someone to attack him on their very ground.
Right then, Vritra stabbed the spear, the blade burying into the administrator's heart, and coming out of his back.
After shock, rage filled his eyes, as the administrator coughed out blood, and then blasted them both away.
He tried to contact the other administrators but found that the surroundings had been locked by the protector.
"Looks like I overestimated your intelligence, for this crime, I am allowed to directly execute you both." The administrator spoke calmly.
Vritra and the protector glanced at one another and for now they had the same goal, without a word, both rushed forward.
BOOOOOM
The sky was covered by terrifying flames, as waves of blood flew and collided into the invisible wall.
The administrator defended against the joint attacks, he wondered if he should call the gods or use the gods' punishment.
But seeing the protector and the weak human, he didn't feel the need and began to attack back more aggressively.
The spear and the chains worked in coordination, despite Vritra being the weakest, he was putting great strain on the administrator.
Whenever he was attacked he would dodge or the protector would parry, and that spear actually managed to cut the administrator's body.
'The protector's strength is similar to the administrator, sigh I can't defeat them on my own.'
In a proper fight against them, he would have been killed instantly.
CLANG
A chain blocked another attack that nearly ripped Vritra apart, as he rushed forward and sliced off one of the administrator's arms.
Vritra grabbed the arm, and threw it back towards the administrator.
[Blood Explosion!]
BOOOOM!
The chains struck the administrator at the same time, while he tried to dodge the barrage of attacks.
'This is getting troublesome, I am still unable to contact the others. Looks like I will have to inform the gods directly, this is a serious matter.'
The administrator decided, neither Vritra nor the protector could stop that.
Dodging another attack, he took out an orb and crushed it, as the energy rushed into the sky and disappeared.
A grim expression appeared over the protector's face, if the gods got involved, he wouldn't be able to do anything.
Vritra would most probably be killed and the criminal they needed to arrest would be gone.
Yet there was just no way to stop that message.
"Stop, it is pointless to fight any longer, the gods must have already gotten the message.
You will both receive your punishments." The administrator said calmly.

Yet at that moment, his expression changed, he looked up suddenly.
BOOOOM
An explosion that sent Vritra flying back suddenly exploded on the protector's body, burying him deep into the ground.
Vritra transitioned between blood state and somehow managed to balance himself.
He looked up quickly and saw a man floating high in the sky, he looked like a normal middle-aged human.
Though Vritra could tell that wasn't his real form, another person had been added to the equation.
"Uh oh, that's one of the administrators, they work right under the gods and maintain order in the game.
You can be exposed, if he sees you." Divine spoke, but he didn't seem in a hurry to help Vritra.
The protector stood up and dusted off his robe, that attack didn't deal much damage, except breaking a few chains.
"Protector, I advise you to leave the game area immediately.
Whatever issues the world bank had, you shall not interfere with the games, the higher beings won't like it."
The administrator spoke, his tone emotionless.
"I just need this one person, and all of us will leave.
If we can't capture and bring him back, we would have to face the higher beings, so we don't really have any choice."
The protector said, not backing down.
The administrator's gaze moved towards Vritra who was standing not too far away and a surprised expression appeared on his face.
"Oh hmm?
You are?"
"Hello, I am Adam, nice to meet you.
Please resolve your issues, I will be taking my leave now." Vritra said, turning and trying to fly away.
"Wait." both the men said at the same time, it seemed escape was impossible.
"Yes?" sighing he turned back and questioned.
"Why do you... have the same code as one of the players?
How did you get here?
Who are you?" the administrator's brows furrowed as he opened info about Vritra.
"Alright, I need both of you to follow me.
We need to detain you and conduct a thorough investigation, but the game shall not be interrupted!" he said firmly.
The protector nodded, floating close to the administrator.
Vritra sighed and nodded as well, his body shooting up.
"Good, don't worry, you will be sent back into the game after we are done with-" the administrator was speaking when suddenly a chain pierced through his back.
His eyes widened, not expecting someone to attack him on their very ground.
Right then, Vritra stabbed the spear, the blade burying into the administrator's heart, and coming out of his back.
After shock, rage filled his eyes, as the administrator coughed out blood, and then blasted them both away.
He tried to contact the other administrators but found that the surroundings had been locked by the protector.
"Looks like I overestimated your intelligence, for this crime, I am allowed to directly execute you both." The administrator spoke calmly.
Vritra and the protector glanced at one another and for now they had the same goal, without a word, both rushed forward.
BOOOOOM
The sky was covered by terrifying flames, as waves of blood flew and collided into the invisible wall.
The administrator defended against the joint attacks, he wondered if he should call the gods or use the gods' punishment.
But seeing the protector and the weak human, he didn't feel the need and began to attack back more aggressively.
The spear and the chains worked in coordination, despite Vritra being the weakest, he was putting great strain on the administrator.
Whenever he was attacked he would dodge or the protector would parry, and that spear actually managed to cut the administrator's body.
'The protector's strength is similar to the administrator, sigh I can't defeat them on my own.'
In a proper fight against them, he would have been killed instantly.
CLANG
A chain blocked another attack that nearly ripped Vritra apart, as he rushed forward and sliced off one of the administrator's arms.
Vritra grabbed the arm, and threw it back towards the administrator.
[Blood Explosion!]
BOOOOM!
The chains struck the administrator at the same time, while he tried to dodge the barrage of attacks.
'This is getting troublesome, I am still unable to contact the others.
Looks like I will have to inform the gods directly, this is a serious matter.'
The administrator decided, neither Vritra nor the protector could stop that.
Dodging another attack, he took out an orb and crushed it, as the energy rushed into the sky and disappeared.
A grim expression appeared over the protector's face, if the gods got involved, he wouldn't be able to do anything.
Vritra would most probably be killed and the criminal they needed to arrest would be gone.
Yet there was just no way to stop that message.
"Stop, it is pointless to fight any longer, the gods must have already gotten the message.
You will both receive your punishments." The administrator said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 678 A Crazy Woman
paragraphs: Some distance away, a girl with long blonde hair sat over a cloud, in her hand was a small orb.
It was the message the administrator had sent.
Just a bit longer, and using the chaos the death of an administrator would bring, she would be able to meet him.
Revealing herself would have put Vritra in danger and her family would have found out.
So, she needed to create some chaos first, and what could be more chaotic than the death of an administrator.
"Go ahead my love, kill him, I am here to support you." She muttered, her voice like a spell that could hypnotize anyone.
The crazed look in her intensified as she gazed at Vritra, seeing him fight so fearlessly made her want to pull him into a tight embrace.
Although all those 9 years were just an illusion, a memory that doesn't exist and Vritra isn't even aware of.
But she had spent 9 whole years with him, there were just the two of them.
With her personality, she didn't really like or trust him at first, but when she fell for him, the world became meaningless, she fell hard.
They had spent nearly seven years as husband and wife, although it was not real, but that was exactly how Vritra is in reality.
Just to meet him faster, she had committed too many crimes of the higher being society.
And knowing the rules and regulations, knowing her family, she knew they would never let her be with a normal human.
But none of it mattered, he belonged solely to her, no matter what she would have to do for that.
As for a mere god, what can they even do to him? She would rather kill all ten of the gods overlooking this game.
On the other side, the protector and Vritra looked strangely at the administrator, who floated with confidence.
"How long before your gods appear?" Vritra asked, holding the spear.
He didn't know either what would happen if a god really got involved.
"Hmph Wait, they will be here soon. I don't wish to use the god's punishment upon you two so just wait for the god's decision." The administrator spoke.
A few seconds passed and then a whole minute passed, and the administrator frowned, something was wrong.
At that moment, both Vritra and the protector moved, launching powerful attacks at the frowning administrator.
Caught off guard, several chains pierced through his body and the spear pierced into his forehead.
"Y- You... Don't you fear the god?" even as his brain got destroyed, he glared at the two.
His remaining hand moved as he took out another orb, and Vritra recognised it all too well.
SWISH
He slashed and hurriedly cut off the remaining arm, catching the god's punishment and storing it away.
The two again madly launched attacks upon attacks, riddling his body with holes.
The administrator tried to kill Vritra so many times but even when the protector was away, none of his attacks connected.
'Who is helping him? I have to escape!' finally fear crept into his heart.
Just like the gods, the administrators were greedy beings that move mostly for their profits.
He wouldn't want to die just to capture these guys, so turning around, he tried to flee.
The chains quickly wrapped around him and Vritra slashed off his neck before stabbing the spear into the administrator's energy core.
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
The body of the administrator was torn to pieces, as the sky suddenly brightened, covered by intense violent energy.
Vritra was blasted back along with the protector, as the administrator died.
The blonde sitting not too far away snapped her fingers and destroyed the soul and the secret signal he had sent before his death.
[Congratulations! Special secret task completed!!]
[You have killed an administrator!!]
[You have been rewarded with 100 Strength Attribute points.]
[You have been rewarded with 100 Agility Attribute points.]
[You have been rewarded with 100 Endurance Attribute points.]
[You have been rewarded with 100 Spiritual Attribute points.]
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +1,000,000}
[You have been rewarded with the Infinite Evolution Ascension Path!]
Suddenly, waves of messages flashed before Vritra, as a warmth enveloped him.
His strength rose rapidly, both mind and body relaxed as a powerful wave of energy buzzed around him.
All his stats had surpassed 200 and the Spiritual attribute had even crossed 300, the jump was too big.
'Whoa, 1 million Sin points!!' looking at the messages, Vritra was quite surprised.
He hadn't expected any sort of reward for doing that, instead expected a chase from other administrators.
But this was a pleasant surprise.
He stood up, seeing the wounds on his body heal rapidly, and glanced at his status panel.
[Stats]
(Strength: 270.6)
(Agility: 278.3)
(Endurance: 272.8)
(Spiritual: 315.3)
{Free Attribute: 16}
{Sin Points: 1,027,920}
"And another ascension path!" this was an unexpected gain, but right now there was something else he needed to worry about.
"So Vritra, now that you have killed an administrator, you won't be able to participate in the game anyway. Why don't you just come along?" the protector asked.
He was actually surprised that the administrator was killed so easily, it was actually way too easy.
It made him feel uneasy, maybe there was someone else here.
Despite the jump in Vritra's strength, he could not yet defeat the protector.
'Hey, Divine, you got any ideas?' taking the fighting pose as the spear flew back into his hand, Vritra asked.
"Sigh so, you want to resist till the end- COUGH" suddenly, intense pain shot through the protector's mind and body.
As if he was about to be torn apart, he had never felt death so clearly, his entire body was wrapped by a dreadful pressure.
And then a single voice sounded in his mind...
'LEAVE!!'
His knees trembled, entire body shaking as he almost fell to the ground.
But knowing that a second more here would mean death, the protector said nothing more and flew away at full speed.
"Huh? What was that?" Vritra couldn't understand why this guy suddenly left.
Whatever might be the case, it was time to find his family and continue with this game, while being more careful.
But right as he was about to fly away, a strange thought appeared in his mind.
'Wait, they are fine but first I need to use the Infinite Evolution Ascension Path.'
Before he could think further, he was holding the ascension path stone and inserted energy into it.
This was strange, too strange... why was he being so reckless again? He should have gone to meet his family first.
But before he could think anything else, the evolution began...
This time, not a forceful one.
The stone slowly broke into dust, wrapping all around his body, as he floated up glowing like a sun.
Vritra could feel the slight shift in his body and then his consciousness was consumed by darkness.
He lost all sensations, just allowing the evolution. The whole surroundings were consumed by an even bigger phenomenon.
An unknown time later, Vritra's senses slowly began to return.
His eyes were shut tight, and he found himself lying on a soft comfortable bed.
'Where am I? Did they find me?' he wondered if it was Yasmine, Maeve and the others.
As seconds ticked by, he started to feel more of his surroundings.
Vritra felt slight weight over his abdomen, as if someone was seated there.
Something soft pressing against his chest...

chapters.title: Chapter 679 My Love~
paragraphs: Warm breath tickled his ear as Vritra's eyes fluttered. A comfortable warmth and softness pressed against him.
An intoxicating fragrance calmed his senses, but this scent didn't belong to any of his wives.
'Where am I? Did the ascension succeed? Why did I even decide to do that?' Vritra's mind felt drowsy, then a honey-like voice sounded right beside his ear.
Tender moist lips brushed against his skin.
"My love, open your eyes. It is me, your Evelyn!"
Vritra felt like he was in a dream, and merging with the last evolution, he had been quite exhausted.
So, it felt nice to rest, and there was no way any other woman would get close to him with his wives around.
It must be a dream, but even in his dreams, why was there someone unknown?
Her eyes, full of love and madness, stared at his face.
After waiting for so many years, she could finally have him for herself, her man.
"Sigh... you really made me wait a long time. You'd better be ready for your punishment," she murmured, lightly biting his earlobe.
Vritra's eyes trembled slightly, but he didn't wake up.
He couldn't even sense her presence.
"Hehe. Do I need to wake you up with a kiss just like before? Hmm. Technically, it should be our first kiss..." she mumbled, pulling back a little.
Then her soft palms pressed against his cheeks as she held his face gently, despite the fiery emotions in her heart.
Her heart thumped wildly, feeling as if her body was on fire.
She had dreamed of this moment infinite times, to hold him close, to again become his wife.
Finally, it was all coming true...
Closing her eyes, she gently pressed her tender pink lips against his, feeling as if her body was melting into his.
"Mhmm." Pressing her lips harder, she rubbed them against Vritra's.
Vritra too felt the warm and soft sensation of someone's lips moving over his own.
At first, he felt the dream was becoming too real, as if someone was actually kissing him.
Then he thought maybe one of his wives was kissing him, his arms wrapping around her soft waist.
Evelyn moaned, feeling his strong arms wrap around her, her mind and heart overflowing with love.
'Mine, you are all mine!!'
He caught her lower lip between his lips, and as his eyes opened slowly, he really couldn't tell which of his wives was kissing him.
His unfocused eyes saw a face so close to him as she suddenly bit onto his lip before sucking it lightly.
Vritra was suddenly pulled back to his senses when he noticed the blonde hair.
From her waist, his hand moved to her shoulder as he pushed her.
Evelyn was happy that he was awake. She longed to hear him call her name with that love-filled voice.
She didn't let go of his lips instantly. Her teeth sank a bit into his lip, drawing a few drops of blood.
Her tongue softly licked his lips as she tasted his blood, giving it a gentle suck.
He felt a faint stinging pain over his lip, but it healed instantly.
"Mmmm~" Finally, she pulled back, an expression of euphoria on her face.
"My love, you are finally awake. Haa, you taste much more wonderful than in my memories," Evelyn spoke, licking her lips, tasting his blood and saliva.
"Huh? Who are y- Where am I? What is going on?!!" Vritra was completely baffled.
His gaze locked onto the face of the blonde woman before him, her beauty surprising him for a moment.
Long blonde hair, purple eyes, a face no less beautiful than Teresa's, and such a hot, juicy body.
It was as if this woman was created especially to seduce; she could easily drive men to madness.
But her beauty or hotness was the last thing on Vritra's mind. Why was this woman kissing him?
She was even sitting over his abdomen, looking at him with such a fiery gaze. From the look in her eyes, she seemed completely crazy.
"I am Evelyn Arclis, from the Vespera family, wife of Vritra Arclis," she spoke, her lips curling into a dazzling smile.
"..." Vritra stared at her in a daze. Was he missing some context here?
Did the Infinite Evolution Ascension Path make him go crazy or bring along this crazy... baddie?
"Wait, lady, I am a married man who is soon going to be a father. I think you made some mistake," Vritra said as he tried to sit up and push her off.
But his words brought a shift in her expression. She looked sad and resentful.
"You promised to give me your first child, but you went ahead and got another woman pregnant.
Sigh... looks like I need to drain you completely so you can't think about anyone else," she said in a possessive tone.
"Are you okay? What are you even saying?" Vritra frowned. What sort of psycho had he gotten himself involved with this time?
He thought about the past, wondering if he had jinxed it at some point.
'Hmm, I think I did say something when I was being forced to marry Teresa...'
It was something along the lines of being forced into an arranged marriage, then next getting kidnapped and forced into another one.
'No way, right? Right?' A frown appeared on his face. Strangely, he couldn't push off this delicate-looking woman.
He felt a bit annoyed. Her scent and taste lingered on his lips, but he couldn't do anything.
Why did he always end up in such situations? It was Yennefer before. He had to be careful now.
"I am more than fine and very, very happy to meet you, my love. Are you ready to be locked here with me for an eternity?" she asked, her voice taking on a psychotic tone.
"What?!!"
There was no way he would stay here forever. Leaving his family, he would rather die fighting.
"Hahaha. Don't be so tense, my love, I am joking. Haa, I just wanted to say hello this time. There is still time for us to meet properly. Wait for me..." she whispered.
Then a crazy, yandere-like smile appeared on her face.
"But since I have come, let me have a bite of you." As her lips parted, fangs grew in her mouth.
'V- Vampire?' Vritra was even more surprised, but in the next moment, she leaned against him.
Her soft heavy chest pressed against his, her fingers intertwining with his as she held onto him tightly.
Evelyn's parted lips pressed against his neck. She sucked his skin hard enough to leave a mark.
Then she bit into his skin, drawing a wave of his blood flooding into her mouth.
"Mmmmm~ Slup... Mhmm~"
GULP GULP.
Evelyn hummed while sucking hard, her soul almost reaching heaven as she tasted her husband's blood.
Her tongue swam in the warm blood, licking his skin as she gulped it with pleasure.
'So tasty! Mine, it is all mine. He is all mine. All of him is mine!!'
She hugged Vritra so tightly that he couldn't even move his arms.
At first he felt the sting of her teeth, but then it actually started to feel quite nice. It was a strange feeling, but not unpleasant.

'V- Vampire?' Vritra was even more surprised, but in the next moment, she leaned against him.
Her soft heavy chest pressed against his, her fingers intertwining with his as she held onto him tightly.
Evelyn's parted lips pressed against his neck.
She sucked his skin hard enough to leave a mark.
Then she bit into his skin, drawing a wave of his blood flooding into her mouth.
"Mmmmm~ Slup...
Mhmm~"
GULP GULP.
Evelyn hummed while sucking hard, her soul almost reaching heaven as she tasted her husband's blood.
Her tongue swam in the warm blood, licking his skin as she gulped it with pleasure.
'So tasty!
Mine, it is all mine.
He is all mine.
All of him is mine!!'
She hugged Vritra so tightly that he couldn't even move his arms.
At first he felt the sting of her teeth, but then it actually started to feel quite nice.
It was a strange feeling, but not unpleasant.

chapters.title: Chapter 680 Cut and Eat the rod
paragraphs: Evelyn's lips were covered by a red shade as she drank his blood, gulping it down thirstily.
It was as if she wanted to suck his soul out, for a moment she just lost herself in the sensation.
But remembering that Vritra was too weak right now, she controlled her thirst for him.
Having met her man, the one she had been waiting for countless years, she could barely hold back her urges.
Vritra felt dizzy, he blinked, his gaze unfocused.
Sadly, she needed to stop for now, despite her maniacal love, she would be heartbroken if she ended up hurting him accidentally.
A trickle of blood flowed down Vritra's neck, as she pulled back her fangs.
SLURP
She licked it tenderly, her tongue roaming over the mark she had left and pulled back after licking the blood.
"My darling, I will be coming back for you, get a lot stronger, so strong that you can steal me away..." she whispered as Vritra's vision darkened.
And then, darkness enveloped everything.
Everything was so peaceful, no sound, no sensations, it was all still.
Vritra inhaled deeply, but suddenly frowned, the air was a bit damp and suffocating.
Suddenly remembering that crazy woman, his eyes shot open as he sat up, ready to defend.
But there was no one, all of it now seemed like a dream.
"Was that all a dream? What a strange thing to dream about, anyway where am I?" Vritra looked at the dimly lit surroundings, as he felt a slight ache at his neck.
"Wait-" pulling out his spear, he glanced at his neck and it was there!!
The bite mark she had left!!
So that psycho woman was real, all of that had really happened?
Vritra felt his head spin, he thought his luck had finally gotten better.
But looks like he pulled yet another problem, a massive problem.
"A crazy vampire, why is she after me though? Evelyn, I don't remember ever hearing that name and it didn't seem like she was a player or from this planet." Vritra frowned.
"Divine, you know something don't you? Come clean, or I will make you sit over a throne of spikes!" Vritra cursed as he stood up.
"Oh that sounds... painful, haha sorry but I can't tell you anything about her or she will get mad. She is too powerful."
Divine apologized, this time he really could do nothing.
Though Vritra took out his anger on his brother-in-law, cursing until the other party was bleeding from both ears.
Finally, he looked around and found himself in some sort of mine and there were crystals embedded in the wall.
"Hmm now what is this? Did that woman leave me here?" walking up to the wall, he pulled out one of the crystals and bit into it.
[You have obtained 1 Strength Attribute Point!]
"Whoa, this is an Attribute Mine?! Hah great, thank you vampire lady." Vritra said and began to devour one stone after another.
So many would be useless for him, so he could take the rest for his family.
CRUNCH CRUNCH
[You have obtained 1 Strength Attribute Point!]
[You have obtained 1 Strength Attribute Point!]
Moving around rapidly, Vritra even created blood hands to pull more and more crystals, storing them all away.
"Stop lying, there is no way a cave like that could be present here. We have already checked the entire area, aside from those pathetic survivors, there is nothing." A man said angrily.
He wore a doctor's coat, with a stethoscope around his neck, with half his hair turning white.

"Believe me, doctor, I really saw those peasants take out crystals earlier. It increases their physical strength, it is a great treasure, I swear over your dead wife!" the other guy following behind the doctor muttered.
With a fox-like face, he looked really odd, there was even fur over his limbs and torso.

"Over your dead sister? I thought you hated her, if this turns out to be another lie, I will skin you alive. We have taken great risk by entering the territory of the Cinema organization." The doctor muttered.
"Alright, if I lie, then stuff my body with poop and hang me in a gutter, I will eat chili with my nose even!
Cut my penis off, feed it to me, throw dozens of men and mutants at me!" he said, with great determination.
"Okay, I will believe you this time. If it's true, then you are in for a great surprise." The doctor finally smiled.
If he could get such a mine, then his strength would soar and he could take over the Cinema too.
In his organization, the doctors, he was starting to lack live humanoid test subjects after all.
"How far?" he questioned, their bodies covered by strange threads that made them nearly invisible.
"Hehe it's hidden near the back where only peasants live, it will be very easy." The fox man said, scratching his pointy nose.
Soon they arrived near the slum-like area, passing through, they finally appeared on top of a hole.
"Oh it seems you weren't lying after all, good job. You will receive great benefits for this, let's head down and check." The doctor grinned ear to ear, greatly happy, patting the fox man.
"Kaka doctor, didn't I say it? Let's go in and see how many treasures we have, hehe I haven't gone in yet either." He spoke while rubbing his palms.
Yet just as they were about to jump inside, a human figure jumped out of the hole, brushing the dust off his clothes.
"Oh hey there," the person whose face was slightly covered by dust waved his hand, then casually walked past them.
"Huh? Looks like these peasants know about the existence of the mine, we should hurry."
The fox man said, the more these peasants used the stones, the less there would be for them.
Though there should be more than enough inside.
"Oh so they are planning a rebellion against the Cinema? Hehe how cute, too bad we will be stealing their only chance." The doctor muttered, jumping inside.
'Kekeke this is great so great, I am going to rise now. I will take half the crystals and become so strong that I will get all the women!!' the fox man thought and jumped in.
He saw the stunned expression on his brother-in-law's face in the dim light, and chuckled.
"Got shocked right? Didn't I tell you it would be great, so what is my reward now? Let me tell you, I won't settle for anything small brothaaaaaaaahhh-" as he turned, his soul nearly left his body.
There was absolutely nothing in the walls, not even a pebble-sized crystal, it was pitch dark inside.
The fox man bit his palm, tears filling his eyes.
"Good good, you won't settle for small right? I will prepare the biggest cocks for you, and do what? Cut off your cock and feed you? Eat chili by nose? And what..." the doctor was extremely angry.
He had to sacrifice a few of his men to create distraction and sneak inside, all of this for no treasure.
"N- No uwaahh it was here really, kyaaaah bro- brother-in-law, m- my dead sister's soul kiyaaaaaaaa"
A few metres away, Vritra looked back.
"Sigh, men these days, what has happened to society?" he shook his head, those guys just started down there?
"Well who am I to judge, to each their own I guess."

chapters.title: Chapter 681 Letting go
paragraphs: Walking away from the mine, Vritra gazed around at the slum like area, the living conditions of the people were so bad here.
Many hadn't even eaten in days, dead bodies could be seen lying around.
It truly made him feel bad for them, especially since he hated the gods so much.
'Was that woman stronger than the gods? Or was she a demi god too?' Vritra wondered.
But shaking his head, he tried pushing her out of his thoughts, though it turned out to be impossible.
'Do I actually know her?'
Anyway, right now he needed to return to his family and give them those crystals.
He glanced at his status panel, the numbers putting a big smile over his face.
[Stats]
(Strength: 380.6)
(Agility: 278.3)
(Endurance: 272.8)
(Spiritual: 315.3)
{Free Attribute: 16}
"Oh right, I have over a million Sin Points, I will draw lots but let's first get out of here. Hmm." he looked around at the vast territory of this organization.
Despite his high strength, he didn't want to just rush in blindly.
That would be stupid if there were many players or powerful mutants around.
"Infinite Evolution Ascension Path, let's try that!" he suddenly remembered his new Ascension Path.
With just a thought, his body rapidly began to evolve.
Large wings appeared over his back, tearing through his clothes and spreading wide.
Vritra could actually change his body in whatever way he wanted, and it was way better than the Internal Shuffle skill.
There were still limits but he was sure now he could even transform into a giant if he wished it, or gain any physical ability.
"Alright, time to leave." With a jump, Vritra soared into the sky.
At first he felt a bit awkward flying, but he quickly got used to it and sped up.
'I don't even know where I am currently, should I catch someone and question?' flying high, he looked down at the tiny human figures.
And dived down, wings shrinking back as his speed rose to an extreme.
WHOOSH

"So as I was saying, there is a new female survivor in the slu- huh? Where did this bastard go? Tsk I am going to complain, did he get wet from hearing about a woman or something?" the guard shook his head.
"Uwaaaaaaah!!" the other guard was already high in the sky, as Vritra dragged him away.
"S- Save meeeeee, mutant, it's a mutant!!" he shouted.
"Shut up, I am a human." Vritra said, at least he was in human skin.
"Uh oh, h- human? Why did you kidnap me? Are you from the Doctors? SOB Saveeeeeeeeee- Kaghhh" he suddenly fell silent after biting his tongue.
After travelling away, Vritra paused in the air.
"Just answer my questions and I will let you go, if you don't speak or lie I will let you go!" he threatened.
"Y- Yekkk I will goo ik- COUGH ughhh I will do it." he nodded hurriedly.
"Good, now tell me, which organization was it just now? In which direction is the base of Blood Fang? Any powerful mutants around?" Vritra asked.
"W- We are in the Cinema, and b- Blood Fang should be... in that direction. I don't know any mutants a- around." The man answered fearfully.
Vritra nodded as he scanned the area, then smiling he said: "Good job, you are a good guy. As promised I will let you go."
"Hehe T- Thank you saaaaaaaaaa-" the man smiled but only until Vritra let go of his arm, then he screamed madly.
"Bye, be a good person in your next life." After sending off his helper, Vritra scanned the area.
The sky was too dangerous but with his current stats, most things should be no match.
"Let's see how fast I can go then." Flames burst out of his feet as he sped away.
Looking at the mutants on the ground, he kept using Spiritual Burst to kill them all.
'All of them should still be there, right?' their strength was pretty high, they were all about to ascend.
There was a rather big gap between the Cinema and Blood Fang, Vritra had to fly for over thirty minutes.
'That's the location I was attacked at, hmm doesn't look like my second Ascension made as much of a scene.'
"But where are they?" looking around at all the rubble and few buildings, Vritra wasn't really sure.
He didn't even know how long he had been gone for, worry filled his heart.
But soon he saw pieces of clothes, something he was familiar with.
"Wasn't this the outfit that Ergen guy was wearing last time?" following the trail, he walked into a building.
But something felt strange, this building had a strong stench of blood.
He walked deeper, passing through an invisible border, Vritra suddenly found himself standing in a cave.
Water was dripping from the top and the ground was muddy, there were several footsteps.
"They had entered it?" Vritra frowned, he was sure they would just wait for him even if he was gone for a few days.
And with Yasmine with them, none of them would easily take on anything too risky.
"Did someone attack them?" frowning, his body evolved as he turned completely invisible.
Then he made his way forward hurriedly, from the footsteps it didn't seem they were taken in forcefully.
Maybe they escaped from someone, countless possibilities passed through Vritra's mind.
"Damnit, come out right this instant, you bitches, if I manage to break this damn door you are all going to be in big trouble!!" a guy wearing a lion's skin shouted.
"Kek How long can you stay hidden inside? Do you plan to die from starvation and thirst, see we have so much food." Another guy said while drooling.
This was an old man with a head full of white hair and half a foot in the grave.
"Tsk If Morgan hadn't ordered us to catch them alive, I would have just cut them earlier!" another guy whose entire body was full of scars spoke.
"Aye, what are you talking, how can we just kill such pretty ladies? But you are free to kill those guys." The old man said, licking his lips disgustingly.
Most of his teeth were gone too.
Outside a stone covered hole stood more than a hundred men, leading them were four men.
The man with scars, the old man, the brute lion guy and one man who stood completely silent, the new commander of Morgan's army.
He was previously a leader of a big group with the ability to make anything explode, but Morgan managed to somehow turn him into a slave.
The four ascended along with over a hundred men had attacked Fiona and the others while they were waiting for Vritra.
Thankfully, they had managed to escape but ended up locked in this place.
This was not a normal cave, after the door was covered by stone, it wouldn't budge.
Neither from inside nor from outside.
"Break this darn door, and get this perverted old guy away. I am going to kill them all!!" the scarred guy roared.
"Hey calm down, we don't kill women." the lion guy spoke, before adding:
"They are something we enjoy slowly, the more they resist the better. Haha And this bunch, I have never seen anyone as beautiful as those, I won't just hand them over to Morgan."
"Right, we can't kill those pretty girls, come out and play with me." The old man muttered.
Drrrrrrr...
Suddenly, the door began to open.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 Greed
paragraphs: "Sigh, those pigs aren't leaving, what are we going to do?" Diana paced around.
There was actually an ascension path inside this large hole, but if they pulled it out, the door would probably open.
So they didn't touch it.
The seven women stood together, discussing solutions.
"The best chance is that we try to ascend. We already have the ascension stones and 100% mutation, then we can fight them." Yennefer suggested.
Aside from Teresa, Diana and Onest, all of them had the ascension stone.
And seeing the ascension stone buried there, it was actually a good fit for Teresa.
"Yeah, I think that is the only solution, but what if it causes too much chaos? It can hurt others or maybe even open the door." Fiona said, frowning.
Aside from Vritra, they hadn't seen anyone ascend.
"Husband will find us, I am sure they can't defeat him." Teresa muttered.
But the problem was, they didn't know when he would find them and if the door would stay locked until then.
Just then...
DRRRRRRRRRR
The door actually started to tremble and open, all their gazes moved back to the ascension path stone.
Near the embedded stone sat Ming, his hand stretched out as he hurriedly pulled the ascension stone.
'Hurry hurry, I have to take it, once I start merging they can't do anything to me!!' greed took over his reasoning at this moment.
He had seen how strong people grow after using such stones, and Vritra had taken one of his before.
'So isn't it only right that I take this?' with a maniacal grin, he pulled out the ascension stone.
"Hahaha This is mine!! Let me ascend and I will kill those fuckers, hahaha my wife is a whore, now she is going to regret leaving me!!" he laughed madly.
He eyed the seven women, wondering if one of them would be impressed with him if he got very strong.
He imagined beating Vritra up, his laser ability killing anyone as he got a big harem of his own.
'I am going to do it!!'
But then he noticed the shocked expressions of the women and the three men, and heard the vibrating door.
"Fuck!" the ascension stone fell from his hand, his body shivering.
What had he done? Why had his greed suddenly taken over his mind and reasoning?
He had been warned not to touch that stone, yet his body moved on its own.
"Kekeke It's opening brothers, finally, this old guy's spell has worked!" the scarred guy shouted madly, walking inside.
The old guy, the lion man, and the explosion man all walked inside.
"Oh pretty girls, did you miss me? Keke grandpa is here now." The disgusting old guy muttered.
"Bitches, you made me so mad, now I am going to cut you all to pieces." The scarred guy shouted, about to rush but got pulled back by the one wearing lion skin.
"Now now, don't be so hasty. How can we even kill such beautiful women? I am giving you a chance, surrender on your own otherwise, well I love taming women too keke." He laughed.
"We are to bring them all back to Morgan." The mindless explosion guy spoke.
The over hundred men looked at them in shock and lust, how could there be such beautiful women?
Yasmine frowned, she glared at Ming, that man got them into trouble.
"Well well, look at what this twat has got, give it here!" the scarred man walked forward, snatching the stone from Ming's hand who had just picked it up.
"Hmm not bad, alright time for you to die heh." After speaking, he stabbed his own belly with a knife.
But instead, it was Ming who groaned in pain as blood spluttered out.
"Kakakakaka Die die die DIE!!" laughing maniacally, the scarred man stabbed himself again and again.
More scars appeared over his body, but all wounds appeared on Ming's body.
"Aaaaaah sto- urkkk COUGH Ughhh" Ming fell in a pool of his own blood, he felt guilty but it wasn't his fault.
"Sigh that psycho is at it again, whatever, let him deal with those men. So ladies, have you made your mind?" the lion guy asked.
Ming's entire body was riddled with holes and within seconds, his breathing stopped.
"Now, who should I target next? Kakaka." he looked at the remaining people.
"You pigs, step forward if you wanna die!" Shitless shouted, as he and Onest stood before the enemies.
The women also activated their skills, even if the power difference was too high, they would kill at least a few and hold on.
"Ah too bad, I gave you a chance. But I love it when women are so wild, don't mind me being a little rough." The smile on his face changed into a cruel look as he shouted:
"Capture these bitches!!"
"Oh, this place sure is lively, would you mind if I join in?" a strange voice suddenly sounded from the back of the group, interrupting them.
Before anyone could speak however, a layer of blood rose and formed a wall in front of the people standing there.
Startled, all of them turned around, just to see a single guy standing there.
A dark expression on his face, in the next moment an intense bloodlust enveloped the entire cave, spreading even outside the building.
Dozens of men held their throats, feeling suffocated, their eyes almost popping out.
A bloody fog rose from his body, the bloodlust taking on a material form.
"Who the fuck are- ughhhh mmphaaaaaaaa" the lion man frowned as he questioned.
But suddenly, Vritra's figure flashed before him.
One hand clutched his jaw while the other tore into his mouth, grabbing his tongue and pulling it out with a sickening scream.
Tearing half the throat along with it, as the man gurgled and coughed on his blood, jaw dangling freely.
These pigs dared to curse his wives and attack them, their deaths were not going to be easy.
His right hand turned into a bloody claw, slashing at the grotesque face, as he ripped out one of the eyes.
"Aaaaaaaaahh my- My Eyeeeeeesssss uwaaaaaaaah" the man screamed, his body starting to transform into a beast.
His own claws scratched his face but with a crunch and tearing sound, his limbs were broken and torn away.
Kicking the man away and letting him scream in pain, Vritra turned to face the others, his killing intent exploding violently.
None of them was going to survive today.
The men were frightened, their bodies refusing to move.
Only the scarred guy and the explosion guy returned to their senses.
Vritra lunged forward, his body turning into a blur. Using those torn hands, he slashed at everyone's throat or chest, not killing them but leaving them to die slowly.
Screams filled the area, none of them even had the chance to activate any skills as more than a hundred men were defeated within moments.
Soon they all lay in a big heap of bodies, all twisted and mangled, begging to be killed.
Their limbs were torn, their eyes were gone, their internal organs were falling out, yet death was coming too slowly.
Finally Vritra turned to face the remaining three men, the old guy, the mindless one and the psycho.
Just looking at them made him feel immensely mad, if he had been late, these sons of bitches would have attacked his family.
Suddenly, a flood of blood swallowed everything.
