chapters.title: Chapter 683 The Fake Psycho
paragraphs: The three remaining men were smashed against the walls as a flood of blood struck their bodies.
The old man's body almost bent backwards from the pressure.
The blast man pulled the two and rose to the top, steadying themselves as the blood disappeared.
"Ughhhh I- I am innocent, th- they dragged me here, please spare me SOB," the old man begged, trying to look pitiful.
While secretly trying to place a curse over Vritra, the only problem was, his curses took too long to activate.
Earlier he had used it on Ming and it took so many hours to finally show effect.
"..." Vritra's gaze focused on the old man, he had clearly heard those disgusting comments while rushing inside.
This old pig was the most disgusting of them all.
Just as the old man was about to place the curse, two threads of blood rose.
SWISH
In the next instant, his arms were chopped off, then his legs.
Vritra grabbed the air, the old man's body was pulled as he grabbed his throat.
"COUGH p- please, aaaaaaaaah I- I have a family ughhh spare... s- son, please," he begged, while screaming in pain.
"Alright." Vritra raised his other hand, then stabbed a finger into the old man's eye socket.
The blood finger pierced through his eyelid and then made the eyeball explode.
He screamed even louder, as Vritra did the same to the other eye.
"You were speaking rather disgusting words earlier, repent properly in hell." Vritra ripped out his tongue, pulling the jaw away at the same time.
Then threw the barely alive old man near the lion guy, now only two remained.
The explosion man, the commander of Morgan, moved with haste.
He pointed his hands towards Vritra, as loud explosions rang out but it was the wall that exploded.
Vritra's figure faded, leaving afterimages.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
He kept spamming his skill, almost bringing the entire cave down.
Vritra's speed had reached a level that this guy was not able to match with, he appeared behind the commander.
Although he would have very much liked to torture this guy too.
But it was nothing more than a pet of Morgan with no emotion, Vritra had already noticed this.
KCCHHH...
His arm tore through his chest, ripping out the heart with explosive strength of nearly 400 points.
Blood spurted out, and a big hole appeared in the commander's body, killing him instantly.
Now, only one man remained, the scarred man who was looking back at Vritra with a wide grin.
"Kekeke go ahead and kill me, will you? I almost ripped those bitches to pieces, aren't you going to kill me?" he laughed, still appearing crazy and fearless.
Vritra frowned, he was about to attack but felt something was amiss.
This guy had enough time to activate his skill, but why did he not try anything.
A drop of blood shot away, scratching the scarred man's arm but Vritra was surprised to feel it on his own arm.
'He can deflect the attacks back to me? How does this work though?' he pondered, mind working quickly.
It couldn't be because of his blood as he hadn't bled at all.
Not even through touching, then by some sort of scent? It couldn't be so omnipotent that it would work on anyone he wants directly.
'Is it by him seeing me?' Vritra's figure flashed away as another blood drop scratched against the scarred man's arm.
But again, the wound appeared on his body although Vritra was out of his sight.
'This isn't it, then how?'
"Hahaha can't figure it out? What a pity, you are truly powerful.
I am now going to kill you and steal your mutation progression, it is going to make me so strong hahaha then I will kill everything hidden there." He grinned madly.
Raising an arm, he stabbed his own shoulder, as blood spurted out of Vritra's shoulder.
But his expression remained the same, tentacles made of blood rushed out, enveloping around him.
"Ughhh let go bastard, fight me fair and squar- mmpphh-" he struggled but couldn't get free.
The wound on Vritra's shoulder healed quickly, while observing he noticed something strange.
"The shadows... they are moving rather strangely." Hearing his words a terrified expression flashed over the scarred man's face, before he tried to hide it.
'It really is shadow, and the best way to break the connection?' Vritra raised his right hand as a powerful flame burst out.
The ground lit up, the scarred man's shadow shivered before rushing back.
The connection was broken.
"Now, what were you saying again?" carrying the flame, Vritra walked forward and lit him up.
The crazy and arrogant look disappeared, as endless fear appeared in the scarred man's eyes. He was psycho only until he was torturing others.
Heart wrenching screams filled the cave as the scarred man got consumed by flames, but Vritra didn't let him die.
He continued to burn for some time, while at the same time a blood whip crackled over his body.
Ripping his skin, flesh and bones, even cutting into the internal organs.
"Well well, we can't leave your friends out of the fire party, now can we?" Vritra smiled evilly, walking towards the old man and lion guy.
Two blood poles appeared with a pointy tip, he held the limbless lion guy.
Then pushed his body down onto the small blood pole, as it tore through his ass and stabbed deep.
Then he did the same with the old man, their screams filling the whole place.
"Like that? Now let's get it started." Vritra put them on flames too, the three guys screaming as their bodies burned slowly.
"Heh you guys... are on fire today, enjoy your ride to hell." Vritra said as he covered them up with a blood wall.
Then the one which had covered his family disappeared, they weren't able to see or hear anything.
"We are done here, you are all okay, right?" Vritra asked with a gentle smile, looking at them.
"Yes darling, we are all fine, thank you for saving us..." Fiona hugged him, if he hadn't come just now, the outcome would have been tragic.
But even in this place, they couldn't keep up with his growing speed.
"Let's go, it is time for you all to ascend, then we will clear up few more bases here." He spoke, after checking all his wives.
"Pitiful one, where have you been?" Shitless asked, wiping the sweat off his forehead.
He really might have needed to show his true evil power today, the dark evil power hidden in his right eye since birth.
Yes, he is still a chunni.
"I killed that man but somehow ended up getting another ascension stone..." he explained things but didn't tell about the crazy woman he had met.
He wished he didn't have to meet her again, she seemed too dangerous and he was completely powerless against her.
"Even the administrator appeared sigh thankfully you are safe..." Yasmine hugged him tight.
As if the dangers of this planet weren't enough, now they have to face such things too.
"Oh right!" Teresa walked to one corner and picked a stone, it was the ascension stone that Ming pulled.
"This is quite suitable for me." She said, walking to his side then.
"Okay, let's head out then." Vritra said, as the group walked out.
He still needed to draw the rewards.
But right away, a shadow flashed before the ground and a long whip flew towards them at incredible speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 684 The Victim
paragraphs: "..." Vritra frowned, it was the same mutant from before, the one whose arm was torn.
"Fuck, this speedy bastard again?!" Onest was startled, as he fell back and bumped into Shitless,
whose metal head smashed against Ergen's face.
Vritra rolled his eyes, he casually caught the whip, giving it a pull.
KKRRRRRAAA-?
The mutant was startled as its body got forcefully pulled, it realized that Vritra's strength was higher than before.
It had been waiting here to kill Vritra after noticing him going inside.
The spear appeared in his hand and with a single slash, the body of the mutant was torn in half.
RAAARRRRRRRRRR!!
The mutant still roared while rushing at Vritra despite being torn in half.
BANG
Vritra stabbed the spear into its brain, finally killing it.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +3,353}
[You have obtained the Fast Foot Ascension Path!]
"Hmm Onest, see if it suits you." Vritra tossed the ascension stone to Onest.
Ergen, with his bleeding nose and a red face, looked on enviously, Vritra gave away the ascension stone just like that.
"Oh... it is!" Onest was quite surprised, all the ascension stones they were finding even randomly were perfect for them somehow.
"Good, let's continue then." Vritra said before looking at Ergen and asking: "Does your organization have anything good?"
"Hmm not really, they mostly depend on the powerful teams. Maybe they found something after I was gone." He shrugged his shoulders.
"..." Vritra nodded, now only Diana remained who was yet to obtain any ascension stone.
But it was fine, he still had a lot of sin points so he could probably get one for her, divine should have arranged it.
"On our way to the Cinema and the doctor, we will pass through there too. But first, let's rest, so you can all ascend peacefully." He spoke.
The others nodded in agreement, soon Ergen led them ahead towards a safe location.
"Are you feeling okay?" Vritra took Yasmine's hand, asking while looking at her belly.
There didn't seem to be any changes right now.
"Yes, and I doubt anything could happen to me with that charm." She replied, leaning her head onto his shoulder.
The cart moved rapidly, any mutant in the way had their heads explode directly.
"Sir, this is the place where very few mutants come. This place is occupied by an organization called the Survivors, it is filled with survivors." Ergen said.
"...Let's head in." Vritra looked at the large shopping complex which had a big hotel on top.
Right after entering, they saw dozens of people guarding it.
There were several thousand, but the food was even scarcer here.
"Why are you here?" one of the men shouted, holding a knife.
"We are survivors, calm down. We just need to stay here for some time." Ergen said quickly.
"We aren't accepting any more survivors, there is no food left here-"
Vritra didn't want to waste any time, he took out some food and put it on the ground.
"We don't need your food, this is our entry fee, and all the food we have." Vritra said, as he started walking into the building.
The men looked at the food in surprise then with joy, a greedy look flashed in their eyes as they looked at Vritra.
"Also, don't even think of trying anything funny. I can kill your bunch in an instant."
Right as he spoke, blades made of blood suddenly appeared against the throats of all of them.
They were scared to death and nodded hurriedly.
Ergen followed the group quickly, he was thankful that Vritra didn't throw him away despite what Ming had done.
"This place has enough space, we will be taking these rooms. You three can go rest." Vritra said, he took three free rooms.
Giving food to the people occupying them to make them leave for now.
First they ate some food and then rested, the past couple of days had been too exhausting.
They were so worried about Vritra, and then those men appeared.
'Morgan, I will make you suffer more than any of them.' Vritra felt really angry, that bastard was using others to do his work.
"Go ahead, I will watch over you all." Vritra said.
"It won't cause a big commotion, right?" Teresa asked.
"Of course it won't, just go ahead. It will take a day, just relax and go with the flow." He replied calmly.
Seeing his calmness, they felt quite relaxed.
The six of his wives got into three rooms with two women in one room.
Only Diana remained on his side.
"Dear, I guess I will have to wait a little." She said, but wasn't really complaining.
She now gets to spend time completely alone with Vritra.
"Don't worry, I will get one for you right away." Vritra patted the head of the goddess, her white smooth hair feeling quite nice to touch.
{Sin Points: 1,058,745}
"Draw 1000-point rewards, with fifty eight thousand points." he spoke, he wanted to draw bigger and better rewards with the remaining one million.
[You have obtained 3 Agility attribute points!]
[You have obtained 1000 beds!]
[You have obtained 10,000 bottles of cola!]
Vritra waited for all fifty eight rewards to appear and then scanned them.
[You have obtained the Adaptive Support Ascension Path!]
"There it is, good job divine." Vritra said, taking the stone out of storage and handing it to her.

"Heh I'm taking that green haired one, she is so-"

TIP TIP

"Nothing, one of the targets was just causing a ruckus." Yasmine spoke, it was going to be very fun killing them all.
"Alright, don't create too much noise and hurry up." The guards looked at them and then at the bags before heading back.
She glanced at her hubby who made those ten men experience all sorts of pain, from getting eaten up inside to burning, getting their insides ripped apart and much more.
After a few minutes, pieces of their bodies lay all over the ground, the pain they had experienced made them regret each and every single crime they had committed.
"Let's go inside, the best way to battle is stopping them from using their skills." Vritra spoke.
"Don't worry husband, let me take care of that." Teresa spoke, her skill was just perfect to stop anyone.
"Hmm we will start killing once we have found the doctor, this place has such a strong blood scent, a lot of people have died here." He added, as they entered the base.
First Vritra freed the captured humans, there were even kids among them, the people had truly become twisted.

Messages upon messages popped before Vritra as he, Shitless and Onest conducted experiments on the self proclaimed saviours of humanity.
According to them, they were killing humans to save humans, these stupid bastards just enjoyed torturing others and breaking people.
This was almost like those experiments of chimeras that the Nine Pacts were conducting.
While collecting sin points, Vritra walked lab to lab and killed off all the doctors.
Some victims were saved while some were in no condition to be saved, so Vritra gave them an easy death.
The commotion soon reached the Doctor, the leader of this organization.
He had just recently tortured his brother in law according to his wishes and had hanged him outside.
"Who is causing trouble here?" with a frown he asked, it had taken him great effort to build this whole thing.
He wouldn't let anyone ruin it, they were getting closer to creating artificial mutants, and then he would have an army of his own.
Where he would replace all the weak humans with scientifically produced powerful mutants.
"Doctor, they are outside. That bunch has already killed half of our- urkkk" the eyes of the man reporting suddenly widened.
A long spear pierced through the back of his head, coming out of his mouth, as extreme pain shot through him.
Then the spear was pulled upwards, cutting his head in two.
"There is a correction, I have killed all the other psychos working under you." Vritra smiled, looking at the shocked expression of the doctor.
This guy wasn't weak and from what he had heard his powers were truly strange, giving him abilities related to the tools of doctors.
Even from a distance he could kill his opponents before they even knew it, he could also create powerful poisons and inject them into others' bodies from afar.
Vritra knew it might be bad if he let him use his ability.
"You bastard you are dead!" the doctor's eyes focused on Vritra, he didn't even need to move his finger.
But just then his body froze as a room appeared around him, Vritra moved forward leisurely.
"Heh you think you can kill me?" while speaking he stabbed the spear two times quickly and popped both his eyes.
As the room disappeared, the doctor screamed in terror.
He at least needed his eyes to use his ability, now he could do nothing, he was powerless with only slightly high physical prowess.
"Now, as the star of this giant laboratory, you need special treatment." Vritra mumbled.
He made Diana create two types of fluids, one was the best healing fluid while the other was poisonous and acidic.
Then hanging the screaming doctor upside down, Shitless held a rope.
When he pulled, the doctor was dipped into the poison, his flesh, skin and everything started to melt.
But before he could die, Onest would pull and dip him into the healing potion.
They continued to torture him like that for dozens of minutes, completely breaking the doctor.
Then pulling him out, they stabbed hundreds of thousands of needles into his body, sparing not a single part of him.
Then they made him drink and eat everything disgusting they could find, from mutant flesh, poop, vomit, phlegm, urine and whatnot.
Onest and Shitless tortured the doctor to their hearts' content, then cut his limbs into thousands of pieces.
After that his body was hanged alongside his dead brother in law in the sewage.
"Looks like we are done here." Vritra along with his wives walked out, just then another scream of the doctor rang out as small mutant fishes began to tear him apart and eat him.
A perfect death for such a pig.

"Next is the Director, I heard he used to be a real director and created one flop after another. He had gotten to the lowest of society and as the apocalypse came, he went mad. He loves to have slaves." Maeve spoke.
"Well I have been there before, that place isn't far, we can reach it in 20 or so minutes." Vritra said as he created a cart, which then moved quickly forward.
He didn't plan to enter any of the forbidden areas yet, once he was out of the Beast Cave, then his strength would be high enough to sweep through this place easily.
The cart was flying a little higher than the ground but suddenly the rubble under it started to shake.
Vritra frowned as he brought the cart even higher as suddenly a big mouth opened in the ground, trying to devour them whole.
"Its that big mouth again, this bastard really won't let us go!" Onest shouted.
Now, Vritra wasn't really worried, he glanced at its stats all of which were lower than his own.
"Let me go take care of this." He said and jumped down.
This thing was way weaker than that tiger.
Vritra pulled out the spear and stabbed it near the edge of its mouth, as it tried to bite Vritra down with its countless teeth.
But using a blood wall he stretched the mouth even wider, then dragged the spear's blade down, cutting it apart.
RUUUOOOOOOOOO
A pain filled loud roar reverberated all around, it was loud enough to alert even the mutants and humans several kilometres away.
Vritra continued to cut it apart while using blood blades to stab all over, its mouth was stretched to the point it began to tear apart.
This mutant's resilience was rather high, despite being powerless against Vritra, it took some time to finally kill it.
Ignoring the messages, Vritra jumped onto the cart.
"Let's continue, these screams might make the director raise their guard." But with his current strength it didn't really make any difference.
"Husband, have a drink." Teresa smiled as she passed Vritra a cold drink.
Vritra nodded and as per their agreement, he leaned in and pressed his lips against her moist soft black lips.
Instead of thanks, they exchanged kisses.
"Darling, have this snack too." Fiona quickly took out a packet of chilli snacks, just the ones Vritra liked.
"Oh thank you Fiona." Vritra smiled as he took the packet.
"Huh? What about my kiss? I want to exchange thank you and sorrys too!" Fiona said.
Of course Vritra knew why she gave him snacks suddenly, the cute redhead was feeling competitive.
And this brought her cute side out, he really loved her current expressions, even though she seemed upset.
"Ah I see, then do I have to make up for all the past sorry and thank yous?" he asked, leaning towards her.
"Darling, stop teasi- mmm~" suddenly he captured her soft lips, giving her a tender kiss.
For their privacy, he had created a sort of wall around the eight of them while Shitless and Onest sat at the back.
"Aww hubby, are we getting compensations? Then I would like to get my compensations for all my thank yous, I have helped you plenty of times." Yasmine said coyly, pressing her body against his.
"Compensation? I am yours, you can claim as many kisses as you want, do you even need to ask?" Vritra said, wrapping his arms around her soft waist.
Giving a soft kiss on her red lips, he spoke: "And didn't I compensate you enough? Or you want more of my kids?"
"Hehe we can think about that later, we have to first do our best for our baby." She mumbled.
Vritra gently caressed her belly, he couldn't wait for their child to be born, that's all the more reason to do his best and leave this place.
He hugged her before kissing her forehead with love.
"Sigh... wifey, there is something I am yet to tell you." Vritra spoke while hugging her.
"What is it?" she asked, her eyes closed, she loved being in his strong arms.
His warmth and scent, she wanted it to surround her whole body.
"Actually, when I was fighting that administrator and protector, I was kind of kidnapped..." Vritra explained everything, shocking all his wives.
"What?! Who is it that dares to take my position as the first wife?!" Yasmine felt quite mad.
"Honey, she didn't hurt you right?" Vanessa asked worriedly.
"No mom, I am fine, it didn't seem like she was an enemy. And I feel divine already knew about her, she is really powerful though." He added.
"That bastard, playing all secret, just wait till I find out. You are getting beat up so bad." Yasmine muttered.
"Can you defeat her?" Fiona asked, frowning.
"No I can't, sigh she might be even stronger than the gods or so I feel." He said.
The group fell silent, at least that woman wasn't trying to hurt him, or they would be in real trouble.
"Evelyn... who even is she?" Yennefer mumbled, but somehow she felt she knew something about her.
After all, she had entered one tenth part of the love pill, they didn't directly meet but had sensed each other.
"Whatever it might be, I doubt she will appear anytime soon, let's clear up the directors then we will head to the Beast Cave." Vritra spoke.
Glancing at the distant tower, he felt the looming danger, he would need as much strength as possible.
Kill all the players and win this game, then he could finally return to the Zoratian planet and spend some time in peace.
Though Vritra doubted there was any peace in fate.
'Right I still need to find that pig too, that bastard has been causing too much trouble.' He thought about that certain player.

He wouldn't let anyone ruin it, they were getting closer to creating artificial mutants, and then he would have an army of his own.
Where he would replace all the weak humans with scientifically produced powerful mutants.
"Doctor, they are outside.
That bunch has already killed half of our- urkkk" the eyes of the man reporting suddenly widened.
A long spear pierced through the back of his head, coming out of his mouth, as extreme pain shot through him.
Then the spear was pulled upwards, cutting his head in two.
"There is a correction, I have killed all the other psychos working under you." Vritra smiled, looking at the shocked expression of the doctor.
This guy wasn't weak and from what he had heard his powers were truly strange, giving him abilities related to the tools of doctors.
Even from a distance he could kill his opponents before they even knew it, he could also create powerful poisons and inject them into others' bodies from afar.
Vritra knew it might be bad if he let him use his ability.
"You bastard you are dead!" the doctor's eyes focused on Vritra, he didn't even need to move his finger.
But just then his body froze as a room appeared around him, Vritra moved forward leisurely.
"Heh you think you can kill me?" while speaking he stabbed the spear two times quickly and popped both his eyes.
As the room disappeared, the doctor screamed in terror.
He at least needed his eyes to use his ability, now he could do nothing, he was powerless with only slightly high physical prowess.
"Now, as the star of this giant laboratory, you need special treatment." Vritra mumbled.
He made Diana create two types of fluids, one was the best healing fluid while the other was poisonous and acidic.
Then hanging the screaming doctor upside down, Shitless held a rope.
When he pulled, the doctor was dipped into the poison, his flesh, skin and everything started to melt.
But before he could die, Onest would pull and dip him into the healing potion.
They continued to torture him like that for dozens of minutes, completely breaking the doctor.
Then pulling him out, they stabbed hundreds of thousands of needles into his body, sparing not a single part of him.
Then they made him drink and eat everything disgusting they could find, from mutant flesh, poop, vomit, phlegm, urine and whatnot.
Onest and Shitless tortured the doctor to their hearts' content, then cut his limbs into thousands of pieces.
After that his body was hanged alongside his dead brother in law in the sewage.
"Looks like we are done here." Vritra along with his wives walked out, just then another scream of the doctor rang out as small mutant fishes began to tear him apart and eat him.
A perfect death for such a pig.
"Next is the Director, I heard he used to be a real director and created one flop after another.
He had gotten to the lowest of society and as the apocalypse came, he went mad.
He loves to have slaves." Maeve spoke.
"Well I have been there before, that place isn't far, we can reach it in 20 or so minutes." Vritra said as he created a cart, which then moved quickly forward.
He didn't plan to enter any of the forbidden areas yet, once he was out of the Beast Cave, then his strength would be high enough to sweep through this place easily.
The cart was flying a little higher than the ground but suddenly the rubble under it started to shake.
Vritra frowned as he brought the cart even higher as suddenly a big mouth opened in the ground, trying to devour them whole.
"Its that big mouth again, this bastard really won't let us go!" Onest shouted.
Now, Vritra wasn't really worried, he glanced at its stats all of which were lower than his own.
"Let me go take care of this." He said and jumped down.
This thing was way weaker than that tiger.
Vritra pulled out the spear and stabbed it near the edge of its mouth, as it tried to bite Vritra down with its countless teeth.
But using a blood wall he stretched the mouth even wider, then dragged the spear's blade down, cutting it apart.
RUUUOOOOOOOOO
A pain filled loud roar reverberated all around, it was loud enough to alert even the mutants and humans several kilometres away.
Vritra continued to cut it apart while using blood blades to stab all over, its mouth was stretched to the point it began to tear apart.
This mutant's resilience was rather high, despite being powerless against Vritra, it took some time to finally kill it.
Ignoring the messages, Vritra jumped onto the cart.
"Let's continue, these screams might make the director raise their guard." But with his current strength it didn't really make any difference.
"Husband, have a drink." Teresa smiled as she passed Vritra a cold drink.
Vritra nodded and as per their agreement, he leaned in and pressed his lips against her moist soft black lips.
Instead of thanks, they exchanged kisses.
"Darling, have this snack too." Fiona quickly took out a packet of chilli snacks, just the ones Vritra liked.
"Oh thank you Fiona." Vritra smiled as he took the packet.
"Huh?
What about my kiss?
I want to exchange thank you and sorrys too!" Fiona said.
Of course Vritra knew why she gave him snacks suddenly, the cute redhead was feeling competitive.
And this brought her cute side out, he really loved her current expressions, even though she seemed upset.
"Ah I see, then do I have to make up for all the past sorry and thank yous?" he asked, leaning towards her.
"Darling, stop teasi- mmm~" suddenly he captured her soft lips, giving her a tender kiss.
For their privacy, he had created a sort of wall around the eight of them while Shitless and Onest sat at the back.
"Aww hubby, are we getting compensations?
Then I would like to get my compensations for all my thank yous, I have helped you plenty of times." Yasmine said coyly, pressing her body against his.
"Compensation?
I am yours, you can claim as many kisses as you want, do you even need to ask?" Vritra said, wrapping his arms around her soft waist.
Giving a soft kiss on her red lips, he spoke: "And didn't I compensate you enough?
Or you want more of my kids?"
"Hehe we can think about that later, we have to first do our best for our baby." She mumbled.
Vritra gently caressed her belly, he couldn't wait for their child to be born, that's all the more reason to do his best and leave this place.
He hugged her before kissing her forehead with love.
"Sigh... wifey, there is something I am yet to tell you." Vritra spoke while hugging her.
"What is it?" she asked, her eyes closed, she loved being in his strong arms.
His warmth and scent, she wanted it to surround her whole body.
"Actually, when I was fighting that administrator and protector, I was kind of kidnapped..." Vritra explained everything, shocking all his wives.
"What?!
Who is it that dares to take my position as the first wife?!" Yasmine felt quite mad.
"Honey, she didn't hurt you right?" Vanessa asked worriedly.
"No mom, I am fine, it didn't seem like she was an enemy.
And I feel divine already knew about her, she is really powerful though." He added.
"That bastard, playing all secret, just wait till I find out.
You are getting beat up so bad." Yasmine muttered.
"Can you defeat her?" Fiona asked, frowning.
"No I can't, sigh she might be even stronger than the gods or so I feel." He said.
The group fell silent, at least that woman wasn't trying to hurt him, or they would be in real trouble.
"Evelyn... who even is she?" Yennefer mumbled, but somehow she felt she knew something about her.
After all, she had entered one tenth part of the love pill, they didn't directly meet but had sensed each other.
"Whatever it might be, I doubt she will appear anytime soon, let's clear up the directors then we will head to the Beast Cave." Vritra spoke.
Glancing at the distant tower, he felt the looming danger, he would need as much strength as possible.
Kill all the players and win this game, then he could finally return to the Zoratian planet and spend some time in peace.
Though Vritra doubted there was any peace in fate.
'Right I still need to find that pig too, that bastard has been causing too much trouble.' He thought about that certain player.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 The Beast Cave
paragraphs: On their way ahead, Vritra and the others encountered many more mutants, all of whom were killed easily.
At least their current strength was enough to deal with such creatures.
"That is the director's base, as I expected, they have increased the defence." Vritra mumbled as he scanned the guards.
"They are weak, let's clear this up." Fiona spoke, flames bursting out of her palms.
As the cart got closer, the guards were alerted. They pointed guns and ability users locked onto them.
"Stop right there, if you take one more step we are going to shoot!" one of the men shouted.
"Is your leader inside?" Vritra asked.
It looked like a military base, with pretty high walls and all the guards in military uniforms.
"He is, do you want to take shelter here?" another guard asked hurriedly upon seeing the women.
It was still a bit dark but they could still somewhat see, and like always, these men were entranced too.
"Yes, can we enter?" Vritra asked, but then he raised his hand and pointed forward.
WHOOSH
Dozens of blood bullets shot out rapidly, the guards were taken off guard as their bodies got riddled with the bullets.
Within seconds, all of them died, baffled expressions still on their faces.
"Let's go inside, I have seen a lot of people here the previous time."
He cut the door easily as the ten entered the base, though already a lot of military men were rushing towards them.
"Wha- Attack, kill them, there are intruders!" The man leading the group shouted, launching his ability.
BANG BOOM
Instantly lots of attacks were launched towards them, but Teresa using her new abilities caught even the attacks.
After ascension, all of them had grown tremendously.
Yasmine launched spiritual bursts, making the heads of a few of them explode.
Yennefer and Fiona burned some to death, sending flying dragons which ate those men.
And just like that, without Vritra even doing anything all of them were dead and messages kept flashing before him.
"Stop right now!!" a loud voice sounded as a man flew from the sky and landed before them.
He had a seven feet height and a heavy body, he looked like a mutant but that was just how he looked.
"Are you the leader?" Vritra asked.
"Yes I am, how dare you kill my slaves!! But in exchange, I can take these women, not a bad exchange."
Vritra just shook his head, in the apocalypse, 99% of men were going crazy over women.
"Anyway, I heard you are a scum and I decided to come here and clear this place. The doctors are already gone, and looks like only you are left here." Vritra spoke as he took a step forward.

'No way, he has to be lying. I just went there yesterday, there is no way he could have killed them so soon. Right, he is trying to scare me, it must be related to his story. Hmph such tricks won't work on me!'
He acted even prouder, believing that the more fearful he appeared the stronger Vritra got.
"You have come to your death-" he was just speaking when his body began to swell up, the prideful man screamed in pain.
But no matter what he tried, his body kept stretching.
And soon...
BOOM!
He exploded, shooting off blood in all directions.
"And we are done, these bases are pretty weak but the beast cave will be different." Vritra mumbled.
He didn't really have anything to do here, so just like before, after helping the survivors a bit they departed.
They left some food behind, Vritra had too much anyway.
It was time to enter the beast cave and start the grind.
Sitting over the blood cart, Vritra was chatting with his wives as they flew towards the centre of the city.
All nearby mutants died wherever the cart passed.
It was a long ride and took nearly four hours, but no problem appeared during this time thankfully.
"So this is the beast cave? It's more like a hellhole..." Vritra stopped the cart over the big hole in the ground.
A bright red light was coming from inside, it looked truly insidious.
"Shall we enter? Once we are inside, we won't be able to leave until I have cleared it up." Vritra spoke.
"Yes, hubby, let's go." Yasmine and the others agreed.
It was better to be with him than just stay back and wait for him.
"Alright, hold tight then." He said and lowered the cart but as soon as they moved into the red hole, the cart turned back into blood.
All of them suddenly started to fall.
"Kiyaaaaaaah~" Shitless screamed the loudest.
But just as they got closer to the ground, instead of hitting it, their bodies floated for a moment.
Vritra and the others quickly adjusted and landed on their feet, only Shitless fell on his bum and kept screaming.
"Tch stop screaming, we are already here and... we have got quite the company it seems..." Onest spoke, seeing hundreds of men looking back at them.
All of them stood in a big space, as if waiting for something and they looked very very hostile.
Vritra's gaze focused on a man with lots of scars, it was none other than Morgan, that bastard player who kept attacking them.
He was standing with dozens of other men, seeing Vritra and the others still alive, he appeared shocked at first.
Then a strange twisted smile appeared on his face, one of his eyes was gone thanks to Teresa.
So he seemed to look at her really hatefully.
Vritra's anger exploded right after seeing him, but just as he was about to rush forward to kill him, the other men suddenly shook their hands.
"Don't do anything..." they spoke in a low voice.
"What's wrong?" Vritra walked forward, while his gaze remained locked onto Morgan and the others with him.
As he entered the large space, one man gestured for him to look up.
Many men looked at the women with entrancement but none dared to try anything, as if they were afraid of moving.
"Keke why don't you try running or shouting?" Morgan chuckled, but spoke in a very low voice.
Vritra just frowned and looked above, his eyes widening in surprise.
The ceiling of the large space was full of something that looked like big blackish red eggs.
Thousands of them.
"What are those?" he mumbled, all his wives also followed and looked up in shock.
It was a really strange sight, but why were all these people acting like this?
Morgan clicked his tongue when he saw Vritra not doing anything, he hoped to see him die.
Vritra also noticed that their skills were being suppressed here greatly, he could barely activate blood manipulation.
He couldn't understand what was happening, but just as he was about to question Divine, he saw one of the burly men shove a short guy away.
The short guy stumbled and fell, a dreadful expression on his face, but just as he screamed-
KUT
Something flashed, devouring his head and pulling his body upwards and then the short guy was swallowed into one of the eggs.
'What the fuck? I heard this is a trap, but what are we supposed to do here?' the others silently moved away from the burly man who grinned hideously.
"Come attack me, will you?" Morgan whispered, trying to anger Vritra.
Vritra looked at Morgan and nodded: "Alright."
He pointed his hand forward and in the next second a gun appeared in his hand, fully loaded.
Seeing it, Morgan was shaken.
Without the use of abilities, guns were still fatal for them, it could easily kill him.
"W- Wait, if you fire, you will die too so think befo-"
But then everyone standing in the space froze, their eyes going as wide as saucers.
A Baldy entered the large hall, and suddenly he stumbled and fell, his face as red as a tomato.
But that was not shocking as many people's appearances changed with their abilities.
They all looked up as the Baldy cursed loudly and then got up, he brushed off his clothes and quickly walked away.
And nothing happened to him.
"Huh? How is he alright? Is it because of his ability or is that thing up there already full?" someone muttered.
"SOB I don't want to be here, I don't want anything I just want to live!" a man suddenly ran to the outside, feeling that now those things weren't going to attack.
But he hadn't even taken a few steps when suddenly something fell from the top, swallowed his head and dragged him up.
"Whoa, what was that?" Shitless was surprised, he quickly ran, picked up the ring on the ground and hurried back.
Yet again, nothing happened to him.
'As always, Shitless is strange.' Vritra just shook his head, he had gotten used to it by now.
"Wait, Sir Shitless..." as he spoke, the monk turned, wondering what Vritra now wanted him to do.
He used that whenever there was some work.
"Y- Yes?" he asked, looking at the pretty gold ring then putting it away.
"Are you up for doing something evil? Something that creates bloodshed and panic?" Vritra asked, speaking in a low voice.
"Yes!! I am always ready for evil things, tell me, what I need to do!" Shitless agreed instantly, smiling evilly.
"Go and beat those guys over there as much as you want, here use this whip and staff. Beat them until they start screaming." Vritra said, giving a few torture weapons away.
"Oh, hehe that's my favourite. I won't disappoint you pitiful one!" Shitless saluted, then carrying the weapons he walked towards Morgan's group.
"W- What do you want Baldy? S- Stay the fuck away, don't come close ughhh" and then it began...

chapters.title: Chapter 692 The Circle
paragraphs: WHACK WHACK WHACK
Morgan and his group lay upside down, with their backs facing upwards.
They were all biting their own palms to stop themselves from screaming as the mad Baldy kept hitting them.
First he used the whip to strike them with all his strength, each strike ripping their flesh.
Their clothes were already stained with blood.
'Damn you Baldy, just you ughhh w- wait, I am going to kill you, you fucking Baldy bastard!' they were all cursing internally but couldn't do anything.
"Muahahaha How do you like that? Time for this spiky staff." Then Shitless picked the spiked staff and started hitting their asses.
THUMP THUMP THUMP
The onlookers unconsciously tightened their own seeing the wild beating, their asses were torn badly, many of them had even peed in terror.
Even if they survived, they wouldn't be able to sit ever again.
"Focus on Morgan." Vritra said, pointing at the guy who was leaking blood.
"Hahaha" Shitless turned, picked up a metallic rod and stabbed it into Morgan's back entrance.
Right now he felt like a god, he could do anything but the others couldn't even scream.
While hitting Morgan repeatedly, Shitless hit the back of another with the spiked staff.
"Ahh- UWaaaaaah!" he let out a scream and instantly got dragged up by those egg things.
It scared the others. Shitless, the rest moved away from the crazy mutant as he continued to torture Morgan and a few other men.
'Fucking bastard, he is even humiliating us ughh damnit I am going to tear him apart, fuck ughhh stop SOB stop please...' Morgan was crying, his body bloodied all over.
Right as Shitless was about to push the rod deeper, one of the egg like things fell from the ceiling.
THUD
This startled the group, as one by one all eggs started to fall down.
A few of them ended up devouring entire humans, Vritra moved back with his wives.
Shitless also moved away though those things were still treating him like a plague.
THUD THUD THUD
All of them fell, then started to roll rapidly, they moved forward at the same time and got closer.
Then they moved through one of the walls, creating a big cave and continued to move on.
"The beast cave has opened! Mmph-" one of the men shouted, only to regret it a moment later but thankfully nothing happened.
"Let's go!" Morgan was the first to run forward, as he pulled away the rod and ran in a strange manner.
The others in his group were the same, all of them leaving behind a trail of blood.
Poor him had failed to find any other players, so he could only collect the most powerful guys he found.
And right now they were in no condition to fight.
"Let's go." Vritra spoke calmly, he could have just killed Morgan and the others but he didn't.
It would be too easy of a death, and there was no chance of escaping from this cave.
"Was it really okay to let him go?" Teresa asked, looking hatefully at their distant figures.
She regretted not being able to kill him before, if it was for her husband, she wouldn't feel any guilt even hurting others.
"Don't worry, he won't live for long." Vritra said, patting her head gently.
When did this goth mommy become so hot headed?
They were going to stay here for quite long, and all the others who had entered were all going to regret entering.
As the crowd thinned out, they finally started moving.
"Stop right there!" a few guys quickly ran towards Vritra.
Their abilities were still not working, so this was the perfect time for them to gang up on someone and defeat him.
Vritra looked lazily at the ten or so guys, all of them holding knives or other weapons.
'Hah there are always people so eager to give me sin points.' he thought, and pulled out his spear.
"Just keep moving and leave these women behind if you wanna live!" one of them spoke, eyes glued to them.
Another fool whose lust was going to bring him down.
'Kekeke Great, this is great! Die you bastard, while you are busy with them I will be the one to take the reward here. I heard it could make anyone extremely powerful.'
Morgan thought, as he hurried forward.
The group after passing through the cave saw that all the eggs had disappeared and there was a door.
A very big metallic door which had hundreds of animal figures carved on it.
Apocalypse had even brought such things? All of them wondered.
This thing was terrifying as much as it was fantastic, but for some this was the perfect time to shine.
Here, most people started on equal grounds.
Their abilities still seemed to be locked, so they didn't get in any conflicts and quickly pushed the door.
Unlike their expectations, the place inside was pretty lit.
They walked inside, looking at the walls and forward.
The walls seemed to be made of those very eggs they had seen before.
There was a circle at the centre which could at most fit twenty people.
And ahead was nothing but darkness.
"What is this place? Where is the treasure? Do we need to go forward?" one man mumbled.
"This is your father's grave, the treasure was hidden in his ass and no you need to dig down to find his grave.
You bastard, who are you even asking?" another man retorted in rage.
"What did you say? You fucker, I am going to beat your ass and search you, maybe it is your ass the treasure is hidden in!"
The first guy replied in anger, raising his arm.
Both of them were standing inside the circle and they kept getting mad.
"Huh? Why are they fighting over each other's asses suddenly?" the ones outside couldn't understand.
"It's the circle! It makes you mad!" Morgan was the first to realize, thankfully he was standing outside.
"Oh!" all those after hearing this quickly ran outside the circle.
And they finally felt better, it indeed was because of the circle.
"Sorry brother for disrespecting your father's ass, I didn't mean it." The second guy spoke.
"It's fine, I offended your ass too, I am not going to shove my hand into it to find the treasure." The two shook hands, then hugged.
They just stood there, wondering what to do, none of them wanted to get close to those eggs.
Or head into the darkness either.
"Why don't we go ahead and check if the treasure is hidden there?" Morgan suggested, he felt if he could control everyone here.
Then using them as sacrificial pawns would be easy and he could take the treasure.
Vritra too arrived at the large door.
From outside he glanced at everything, then turned to his family.
"The battle will start pretty soon, for now why don't you all just wait here?" he spoke, holding the spear.
"Be careful honey." Vanessa spoke, touching her son's cheek.
"Yeah don't worry, I have faced worse, it won't be a problem.
And as Divine has mentioned, there will be breaks between the beast waves."
After talking for a few more minutes he headed into the door.
His appearance attracted everyone's attention, then they looked at the people waiting outside.

sentences.text: WHACK WHACK WHACK
Morgan and his group lay upside down, with their backs facing upwards.
They were all biting their own palms to stop themselves from screaming as the mad Baldy kept hitting them.
First he used the whip to strike them with all his strength, each strike ripping their flesh.
Their clothes were already stained with blood.
'Damn you Baldy, just you ughhh w- wait, I am going to kill you, you fucking Baldy bastard!' they were all cursing internally but couldn't do anything.
"Muahahaha How do you like that?
Time for this spiky staff." Then Shitless picked the spiked staff and started hitting their asses.
THUMP THUMP THUMP
The onlookers unconsciously tightened their own seeing the wild beating, their asses were torn badly, many of them had even peed in terror.
Even if they survived, they wouldn't be able to sit ever again.
"Focus on Morgan." Vritra said, pointing at the guy who was leaking blood.
"Hahaha" Shitless turned, picked up a metallic rod and stabbed it into Morgan's back entrance.
Right now he felt like a god, he could do anything but the others couldn't even scream.
While hitting Morgan repeatedly, Shitless hit the back of another with the spiked staff.
"Ahh- UWaaaaaah!" he let out a scream and instantly got dragged up by those egg things.
It scared the others.
Shitless, the rest moved away from the crazy mutant as he continued to torture Morgan and a few other men.
'Fucking bastard, he is even humiliating us ughh damnit I am going to tear him apart, fuck ughhh stop SOB stop please...' Morgan was crying, his body bloodied all over.
Right as Shitless was about to push the rod deeper, one of the egg like things fell from the ceiling.
THUD
This startled the group, as one by one all eggs started to fall down.
A few of them ended up devouring entire humans, Vritra moved back with his wives.
Shitless also moved away though those things were still treating him like a plague.
THUD THUD THUD
All of them fell, then started to roll rapidly, they moved forward at the same time and got closer.
Then they moved through one of the walls, creating a big cave and continued to move on.
"The beast cave has opened!
Mmph-" one of the men shouted, only to regret it a moment later but thankfully nothing happened.
"Let's go!" Morgan was the first to run forward, as he pulled away the rod and ran in a strange manner.
The others in his group were the same, all of them leaving behind a trail of blood.
Poor him had failed to find any other players, so he could only collect the most powerful guys he found.
And right now they were in no condition to fight.
"Let's go." Vritra spoke calmly, he could have just killed Morgan and the others but he didn't.
It would be too easy of a death, and there was no chance of escaping from this cave.
"Was it really okay to let him go?" Teresa asked, looking hatefully at their distant figures.
She regretted not being able to kill him before, if it was for her husband, she wouldn't feel any guilt even hurting others.
"Don't worry, he won't live for long." Vritra said, patting her head gently.
When did this goth mommy become so hot headed?
They were going to stay here for quite long, and all the others who had entered were all going to regret entering.
As the crowd thinned out, they finally started moving.
"Stop right there!" a few guys quickly ran towards Vritra.
Their abilities were still not working, so this was the perfect time for them to gang up on someone and defeat him.
Vritra looked lazily at the ten or so guys, all of them holding knives or other weapons.
'Hah there are always people so eager to give me sin points.' he thought, and pulled out his spear.
"Just keep moving and leave these women behind if you wanna live!" one of them spoke, eyes glued to them.
Another fool whose lust was going to bring him down.
'Kekeke Great, this is great!
Die you bastard, while you are busy with them I will be the one to take the reward here.
I heard it could make anyone extremely powerful.'
Morgan thought, as he hurried forward.
The group after passing through the cave saw that all the eggs had disappeared and there was a door.
A very big metallic door which had hundreds of animal figures carved on it.
Apocalypse had even brought such things?
All of them wondered.
This thing was terrifying as much as it was fantastic, but for some this was the perfect time to shine.
Here, most people started on equal grounds.
Their abilities still seemed to be locked, so they didn't get in any conflicts and quickly pushed the door.
Unlike their expectations, the place inside was pretty lit.
They walked inside, looking at the walls and forward.
The walls seemed to be made of those very eggs they had seen before.
There was a circle at the centre which could at most fit twenty people.
And ahead was nothing but darkness.

Where is the treasure?
Do we need to go forward?" one man mumbled.

chapters.title: Chapter 693 The Blood Thread
paragraphs: "Oh, if it isn't the famous Adam, aren't you bringing those beauties inside?" Morgan smiled evilly, his eyes full of hatred.
His back was still twitching so badly from pain, pants full of blood.
"Why? You want your other eye stabbed as well? Or did you like the Monk's torture a bit too much- oh no, you are wet again, did he take your virginity?" Vritra chuckled.
"You bastard!" Morgan was really angry, no one had ever treated him with such disrespect.
He had even sent his men to kill his family, how did they even survive?
"Sir, isn't that red monster coming inside with us? Please bring him inside, it will be safer for us." One of the men pleaded.
Vritra just ignored him then looked at the countless eggs on the walls and the circle on the ground.
"How many of you are willing to follow me ahead to find the treasure? I will guarantee your safety and share with you any treasure we find!" Morgan suddenly shouted.
He noticed that the restriction over their abilities was slowly disappearing.
"..." the men hesitated, glancing at one another.
"I- I will follow you, you will really keep me safe? And give me a part of the treasure?" a young guy asked, he was clearly with Morgan earlier.
"Of course, I would die before I let anything happen to my followers. You see all these scars on my body? I fought bravely to protect my men, almost dying!" Morgan shouted.
Vritra just shook his head, all those who had entered the door were not going to survive anyway, so he didn't bother with anyone.
"I will f- follow you too!"
"Me too! Please sir, allow me to join your team, my ability is great at finding things!"
One after another, nearly all the men had sided with Morgan, although they had seen him get humiliated earlier.
But they were just desperate to cling to anything that seemed reliable.
"Good good, I will protect you all. But first we gotta deal with the troublesome man, or he might cause trouble for us all like earlier.
I only accidentally bumped into him before and he went that far. What do you all think he would do for the treasure?" Morgan spoke.
'Hmm not bad, he is pretty good at manipulating others.' Vritra thought.
After hearing Morgan, all the hateful gazes turned towards him.
They all felt if they showed their abilities now, they would receive favour from Morgan and a bigger part of the reward.
To please him all of them were ready to cut this one man apart.
"Sure sure, come inside and kill me." Vritra stepped into the circle, standing there while holding the spear.
He could kill them all to earn points quickly, but it was pretty meaningless, who knew what abilities they might possess.
So it was better to preserve energy for the beast wave, where he would get a whole lot of points and attributes.
"Ughh you coward, come outside if you dare!" one guy shouted.
"Act like a man, don't hide inside like a coward, come out and fight!"
"Don't copy me bastard, that's what I said!"
"Heh you think you are safe inside? Then face my Ice spikes!" a middle aged man laughed as he pressed his hands against the ground.
CRACK CRACK CRACK
Then spikes began to break out of the ground rapidly, heading dangerously for Vritra.
"Sigh" he sighed, they really wanted to die and give the sin points to him so badly?
"I guess it can't be helped." A thin thread of blood appeared out of nowhere, it was invisible to the naked eye.
But it was extremely sharp, Vritra made it extremely flexible then pulled it to one side with extreme force.
As for the ice spikes, he just launched a spiritual burst to make the head of the man explode.
BOOM
The spikes stopped instantly, the others were shocked as the head of one of them exploded suddenly.
Their heads turned automatically as suddenly a very faint noise sounded.
TUK
The wire was let go, it shot towards the men at such extreme force and speed, barely a few with suitable abilities were even able to notice.
"DUCK!!" a man shouted as he quickly sat down.
Not all were fast enough though, a few ducked instantly as the wire swept through the ground.
THUD
It hit the walls, striking the egg which made cracks form over it.
But no one focused on that, only sixty or so men had managed to duck in time among the hundreds of them.
The ones who were standing had their faces full of shock, as the upper part of their bodies started to slide down.
Thin red lines appeared which instantly soaked their clothes in blood.
THUD THUD THUD
Vritra had seen a scene like this on reels, where people were killed like this in a bus and once in a ship.
A few who reacted a bit late had their heads cut off, giving them instant deaths.
But others who only had their torsos torn were mostly still alive.
They screamed in pain, trying to find their own lower halves as pools of blood and internal organs formed over the ground.
Dozens upon dozens of messages popped before Vritra, giving him thousands of sin points.
He didn't really care about this bunch of people, the moment they entered the door they were going to die anyway.
There was no treasure, it was just a deadly trap.
But for him it was an endless grinding place.
While the people were screaming in terror, Vritra without even glancing at his sin points ordered:
'Use all my sin points and open 1,000 points worth rewards.'
As the wheel began to spin, even more messages began to pop before him.
Neil looked at the survivors who looked absolutely terrified, none of them dared to even get close to him.
Now they knew why Morgan had used them to fight him instead of himself, he didn't even take the lead.
This filled them all with rage towards Morgan, it was all a trap from the beginning.
While standing inside the circle Vritra felt his body grow stronger as the attribute points got added.
He just glanced at the free attributes.
{Free Attribute: 98}
"Hmm add all these points to endurance, I will need more stamina." He said, ignoring the remaining people he gazed back.
Vanessa, Yasmine, Fiona, Teresa, Maeve, Diana and Yennefer all were worried but they smiled in support.
Vritra nodded as a rumbling sound rang out.
DRRRRRRR...
The doors were starting to close, it startled many of them, a couple of men tried to run back.
BAM
But there was some invisible wall that stopped them from leaving, one man fell back while the other was crushed between the heavy metallic doors.
Morgan managed to survive, mainly because Vritra had let him, but all his mindless puppets were gone.
As the door closed, a vibration ran through the entire cave and then...
CRACK CRACK CRACK
Suddenly, the eggs began to crack, and suddenly a message popped before them all.
[Stay outside the circle and be devoured by the beasts, stay inside and be devoured by rage!]
They trembled and understood, so staying inside the circle was safer?
They all looked back at the circle where only Vritra was standing, and frowned, afraid of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 The Beast Tide Starts!!
paragraphs: None of the humans dared to enter the circle because of Vritra's presence, even if that was the safest place.
They glanced at one another while shivering, waiting for someone to make the first move.
CRACK CRACK CRACK
The eggs began to crack suddenly, making everyone shiver in fear.
"Don't be so afraid, you can take this circle." Vritra spoke as he walked out of it.
"Heh fool- ughhh stop pushing me." The crowd rushed into the circle hurriedly but there was clearly not enough space for everyone.
Morgan as an ascended easily took one of the places, there were a few more ascended who pushed the others out.
Only twenty people could stand inside the circle, even then they would be standing very close to one another.
The rest of the forty or so were terrified, trying to pull others as the eggs cracked and strange creatures started to fall out of them.
And even behind the cracked eggs, there were even more eggs.
THUD THUD THUD
Strange black creatures fell to the ground, trembling, their bodies nearly three feet tall.
They were drenched in some sticky fluid, appearing like newborn babies.
Their bodies shook and started to swell, they were growing rapidly and becoming horrifying.
Vritra, holding the spear, dashed towards the wall.
He swung the spear with all his might, cutting a dozen of the small creatures before they could grow.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +832}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +832}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +832}
Vritra didn't wait to see the messages, he had to kill as many of these creatures as possible before they grew.
He ran hurriedly while the others were busy panicking, he cut apart a few more but their growth was just too fast.
In the next few seconds, minotaur like creatures rose to a height of over twelve feet.
Their faces resembled bulls and they all stood over their hind legs, thick fur covered their bodies, and their eyes glowed a dangerous red.
Those creatures were all ascended!!
Vritra could have brought his wives inside to fight along with him, but first he wanted to check the difficulty of the fight.
With his strength he could survive even in the dangerous beast tide but he wouldn't be able to protect them.
After making sure, he would bring them all inside and start the family grinding.
'There are thousands of them, it reminds me of that death zone.' Vritra thought, without pause he continued to move.
Stabbing the spear in rapid succession, he blasted holes into the bodies of several, while twisting his body to dodge the deadly attacks.
Blood blades, spikes and whatnot constantly launched towards the crazy beasts who surrounded Vritra from all sides quickly.
There wasn't even a wall to put his back against, even the ceiling was spawning these creatures.
"Aghhhhhh p- please save meeeee uwaaaaaaah"
"I- I am begging please let me in aaaaaaaah"
The people who weren't able to enter the circle screamed, their bodies crushed and torn to pieces by the daunting creatures.
GRRRRRRRRRR
ROAAARRRRRRRRR
GUOOOOOOOOOO
The creatures let out strange noises, filling the entire cave with a dreadful aura and intense bloodlust.
Within moments, all the people outside the circle were dead.
The twenty men inside were utterly appalled by the sight, their bodies shaking.
These things were too powerful, how were they going to even fight so many? Where even is the treasure?
All twenty of them were sticking closer, afraid that the circle might shrink or those things might enter.
But in the horde of monsters, they all saw blood splatter wildly and something shiny wave through the air.
BAM
A heavy corpse was thrown away, smashing into the wall, and a pool of blood could be seen on the ground.
"N- no way, that guy is fighting all these creatures on his own? Just h- how strong is he?!!" the people inside were baffled, watching as Vritra created a bloodbath wherever he moved.
He had already used all treasures he had found through the sin points, going all out in the battle.
"Fucker, stop pushing me!! There is not much space here!" one man shouted suddenly, the circle was completely surrounded by those beasts.
They kept screaming at them, waiting for any to move out.
"Ughhh damnit, stop poking my butt you stupid sucker, what are you even doing?! Get away!" another man shouted in rage and pushed the first out.
Who screamed and was torn apart the moment his body moved out of the circle.
Blood was thrown onto the men in the circle, shaking them, as they saw the internal organs and bones getting devoured.
A heavy kick was thrown at Vritra's back, as he jumped up, rotating in the air and cutting the leg apart.
Strikes were raining down at him from all sides, and he could feel as time passed, these beasts were getting more dangerous.
While in the air, he pulled the spear and threw it with all his might, impaling the head of one beast into the ground.
Then he punched out, his hand piercing through the chest of one, ripping its backbone out.
CLANG
A powerful blow landed on his back, but was stopped by his armor, as Vritra kicked at the attacker's shoulder.
As a loud crunching sound rang out.
There was little space to move, using the spear was too difficult here.
'Keep drawing 1000 sin points reward, use all my points.' he called out in his mind.
The ethereal wheel rotated quickly as a lot of rewards appeared, even giving him a lot of attribute points.
'Add all my free attribute points to endurance.' Vritra thought, then shot out powerful spiritual bursts.
He scanned the storage while the beasts were dazed and pulled out dual swords which were a new reward.
"Ughh I meant it when I said the reward is in your father's ass, bastard, go out and dig it!"
"Hah not his ass but his dick, which he left in your mother, you son of a bitch."
The two vulgar guys started to fight, their eyes turning red from rage.
"How dare you say that about my mother, I am going to kill you myself, motherfucker!"
And so, he stabbed the other man and then threw him out.
But the other guy's hand suddenly grew, pulling the first guy out, as the two screamed and were torn and devoured quickly.
Now, three were dead and only seventeen remained, even more scared.
Morgan looked around, if it was before he might have been able to fight some of these creatures too.
But now that all his parasites were gone, he had lost a big part of his powers, there is no way he could survive outside.
And inside the circle people were slowly getting affected, their eyes turning blood red.
"Aggghhhhhhh get awayyyyy, uwaaaah how dare you beasts look down on me, no one can look down on me.
Not my parents, nor my teachers, neither my friends, not even you shitty beasts. I am going to kill you all." A guy in his twenties screamed in rage and suddenly ran out.
But instantly his body disappeared in the sea of dreadful beasts, sounds of bones breaking and flesh tearing apart sounding.
Vritra, without caring about them, continued to exert more and more strength, his breathing getting faster and faster.
"Hehe Did you miss me, my love?"

The twenty men inside were utterly appalled by the sight, their bodies shaking.
These things were too powerful, how were they going to even fight so many?
Where even is the treasure?
All twenty of them were sticking closer, afraid that the circle might shrink or those things might enter.
But in the horde of monsters, they all saw blood splatter wildly and something shiny wave through the air.
BAM
A heavy corpse was thrown away, smashing into the wall, and a pool of blood could be seen on the ground.
"N- no way, that guy is fighting all these creatures on his own?
Just h- how strong is he?!!" the people inside were baffled, watching as Vritra created a bloodbath wherever he moved.
He had already used all treasures he had found through the sin points, going all out in the battle.
"Fucker, stop pushing me!!
There is not much space here!" one man shouted suddenly, the circle was completely surrounded by those beasts.
They kept screaming at them, waiting for any to move out.
"Ughhh damnit, stop poking my butt you stupid sucker, what are you even doing?!
Get away!" another man shouted in rage and pushed the first out.
Who screamed and was torn apart the moment his body moved out of the circle.
Blood was thrown onto the men in the circle, shaking them, as they saw the internal organs and bones getting devoured.
A heavy kick was thrown at Vritra's back, as he jumped up, rotating in the air and cutting the leg apart.
Strikes were raining down at him from all sides, and he could feel as time passed, these beasts were getting more dangerous.
While in the air, he pulled the spear and threw it with all his might, impaling the head of one beast into the ground.
Then he punched out, his hand piercing through the chest of one, ripping its backbone out.
CLANG
A powerful blow landed on his back, but was stopped by his armor, as Vritra kicked at the attacker's shoulder.
As a loud crunching sound rang out.
There was little space to move, using the spear was too difficult here.
'Keep drawing 1000 sin points reward, use all my points.' he called out in his mind.
The ethereal wheel rotated quickly as a lot of rewards appeared, even giving him a lot of attribute points.
'Add all my free attribute points to endurance.' Vritra thought, then shot out powerful spiritual bursts.
He scanned the storage while the beasts were dazed and pulled out dual swords which were a new reward.
"Ughh I meant it when I said the reward is in your father's ass, bastard, go out and dig it!"
"Hah not his ass but his dick, which he left in your mother, you son of a bitch."
The two vulgar guys started to fight, their eyes turning red from rage.
"How dare you say that about my mother, I am going to kill you myself, motherfucker!"
And so, he stabbed the other man and then threw him out.
But the other guy's hand suddenly grew, pulling the first guy out, as the two screamed and were torn and devoured quickly.
Now, three were dead and only seventeen remained, even more scared.
Morgan looked around, if it was before he might have been able to fight some of these creatures too.
But now that all his parasites were gone, he had lost a big part of his powers, there is no way he could survive outside.
And inside the circle people were slowly getting affected, their eyes turning blood red.
"Aggghhhhhhh get awayyyyy, uwaaaah how dare you beasts look down on me, no one can look down on me.
Not my parents, nor my teachers, neither my friends, not even you shitty beasts.
I am going to kill you all." A guy in his twenties screamed in rage and suddenly ran out.
But instantly his body disappeared in the sea of dreadful beasts, sounds of bones breaking and flesh tearing apart sounding.
Vritra, without caring about them, continued to exert more and more strength, his breathing getting faster and faster.
"Hehe Did you miss me, my love?"

chapters.title: Chapter 695 The Bet
paragraphs: "My hunny bunny, did you miss me?"
Suddenly a sweet fragrance enveloped Vritra as he felt softness press against his back, then two arms wrapped around his neck.
She spoke in a low whisper, before planting a soft kiss on his neck.
Vritra who was just fighting the beasts was shocked, freezing for a moment then he realized who it was.
"Evelyn?!" While he was distracted dozens of large creatures attacked him at once.
But they were all pushed back, creating an even bigger circle around the two, just by one thought of Evelyn.
"Yes, it is me, your first wife." She spoke sweetly, getting off his body.
Vritra turned around and saw the same gorgeous face with a burning gaze and sweet smile.
"What are you doing here? Why are you even bothering me?" Vritra asked, taking a step back.
"Obviously I am here to see you, and don't say that, it makes me feel sad. But it's fine- Love!"
Just as Evelyn was speaking one of the creatures broke free, rushing into the circle as it swung its claws towards Vritra's back.
But right at the last moment, Evelyn pulled him, shielding him with her body.
BANG
The claws struck her body, piercing through as blood splashed over the surprised Vritra's face.
COUGH
She coughed, weakly raising her hand to push the beast away, blood leaking from the corner of her lips.
Evelyn looked weakly at Vritra, touching his cheek with her bloody hand, softly falling into his arms.
Vritra held her, his face emotionless as he looked at her weak, shivering form.
As she fell, he sat down, holding her.
"M- my love, I have loved you haa for a long time. Protecting y- you was my choice, I just want to hear you say you love m- me cough p- please, fulfil my l- last wish..."
She spoke in a broken voice, eyes slowly shutting down.
Vritra's expression turned grim as he nodded, if it was her last wish, he would certainly fulfil it.
He wasn't so cruel as to send off someone who just saved him in sadness.
Touching her cheek, and supporting her, he spoke gently.
"You love m- me cough, happy now?" Vritra asked, rolling his eyes.
Evelyn who was waiting to hear his love confession after so long, was speechless, he didn't have to say literally the same thing.
He rose to his feet, pulling her up, and spoke, "Now, enough with your act, don't disturb me."
"Haa my love, you used to play along before, anyway where are my welcome back kisses?"
Evelyn asked, spreading her arms.
Vritra just rolled his eyes, he took several long breaths to calm down, good breathing, then asked:
"How do you even know me? I haven't even heard your name before."
"Sigh fine, I'll tell you. You might not know it but we spent whole nine years together, it might have been a dream but it was a reality for me. Remember the love pill?" She asked.
"Oh!" Vritra suddenly remembered a pill he got from the sin wheel which he had tossed out of the planet.
He still wasn't sure why he had even thrown that pill away.
He cursed the divine internally, as expected, that bastard not only knew about it but he was the one to start it all.
"Haa wait, what you are feeling must have been the effect of the love pill, it's not real love! Maybe th- the effects of the pill will disappear or... I can try finding some antidote." He spoke.
"No! Those nine years might have been an illusion but I lived through them. And I know very well what a love pill is, I created it.
It doesn't work like that, it won't just make anyone fall for anyone. I lived with you and I fell for you, while you did for me, it was all real." Evelyn spoke seriously.
Vritra truly didn't know what to say to her now, she definitely wouldn't hear no and he can't just accept any random woman into his life.
He didn't even know how much is the truth and if she has any hidden motives.
"Don't worry, my darling. You don't have to respond or even accept my love, I can just steal it all, you, your love. All of it belongs to me..."
She muttered in a soft yet obsessive tone. Vritra was truly helpless, since when did women become so open, forward and forceful?
He was sure he couldn't defeat her, and was even worried she might hurt others in his family.
"So, what are you here for then?"
He questioned, looking cautiously at her.
Vritra didn't want Evelyn to jump on him like Yennefer did, this woman seemed even crazier.
"I'm here to meet you of course, and tell you that I need you to quickly meet my parents." She replied, smiling.
"Huh? Why would I meet your parents?" Vritra wondered if this woman had a screw loose, she was acting like he had already agreed.
Or did his choice not matter at all here?
"Of course that's to marry me, my silly love." She added.
"Sigh I have not agreed to any of that yet, also let me focus on killing these beasts now." Ignoring the beautiful blonde woman, he turned to look at the grotesque monsters.
They still seemed to be growing with the passage of time, their bodies already over fifteen feet.
"Hmm how about a small bet? If you can kill exactly 107 monsters in a minute, I will leave for now and even leave a nice gift for you." Evelyn spoke, and continued:
"And if you lose, heh you will have to play a little game with me."
"I don't agree, I don't want to bet. And from the way you spoke last time, it doesn't seem your family will approve of our relation even if I agree, right?"
Vritra asked, thinking of ways to make her disappear.
"...Yeah, it will be really difficult to make them agree, but we can do it I am sure.
Sigh they had already even found some random higher being for me, trying to get us engaged, but don't be jealous my love, I firmly rejected." Evelyn said.
Though she knew her family wasn't going to drop the matter easily and there wasn't much she could do against them.
That's why she needed Vritra to grow quickly.
She wouldn't even be able to run from her family, so unless Vritra married her officially, the only way to stop the marriage is by freezing her life force for eternity.
"And you believe I can do anything against your family? I can't even defeat you." Vritra said, he could smell the trouble brewing.
"Not... now, but very soon. I am here to support you, aren't I? Anyway as for our bet, let's start!" she said, as her serious expression changed into a playful one.
With a snap of her finger, the force disappeared, allowing those beasts to attack Vritra again.
He could only sigh, knowing he had no say even in this bet.
Maybe winning this bet could give him momentary freedom, he held the dual blades, and went on a killing frenzy.
Kill exactly 107 of these creatures.
As the sounds of battle started to ring out again, the seventeen men standing in the circle were utterly terrified.
Their minds were going out of control already, rage building inside their minds.
